dhanādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavānunmādaḥ syāt| tena pāṇḍvādikaḥ
                            sannidamidaṃ karoti| tathā śokakhinnacetāḥ san dhyāyan jāgaraṇaśīlo
                            viceṣṭate|

athedṛśyunmādalakṣaṇe+avagate sati pavanajo ya unmādastasmin snehapānaṃ
                            pūrvaṃ kārayet| āvṛtavartmani tvanile sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanaṃ pūrvaṃ
                            snehapānāt kārayet|

kaphabhave pittabhave conmāde snigdhasvinnasya narasya yathāsaṅkhyaṃ
                            vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca kārayet| apiśabdānna kevalaṃ
                            pavanajesnehapānamādau, yāvat kaphapittotthe+api kāryamiti gamayati|
                            tathā ca muniḥ(?)-"unmādaṃ snehapānena pūrvaṃ sarvamupācaret|" iti|
                            bastiṃ śirasaḥ savirecanaṃ triṣvapyunmādeṣu kārayet| tathā ca-evaṃ,
                            śuddhaśarīrasya sato manaḥ prasīdati|
yuñjyāttāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ||22||

evamapyupakrānta unmāde+asyānubandhe sati tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanāñjanaṃ yuñjyāt,
                            harṣaṇādi ca| kutaḥ ? yasmādetāni kṛtāni śuddhadehasya cittaṃ prakṛtiṃ
                            prāpayanti|

hiṅgvādibhirdvipalikairghṛtasyāḍhakaṃ gomūtreṇa saha pacet| taccopayuktaṃ
                            paramamunmādādijit|
dvau prasthau svarasād brāhayā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam||23||

brāhmīsvarasātprasthadvayaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ vyoṣādibhiḥ kārṣikai
                            rajīkṛtaiḥ pakvaṃ palavṛddhyā-palaṃ prathame+ahni dvipalaṃ dvitīye+ahni
                            tripalaṃ tṛtīye+ahni catuṣpalaṃ caturthe+ahne tataḥ paraṃ
                            catuṣpalamityevaṃ, prayuñjīta| tacconmādādijidvandhyāsutapradaṃ
                            vāgādikṛcchivaṃ ca brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam|
pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare||29||

varādibhiḥ karṣapramāṇairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| taccopayuktaṃ
                            bhūtagrahādiṣu śreṣṭhaṃ balyādiguṇaṃ ca| kalyāṇakākhyametatsarpiḥ
                            puṃsavaneṣu ca varam| atra ca bhadrailā-sthūlailā|

ebhyo-varādibhyo, madhyādādyāni sapta hitvā, dvisārivādīnyekaviṃśatiṃ
                            jale ṣoḍaśaguṇe snehāpekṣayā pacedyāvatsnehāccaturguṇaḥ kvāthaḥ| tasmin
                            snehacaturguṇe rase sarpirgṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇaṃ vīrādibhiḥ
                            snehakvathitaiḥ pādikaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet| etanmahākalyāṇakaṃ nāma
                            ghṛtaṃ pūrvasmāt-kalyāṇakāt, guṇairatiriktam| atra dvisārivādināṃ
                            pāṭhādevaikaviṃśatitvaṃ cet atadguṇasaṃvijñāno+ayaṃ bahuvrīhiriti
                            kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| evaṃ ca sārivādidvayasya grahaṇaṃ na
                            prāpnuyādityekaviṃśatigrahaṇam
jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā||34||

jaṭilādibhirghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| jaṭilāmāṃsī|
                            pūtanā-harītakī| keśī-gandhamāṃsī| caraṭī-padmacāriṇī|
                            markaṭī-kapikacchūḥ| jayā-araṇikā| vīrā-kākolī| corakaḥ-caṇḍā|
                            vayaḥsthā-dhātrī| śūkarī-vṛddhadārukaḥ| chatrā-dhānyakam|
                            aticchatrā-śatapuṣpā| palaṅkaṣā-lākṣā| mahāpuruṣadantā-śatāvarī|
                            kāyasthā-kṣīrakākolī| nākulīdvayaṃ-sarpākṣī sarpasugandhā ca|
                            mahāpaiśācakasaṃjñaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| tathā+amṛtatulyaṃ
                            mahāguṇatvāt| buddhyādikaṃ śiśūnāṃ ca saṃvardhayati|
brāhmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām||38||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām||39||

brāhmyādibhirgajamūtrapiṣṭā vartiśchāyāyāṃ viśoṣitā nasyādibhirunmādahṛt|
                            viṣaghnā-ativiṣā| viśalyā-lāṅgalī| nāgavinnā-nāgadantī|
                            kāṅkṣī-saurāṣṭrikā|

sa-"kalkādyairavapīḍastu" (hṛ.sū.a. 20/7) iti kathito+avapīḍaḥ|
                                te+avapīḍāḥ sarṣapatailayutā hitāḥ| abhyaṅgaśca sarṣapatailena|
                                tathā+asya tadrajaḥ-sarṣapacūrṇaṃ, ghrāṇe dhmāpayet| tathā
                                sūtrasthānoktastīkṣṇo dhūmo (a. 21/17) hiṅgunā saha hitaḥ|

enaṃ-conmādinaṃ, punaḥpunaśca gomatsyādibhiḥ suṣṭhu
                            pūtiṃgandhibhirdhūpayet| vātaśleṣmātmake bāhulyenaiṣa upakramaḥ|
tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ||45||

paittike tūnmāde tiktakaṃ sarpirjīvanīyaṃ ca śasyate| tathā
                            miśrako-yamakaḥ snehaḥ, praśasyate| tathā śiśirāṇi madhurāṇyannapānāni
                            laghūni ca śasyante|
vidhyecchirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā||46||

tathā śirāvyadhavidhyuktāṃ śirāṃ vidhyet| meduramāṃsasya tṛptaṃ nivāte
                            svāpayecca| evaṃ kṛte sati mativibhramāt mucyate|
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||52||

athavā jalavarjite kūpe prakṣipya kṣudhā śoṣayet| athavā
                            taṃ-unmādavantaṃ, suhṛt dharmārthayutairvākyairāśvāsayet-sāntvayet|
                            athavā+asya putrādervināśaṃ-vighātaṃ, taṃ brūyāt| adbhutāni vā taṃ
                            darśayet| athavā kaṭutailenābhyaktaṃ badhvā tamuttānaṃ kṛtvā+a+atape
                            nyaset| kapikacchvā, athavā taptairlohādibhiḥ| athavā
                            carmakaśābhirahatya baddhaṃ santamavaṭe viniḥkṣipet| śastrādivarjite
                            tvagāre(+andhakāre) bhavane vā badhvā vinikṣipet| nanu ca, ekasya
                            śūnyagṛhe sthitirunmādasya nidānamuktam| yacca yasya nidānaṃ tadeva
                            tasya kathaṃ cikitsitaṃ syāt ? naiṣadoṣaḥ| tadarthakāribheṣajatvāt|
                            tadarthakāriṇi hi bheṣajeyadeva nidānaṃ tadevauṣadham|
                            yathā,-tucchadagdhe+agnipratapanam, madātyaye madyapānamiti|
                            tadvadihāpyavagantavyam| athavā samutpāṭitadaṃṣṭreṇa sarpeṇa bhāpayet,
                            dāntairgajādibhirvā| rājapuruṣā bahirnītvā taṃ suṣṭu yantritaṃ kṛtvā
                            rājājñayā tarjayanto vadhena bhāpayeyuḥ| yato dehaduḥkhabhayebhyaḥ
                            sakāśāt paraṃ-atiśayena, prāṇabhayaṃ matam| tena-bhayena,
                            itaścetaścittaṃ viplutamunmādinaḥ śamameti|

iṣṭadravyavināśād yasya mānasamupahanyate tasya tatsadṛśā-tulyā, prāptiḥ
                            kāryā| tathā sāntvanaiścāśvāsanaiśca śamamunmādinaṃ nayet|

bhūtaiḥ-devādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anubandhaḥ-anuṣaṅgaḥ, tamanantarokta
                            āgantāvunmāde yadīkṣeta tato bhūtapratiṣedhoktamauṣadhaṃ kuryāt| nanu,
                            kathamīkṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyate ? iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa
                            hetumāha-proktaliṅgādhikākṛtimiti| proktāni pūrvaṃ ṣaḍvidhasyonmādasya
                            yāni liṅgāni tebhyo+adhikā+a+akṛtiḥ-lakṣaṇaṃ, yasya-bhūtānubandhasya,
                            taṃ tathāvidham|
catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca||58||

tathā+atra bhūtānubandhe palalayāvakādi ca yāvat puṣpāṇi sahacarasya ceti
                            baliṃ dadyāt| kva ? catuṣpathe, tathā gotīrthe nadyorvā saṅgame|

yaḥ puruṣo nivṛttamadyamāṃso hitabhojī prayataḥ śuciḥ syāt| sa sātviko
                            nijāgantubhirunmādairna yujyate| tasmādīdṛśena bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ|

indriyārthānāṃ prasannatvaṃ tathābuddhyātmamanasāṃ ca, dhātūnāṃ
                            prakṛtisthatvaṃ ceti vigatonmādasya lakṣaṇamiti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne unmā- dapratiṣedho nāma
                            ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 6||
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca||2||
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||3||

smṛterapāyo-vināśaḥ, apasmāra ucyate| sa ca-smṛtivināśo,
                            buddhyādivināśāccitte cintādyabhihate,
                            tathonmādavaccittadehagatairdoṣaiḥ prakṛpitaiḥ sattve hate, hṛdaye
                            vyāpte, tathā saṃjñāvāhiṣu srotaḥsu vyāpteṣu satsu, jāyate| tasmiṃśca
                            jāte sati mūḍhamatiḥ san tamo-mohaṃ, viśan bībhatsāḥ-ninditāḥ,
                            kriyāḥkurute| na tu tamo dravyaviśeṣa iha gṛhyate, tasya
                            divā+asambhavasyāpi darśanaṃ sambhāvyata eva, rogasvabhāvāt| ata eva
                            vakṣyati,-"paśyannasanti rūpāṇi" iti| tā eva kriyā vakti-dantānityādi
                            yāvadvijihvākṣibhruva iti| vijihyamakṣibhruvaṃ yasya sa evam|
                            akṣibhruvaśabdo+acaturādinipātaḥ| doṣavege cātikrānte
                            vibudhyate-prakṛtiṃ yāti| kālāntaraiṇa saḥ-apasmarīm evameva-pūrvavat,
                            karoti|
pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam||8||

asminnapasmāra udbubhūṣati sati hṛtkampādayaḥ syuḥ| gānādi syāt,
                            tailamadyayoḥ pānaṃ syāt, tathā tayoreva-taila madyayoḥ,
                            mehanaṃ-mūtraṇaṃ, syāt|
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan||9||
tatra-teṣu madhyāt, vātādapasmāre sati sphuratsakathyādikaḥ syāt|
apasmarati pittena muhuḥ saṃjñā ca vindati||12||

pittenāpasmāre sati punaḥpunaḥ saṃjñāṃ-cetanāṃ ca labhate|
                            pītaphenākṣimukhatvaṃ syāt| atra ca vaktragrahaṇenaivākṣigrahaṇe
                            siddhe+akṣigrahaṇamatiśayārtham| tathā+a+asphālayati medinīmityādi ca
                            syāt|

kaphāccireṇa kālena grahaṇam| cireṇaiva vimokṣaṇaṃ syāt| śceṣṭā+alpetyādi
                            ca|

atha-evamapasmārasvarūpamavagamya, dhīcittahṛdayasrotasāṃ pūrvaṃ
                            prabodhanaṃ kuryāt| kaiḥ ? vamanādibhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ|

vātikamapasmāraṃ bastiprāyairupācaret| paittaṃ virecanaprāyairupācaret|
                            ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyairupācaret|

sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭācca viśuddhasya, tathā samyagāśvāsitasya
                            ca-kṛtapeyādyannasaṃsargikasya ca samyagāśvāsanaṃ sampadyate|
                            tasyāpasmāriṇaḥ, apasmāraviśodhanāya vakṣyamāṇānimān yogānākarṇaya|
prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcaganyamidaṃ mahat||23||

dvipañcamūlādīni pṛthag dvipalapramāṇāni jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite
                            kvāthe bhārgyādibhiḥ karṣāśaiḥ kalkīkṛtairghṛtasya prasthaṃ tadvat
                            pūrvaiḥ-gomayasvarasādibhirdravaiḥ, pācayet| mahadidaṃ pañcagavyaṃ paraṃ
                            jvarādiharam, śophādighnaṃ ca| bahudravyayogāccāsya mahattvam, yathā
                            mahākalyāṇakādeḥ|

tailaprasthaṃ ghrutaprasthaṃ jīvaniyaiḥ rajīkṛtaiḥ palapramāṇaiḥ
                            kṣīradroṇe pacet| tatsiddhamapasmāravimocanam|

kṣīrekṣurasayoḥ kaṃse-āḍhake, tathā
                            kāśmaryarase+aṣṭaguṇe-aṣṭaprasthaparimāṇe, ghṛtādasyāṣṭaguṇatvam|
                            jīvaniyaiḥkārṣikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tat vātapittajamapasmāraṃ
                            śīghrameva nihanti| nanu, dvandvajasyāpasmārasyāsambhavāt kathamuktaṃ
                            vātapittodbhavaṃ hantīti? ucyate|
                            vātapittotthayordvayorapyapasmārayorhantītyetadihokta mityadoṣaḥ|

kūṣmāṇḍasvarase+aṣṭādaśaguṇe madhuyaṣṭikākalkaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ
                            pakvamapasmārajit budhdyādipradaṃ ca|
kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvane paramaṃ hitam||29||

kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nasye suṣṭru hitam, na kṛṣṇānām gavām,
                            acintyatvātprabhāvasya| śvādīnāmapi pittaṃ hitam|
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca śasyate||31||
godhādīnāṃ ca pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca śasyate|
bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayedbhiṣak||32||

triphalādibhiḥ kalkitaiśchāgamūtre caturguṇe sādhitaṃ tailaṃ
                            nasyamunmādāpasmāriṇorhitam| cūrṇaṃ triphalādervā vaidyo nāsāyā madhye
                            dhmāpayet|

tathā tailalaśunaṃ śīlayet| kṣīreṇa vā śatāvarīmadyāt| brāhmīrasaṃ vā
                            kuṣṭharasaṃ madhunā samabhyaset, vacāṃ vā|

yat-yasmāt, apasmāro yugāpatprakopitaiḥ śārīramānasairdoṣairjāyate,
                            yataścaiṣa mahāmarmāśrayaḥ, tata enaṃ-apasmāraṃ, duścikitsyaṃ
                            rasāyanairupācaret| apasmārārtaṃ cāgnijalāderviṣamāt sada pālayet|

manovikāreṇa ca muktaṃ santaṃ tvamitthaṃ kṛtavāniti na brūyāt| asya ca
                            manaḥ kliṣṭamiṣṭairviṣayairupabṛṃhayediti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne+apasmāra- pratiṣedho nāma
                            saptamo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 7||

apasmārādanantaraṃ śālākyamupakramyate| yathaiva
                                hṛdayākhyamahāmarmāśritairapasmāro janyate tathaiva
                                murdhākhyamahāmarmāśritairūrdhvajatrūtthā rogā janyante| teṣāmapi ca
                                madhye cakṣūrogāṇāṃ sa0-vartmani rogā
                                vartmarogāḥ,-kṛcchronmīlādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānaṃ-bodhaḥ, sa vidyate
                                yasminniti chaḥ, tasya pūrvavalluk|
vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvamakṣi vā||2||

sarvaroganidāne uktāni-abhihitāni yathāyogaṃ tiktoṣaṇādīni,
                            tairāhāravihāraiḥ prakupita malā rogān kuryuḥ|
                            viśeṣādacakṣuṣyairāhāravihāraiḥ kupitā malāḥ prāyo-bāhulyena,
                            pittānusāriṇastathā śirādibhiḥ karaṇabhūtābhirūrdhvaṃ jatruṇaḥ
                            prasṛtāstathā netrasya sambandhinamavayavaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ vartmādikaṃ,
                            āśritāḥ| vartmetyādi| vāśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yujyate, vartma vā sandhiṃ vā
                            sitaṃ vā+asitaṃ vā dṛṣṭiṃ vā sakalaṃ locanamāśritāḥ| iti sāmānyena
                            nayanarogāṇāṃ samprāptiḥ|
vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat||4||

tatra-teṣu vartmādyāśriteṣu madhye, vartmāśrayāḥ sirā vāyuḥ prāpya
                            suptotthitasya narasya vartmastambhaṃ kurute, rujayā saha| tathā
                            paṃśupūrṇābhanayanatvaṃ kṛcchreṇonmīlanamaśru ca kurute|
                            vimardanāt-malanācca, śamaḥ syāt| taṃ-īdṛksvarūpaṃ, kṛcchronmīlākhyaṃ
                            netrerogaṃ vadanti|

vāyurvatmanī cālayan nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ punaḥ punaḥ karoti| asau
                            nimeṣākhyo rogo jñeyaḥ|
vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vātahataṃ hi tat||6||

yatpunarvartma vimuktasandhi tathā niśceṣṭaṃ hīnam ca nimīlyate taṃ
                            vātahatākhyaṃ rogaṃ vadanti, 'munayaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

pittena kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ piṭikā bahvyo vartmanormadhye kumbhīkabījatulyāstathā
                            bhinnāḥ satyaḥ punaradhmāyante, tāḥ kumbhīsaṃjñāḥ|

pittena sadāhakledanistodaṃ tathā raktākāraṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ vartma
                            jāyate, tat pittotkliṣṭamuśanti-kathayanti|
karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitam||8||
pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam||9||

pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitaṃ kaṇḍūm dāhaṃ ca karoti| anupaścāt, pakṣmāṇāṃ
                            śātaṃ karoti| taṃ pakṣmaśātaṃ varṇayanti|
pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapabhā ghanāḥ kaphāt||9||

kaphāt piṭikāḥ sitāḥ sarṣapopamā ghanāḥ-nibiḍāḥ, śophādiyutāḥ
                            pothakīsaṃjñāḥ|
stambhādiyutaṃ vartma yad bhavet tatkaphotkliṣṭaṃ nāma|

kaphāt yo granthiḥ kolamātraḥ, athavā tataḥ-tasmāt kolātkiñcidalpaḥ,
                            pāṇḍuḥ pīḍāpākarahitaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaśca syāt, sa lagaṇākhyaḥ|

tathā-utsaṅgavat, utkliṣṭākhyaṃ vartma| tacca na piṭikārupam, kiṃ tarhi ?
                            rājiyutaṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ ca syāt|
raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate||13||

adhikamāṃsaṃ ca vartmābhyantarasthitamarśo nāma raktena syāt| raktaṃ
                            varṇataḥ, tathā stabdhatādiguṇaṃ syāt| tathā tatsrāvitadraktaṃ
                            sravatyabhīkṣṇam| tat punaḥpunaschinnamapi vardhate|
madhye vā vartmano+ante vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā||14||

asṛjā tāmrā piṭikā mudgapramāṇā vartmano madhye+ante vā kaṇḍvādimatī
                            sthirā cāñjananāmikā syāt|

doṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, bahiḥ śūnaṃ yadvartma sūkṣmaiḥ khaiḥchidraiḥ,
                            antarācitaṃ sasrāvaṃ ca tad bisavartma,
                            udakāntaḥsthitasacchidrabisatulyatvāt|

yadvartma raktotkleśāddoṣatrayotkleśācca utkliṣṭaṃ-utkleśitaṃ sat,
                            akasmāt-hetuṃ vinaiva, mlānimiyāt-śuṣkatvaṃ yāyāt, tadutkliṣṭavartma
                            syāt|

raktasahitaistrimalairyadvartma śyāvaṃ rujā kledena śophena ca yuktaṃ
                            bhavati, tacchyāvavartma|
śliṣṭe-ekatra saṃlagne, vartmanī kaṇḍvādiyute śliṣṭavartma nāma|

vartmano madhye vālikātulyāḥ piṭikāḥ kharasparśāstathā rūkṣāḥ, tat
                            sikatāṃvartma|

bahalaiḥ-ghanaiḥ, māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiḥ samaiḥ-na viṣamaiḥ, cīyate tadbahalaṃ
                            nāma|

kukūṇakaḥ śiśoreva-na mahato, jayate| yato+asau dantotpattihetuko
                            bhavati| tena-kukūṇakena, bāla ucchūnatāmranayano vīkṣaṇākṣamastathā
                            vartmaśūlādimān karṇādimardanaśca syāt|

pakṣmoparodhe vartmanāṃ saṅkoco bhavati| tathā kharatvamantarmukhatvaṃ ca
                            romṇām, anyāni va romāṇi jāyante| taiścakharāntarmukhaiḥ, apūrvairvā
                            rogasvabhāvāttīkṣṇāgraiḥ kaṇṭakairiva ghṛṣṭamakṣiśūyate| uṣyate
                            ca-sāntardāhastīvroṣmā syādityarthaḥ| tathā pavanādidviṭ,
                            ādiśabdenānalātapau gṛhyete| stokānyahānyuddhṛtaiḥ-utpāṭitaistaistaiḥ,
                            śāntirbhavati|

kanīnake vartmanorbāhyataḥ kaṭhina unnato granthiralajītyucyate| kimbhūto
                            granthiḥ ? tāmraḥ pakvaścāsrasrāvī pūyasrāvī ca| tathā muhurmuhuḥ srutaḥ
                            sannādhmāyate|

vartmano+antare māṃsapiṇḍākṛtiḥ śvayathuḥ saraktaistribhirdoṣairarbudaḥ
                            syāt| kimbhūtaḥ śvayathuḥ ? grathito nīrujaḥ| sa ca bāhyataścalo
                            viṣamaśca syāt|
iti-anena prakāreṇa, caturviṃśatisaṅhkhyā vartmāśrayā rogāḥ syuḥ|
ādyo+atra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato+arśaśca varjayet||25||

[ atra-] eṣu madhyāt, ādyaḥ-kṛcchronmīlanākhyo, bheṣajaiḥ sādhyaḥ|
                            tataḥ-anantaraṃ, dbau-nimeṣavātahatau arśaśca varjayet| pakṣmoparodho
                            yāpanīyaḥ| śeṣān-ekonaviṃśatiṃ, śastreṇopacaret|

teṣvapi-śastrasādhyeṣu madhye, pakṣmasadanaṃ kuṭṭayet sūcīkūrcena|
                            arbudaṃ ca chindyādvṛddhipatrādinā| lagaṇādīni vrīhimukhādinā bhindyāt|
                            pothakyādayaḥ kukūṇakāntā ekādaśa vilekhyāḥ|
                            utkliṣṭacatuṣṭayaṃ-pittotkliṣṭaṃ kaphotkliṣṭaṃ
                            raktotkliṣṭamutkliṣṭavartmaceti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartmaroga- vijñānīyo
                            nāmāṣṭamo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 8||

kṛcchronmīle vartmaroge purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ drākṣākalkāmbupakvaṃ samaśarkaraṃ
                            yojayet| snigdhaṃ ca nasyādikam|

kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ vṛddhipatrādinā saindhavalavaṇena pratisāritaṃ
                            sat madhuyaṣṭikādikvāthena pariṣecayet|
na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatastataḥ||4||

nivāte sthāne āptairadhiṣṭhitasya-kṛtāśrayasya, tathā
                            śuddhasya-vamanavirecanādinā, uttānaṃ nityaṃ śete tasya vartma vāsasā
                            koṣṇāmbunā taptena sveditaṃ sannirbhujya-kuṭilīkṛtya, vastrāntaritaṃ
                            vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhyāṃ dhṛtamevaṃ na sraṃsate| na vā calati sarvataḥ|
                            anantaraṃ tadvartma tiryaṅ maṇḍalāgreṇa śastrapadāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva
                            śastreṇa śākādipatrairvā samudraphenena vā likhet| kiṃ kurvan ?
                            picunā-karpaṭādiyojitena, raktaṃ pramṛjan| rakte sthite-avahati,
                            sulikhitaṃ tadvartma jñātvā sakṣaudrairyathāsvaṃ kathitaiḥ
                            saindhavādibhiḥ pratisārayet| paścāccoṣṇena vāriṇā prakṣālya sarpiṣā
                            siktamanantaramabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayoryavasaktubhiḥ
                            piṇḍīṃ ca dattvā+avabadhnīyāt| dvitīye divase muktasya vartmano
                            yathāsvaṃ pariṣekaṃ kuryāt| caturthe divase nasyādīn kuryāt| pañcame
                            divase muñcedeva-nānyatkiñcitkuryāt|

samaṃ nakhasadṛśaṃ śophādyapīḍitaṃ sulikhitaṃ vartma jānīyāt|
                            viparyaye-asmāllakṣaṇādvaiparītye sati, tadvartma punarlikhet|

atilekhanādrujādīni syuḥ| tasmin-atilekhane, snehasvedādiko vātaghno
                            vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam||13||

śvetarodhraṃ navanītenābhyajya eraṇḍamūlakalkena pralepayet| anantaraṃ
                            puṭapāke pacet| svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ sat
                            yuvatīkṣīreṇa chagalyā vā kṣīreṇa marditaṃ netre secanaṃ hitam|

atilikhite vartmani navanītenāktaṃ śvetarodhraṃ śālitandulakalkena liptaṃ
                            baddhaṃ pariṣkṛtaṃ-pūrvavatparikalpitaṃ puṭapākīkṛtaṃ svinnaṃ
                            prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ cetyarthaḥ, tat dadhimastunā
                            mṛditaṃ sekaṃ kuryāt| dadhigrahaṇaṃ takramastvādinivṛttyai| athavā
                            kevalena-kalkarodhrarahitena, mastunā jāṅgalamāṃsāśino narasya sekaṃ
                            kuryāt| apiḥ svedanādisamudāyavikalpārthaḥ|

kaṭhinonnatāḥ piṭikāḥ vrīhivakreṇa bhittvā+anu niṣpīḍayet| pariśeṣo
                            vidhiḥ-pralepanakṣālanabandhanasecanādiḥ, pūrvavatkāryaḥ|
lekhane bhedane cāyaṃ kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani||16||
lekhane bhedane ca eṣa eva kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani kāryaḥ|
likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam||17||

pittotkliṣṭe raktotkliṣṭe ca madhuraskandhaśṛtena ghṛtena snigdhasya
                            puṃsaḥ sirāvimokṣaḥ kāryaḥ| tathā trivṛtātriphale virecanam| likhite
                            vartmani srutalohite ca sati madhuyaṣṭikākvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| kṣīraṃ
                            candanasādhitaṃ tu seko hitaḥ|

pakṣmaṇāṃ sadane sati romakūpān-romamūlāni, sucyā vikuṭṭayet|
                            jalaukobhirvā grāhayet| kṣīreṇekṣurasena vā vamanaṃ hitam|
                            madhuraśītalaiḥ-drākṣādibhiḥ, pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|

puṣpakāsīsaṃ cūrṇayitvā tāmrapātre daśāhaṃ surasārasaiḥ-samūrvārasaiḥ,
                            bhāvayet| tat-etat, pakṣmaśāte śreṣṭhamañjanam

pothakīrlikhitā vṛddhipatrādibhiḥ, śuṇṭhīsaindhavābhyāṃ pratisāritāḥ,
                            tathoṣṇāmbunā kṣālitāḥ, jalakvathitaiḥ khadirādibhiḥ siñcet|
                            dviniśādibhirvā jalakvathitaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ siñcet|

kaphotkliṣṭe vartmani śastreṇa vilikhite saindhavādibhiḥ
                            sūkṣmarajīkṛtairmākṣikasahitaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| tathā vamanādi
                            hitam| sarvaṃ ca yatkaphajit tacca hitam|
lagaṇe+apīdaṃ kāryam| evamapyaśame sati jvalanena dahet|

kukūṇe khadirādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ dhātrī-stanadāyinī, pītvā
                            kṛṣṇādibhirvamet|
mustādikalkena kucāvālepayet| sājyaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ stanau dhūpayet|
śuddhāṃ ca-vamanavirecanādinā, paṭolādikaṃ kvāthaṃ tāṃ pāyayet|

śiśoḥ punarvartma likhitaṃ jalaukābhirvā srutaraktaṃ
                            dhātryādipatrakvāthena secayet|

prāyo-bāhulyena, kṣīraghṛtabhojanatvācchiśūnāṃ kaphajā rogāḥ syuḥ|
                            tasmādvamanameva pūrvaṃ teṣāṃ sarvavyādhiṣu pūjitam|
kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnamannaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ||30||

sindhūtthetyādi vamanaṃ dadyāt, vacācūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro vā, madanaphalaṃ
                            madhuyaṣṭīyuktaṃ vā| kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnaṃ tathā+annaṃ bhajataḥ
                            śiśoryathākramaṃ vamanatrayametat yojyam| vamanaṃ sarveṣvevāmayeṣu śiśoḥ
                            śreṣṭham| viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake hitam|
saptalārasena vā siddhaṃ ghṛtamūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ hitam|

kukūṇake dviharidrādibhistāmracūrṇayuktairjalapiṣṭairvartirhitā|
                            kṣīrādiyuktaṃ dagdhaṃ lohotthaṃ vā cūrṇaṃ hitam| kecittu
                            samudraphenacūrṇaṃ dagdhaṃ dugdhamākṣikayuktamityāhuḥ|
utsṛjya dvau bhruvo+adhastādbhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ||35||
badhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam||37||

pakṣmarodhe romasu prakarṣeṇa vṛddheṣu śuddhaśarīrasya narasya
                            bhravo+adhastādvou bhāgāvutsṛjya-vihāya, pakṣmato bhāgaṃ hitvā
                            yavamātraṃ-yavasaṃsthānaṃ, tiryak chittvā klinnavastreṇa raktamapanayet|
                            rakte cālpībhavati sati vakrayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ sīvyet|
                            tato lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ badhvā tatra ca paṭṭe sīvanasūtrakaṃ nātigāḍhaślathaṃ
                            sūcyā vinikṣipet| anantaraṃ mākṣīkaghṛtakavalikāṃ yojayet| na cātra
                            bandhaṃ kuryāt| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ nyagrodhādi kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrayutaiḥ secayet|
                            pañchame divase sūtramapanīya vraṇaṃ gairikeṇāvacūrṇayet| tīkṣṇaṃ ca
                            nasyādi yuñjyāt|

evamapyaśāntau vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīṃ nirbhujya dahet| adhikaṃ pakṣma
                            saṃdaṃśena hṛtvā tasya pakṣmaṇa āśrayaṃ dahet| kena ?
                            sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena| bāhyālajestu bhinnasya dāhaḥ kāryaḥ| alajīśabdaḥ
                            puṃsyapi dṛṣṭaḥ| arbudasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ suṣṭu cchinnasya dāhaḥ kārya
                            iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya-
                            ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarakhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartma-
                            rogapratiṣedho nāma navamo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 9||

vartmarogapratiṣedhādanantaraṃ sthānānupūrvyā
                                sandhisitāsitarogavijñānamārabhyate- saṃ-sandhī ca sitāsitau ca
                                sandhisitāsitāḥ, teṣu rogāḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

pavanaḥ kupito jalavāhinīḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalākṛti aśru srāvayate| kutaḥ ?
                            vartmaśuklasandhe kanīnakāt| tena-jalābhasrāveṇa, nayanaṃ saruk sarāgaṃ
                            saśophaṃ ca syāt| sa ca jalāsravākhyo rogaḥ|
kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet||2||
kaphāt kaphāsrave sati śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ ca sravet|
śleṣmaṇā śophastīkṣṇāgrādiguṇaḥ| sa upanāhākhyo nīrujaḥ syāt|
raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet||4||

raktena raktāsravo bhavati| tasmiṃśca tāmravarṇamuṣṇaṃ cāśru
                            saṃsravet|
tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī||5||

vartmasandhirāśrayo yasyāḥ sā vartmasandhyāśrayā, śukle piṭikā
                            śūladāhavatī tāmravarṇā mudgasadṛśī parvaṇī bhaṇyate| sā ca bhinnā satī
                            raktaṃ sravati| eṣā ca raktasamutthaiva vedyā, raktāsravādanantaramasyāḥ
                            pāṭhāt raktasrāvitvācca|

pūyāsravākhye doṣā raktasahitā vartmasandheḥ kanīnakāt punaḥ punaḥ pūyaṃ
                            sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākāddhetoḥ srāvayanti|

pūyālaso vraṇa ucyate| kīdṛk ? sūkṣmaḥ tathā śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ|
                            kvāsau syāt ? kanīnasandhau| tathā+a+adhmāyīānāhavān, pūyāsrāvī saruk ca
                            syāt|

apāṅge kanīne vā kaṇḍvādimāṃstathā pūyāsrāvī granthireva
                            kṛmiyukto+artimān kṛmigranthirucyate|

upanāhādīṃścturaḥ śastreṇa sādhayet| āsravān-jalāsravādīṃścaturaḥ, alajīṃ
                            ceti pañca tyajet|

site netradeśe pittaṃ kartṛ bindūn kṛṣṇaśyāvapītān kuryāt|
                            malalepadigdhadarpaṇasamānaṃ vā sarvam śuklam| evamubhayaprakāro+apyayaṃ
                            sadāharuk śuktikasaṃjño rogaḥ, śakṛdbhedena tṛṣā jvareṇa ca yuktaḥ|

kaphācchuklabhāge samaṃ-na tu viṣamam, tathā śvetavarṇamadhimāṃsakaṃ
                            ciravṛddhi, tat śuklārma|

śophastu nīrujaḥ samānavarṇo bahalādistathā jalabindusamo balāsagrathitaṃ
                            smṛtam|
aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpā taḥ sa śoṇitāt||14||

raktarājītataṃ śuklaṃ-śuklabhāgaṃ, uṣyate| yatsavedanaṃ
                            śophāśrūpaleparahitaṃ sa śoṇitāt sirotpātaḥ|

sirotpāto+acikitsitastā eva-raktā eva, rājīrvardhayan sirāharṣaṃ sāsraṃ
                            kuryāt| tena-sirāharṣeṇa, locanaṃ vīkṣaṇākṣamaṃ syāt|

sirājāle bṛhattathā raktaṃ ghanamunnataṃ ca yad bhavati, tatsirājālaṃ
                            nāma|
samaṃ-natu viṣamaṃ, tathā ślakṣṇaṃ yadadhimāṃsakaṃ tacchoṇitārma|

māṃsaṃ prastāritaṃ tathā mṛdu tathā āśuvṛddhi tathā nīruk śyāvalohitaṃ
                            prastāryarmetyucyate| tacca tribhirdoṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ syāt|

śuṣkaraktapiṇḍavacchyāvaṃ yanmāṃsaṃ tathā bahalaṃ pṛthu ca syāt,
                            tadadhimāṃsārma bhaṇyate|

piṭikā dāhādimatyastathā sirācitāḥ kṛṣṇabhāgāsannāḥ sarṣapasaṃsthānāḥ
                            sirāsaṃjñāḥ|

śuktyādīn ṣaḍauṣadhaiḥ sādhayet| śeṣān sapta śastreṇa sādhayet|
                            navotthitānetānapi bheṣajairupakramet na kevalaṃ pūrvoktaṃ
                            ṣaṭkamityarthaḥ|

yacca pañcaprakāramarmoktaṃ-śuklārma śoṇitārma prastāryarma
                            snāvārmādhimāṃsārma, etacchedanārham| yat kṛṣṇabhāgaprāptaṃ
                            māṃsasnāvasirāvṛtaṃ carmoddālavaducchrāyi tadvarjayet-na cikitset| yacca
                            dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ tadapi varjayet|

pittaṃ kartṛ kṛṣṇabhāge dṛṣṭau vā śukraṃ janayati| kimbhūtam ?
                            todāśrurāgayuktam| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tvacaṃ-prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ chittvā, tena
                            kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ pakvajambūsadṛśaṃ nimraṃ ca kṣataśukrakaṃ syāt| tacca
                            kṛcchrasādhyam| dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāttu yāpyaṃ syāt|
                            tatra-dvītīyapaṭalavyadhe, todādīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ tathā
                            sūcīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatvaṃ ca| todādibhūyastvena
                            sevanīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatayā ca dvitīyapaṭalavyadho+anumīyata
                            ityarthaḥ| tṛtīyapaṭalacchedāt vraṇairnicitamasādhyaṃ kṣataśukrakam|
                            evaṃ kṣataśukrakaṃ tridhā+abhidhāya śuddhaśukramācaṣṭe|
śaṅkhavacchuklaṃ śuddhaśukrakam| tacca kaphājjāyate| na cātivedanam|

ātāmraṃ-īṣattāmravarṇaṃ, picchilaṃ cāsraṃ sravati yā+asau
                            ātāmrapicchilāsrasrut| tathā ātāmrapiṭikā tathā+atipīḍāvatī
                            tathā+ajāviṭsadṛśe ucchrāyakārṣṇye yasyāḥ saivam| ajakākhyā raktena
                            syāt| sā ca varjyā+asādhyatvāt|

saraktairmalaiḥ sirāśukraṃ syāt| tena sirāśukreṇa juṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ
                            sirābhiravatanyate| kimbhūtābhiḥ ? satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ|
                            animittaṃ-akasmāt, asmin kadāciduṣṇamacchaṃ ghanaṃ vā+asraṃ sravati|
                            tacca tyajedasādhyatvāt|

doṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ sakṛt-ekahelayaiva, kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ śuklarūpatāṃ nīyate|
                            kimbhūtam ? dhavalābhropaliptābham| tathā niṣpāvārdhadalasyevākṛtiryasya
                            tadevam| tathā tīvravedanārāgadāhaśvayathubhiḥ pīḍitam| tacca śukraṃ
                            pākātyayena tīvrarujaṃ varjayet-nopakramet|
yasya vā liṅganāśo+antaḥ śyāvaṃ yadvā salohitam||30||
purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam||31||

tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne
                                sandhisitāsitarogavijñhānīyo nāma daśamo+adhyāyaḥ||10||

yasya ca śukrasya liṅganāśaḥ-antardṛṣṭivināśa ityarthaḥ, yacca
                            śyāvamantaḥ, yacca kiñcillohitam, tathā+atyunnatamavagāḍhaṃ vā,
                            sāśrunāḍīvraṇāvṛtaṃ vā, tathā purāṇaṃ-vatsarātītam tathā
                            viṣamasaṃsthānam, tathā madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakaṃ, tatsarvaṃ
                            varjayet| sa0-kṛṣṇamaṇḍale iti-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, pañca rogāḥ
                            sādhyāsādhyavibhāgenoktāḥ| sukhagrahaṇadhāraṇārthaṃ saṅkhyopādānamiti|
                            iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅga-
                            hṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne
                            sandhisitāsiratogavijñānīyo nāma daśamo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 10||

sa0-pratiṣidhyate nirākriyate cikitsyata iti pratiṣedhaḥ,-cikitsā|
                                śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca||1||

vaidyo maṇḍalāgreṇopanāhaṃ sandhirogaṃ lekhayet| kimbhūtam ? svinnaṃ
                            vartmarogapratiṣedhoktena prakāreṇa poṭalikayoṣṇodakaplutayeti| tathā
                            vrīhimukhena bhinnam| tataḥ pippalyādibhiḥ pratisārayet| [ tataḥ-]
                            anantaraṃ, pūrvavat-prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā ghṛtena siktamabhyaktaṃ
                            madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayośca yavasaktubhiḥ piṇḍīṃ dattvā,
                            badhnīyāditi| tathā paṭolapatrāmalakakvāthena cāścyotayet|

parvaṇī bāhyasandhitribhāge baḍiśena gṛhītā satī vṛddhi patreṇa
                            vardhyā-chedanīyā| kutra bhāge vardhyā ? ityāha-ardhe|
                            ato+anyathā-adhikacchedanāt, aśrugatiḥ syāt| cikitsā ceyamarmavat| tatra
                            caivamuktam (ślo. 20)-"samyak chinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam|
                            uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktamabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā|| badhnīyātsecayenmuktvā
                            tṛtīyādidineṣu ca| karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa' iti|

pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet| anantaramupanāhayet| akṣipākoktaṃ cāśeṣaṃ karma
                            yathāvidhi kurvīta|

saindhavādibhiścūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta| saindhavādibhireva mākṣikayutai
                            rasakriyāṃ vā|
kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca||6||

kṛmigranthi tripalādibhiḥ pratisārayet| kimbhūtam ? karīṣeṇa-gomayādinā
                            svinnam, tathā vrīhimukhādibhirbhittvā vilikhya ca|

balāsagrathitaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca sirāvyadhaṃ varjayitvā
                            kaphābhiṣyandavadupācaret| tathā bījapūrakarasenāktaṃ
                            vyoṣakaṭphalamañjanaṃ|
madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha||12||

sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikamañjanaṃ hitam| sirāharṣe mākṣikeṇa
                            ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam| arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudreṇāścyotanaṃ hitam|
                            spāṭikādi mākṣikeṇāñjanamathavā sauvīrāñjanaṃ madhunā hitam| śaṅkho vā
                            samudrapheno vā śarkarayā saha hitaḥ|
armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat||13||

arma pañcaprakāramuktam| teṣu madhye yattanu dhūmavadāvilaṃ ca, tathā
                            raktaṃ-raktavarṇaṃ, dadhisadṛśaṃ ca yat, tasyārmaṇaḥ
                            śukrasadṛśamauṣadham|
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ||17||

uttānasya puṃso vāmadakṣiṇayoritarat-ekamakṣi, svinnaṃkṛtasvedaṃ ca,
                            tathā bījapūrarasena saindhavānvitenāñjitaṃ nimīlyasthagayitvā,
                            vimardayet-malayet| anena prakāreṇa saṃroṣitākṣasyasato+armādhimāṃse
                            pracale sati mūrdhni niścalaṃ ghṛtasya vartmanośca viśeṣeṇa ghṛtasya
                            kanīnakādarmaṇi vṛddhe satyapāṅgaṃ paśyato yatra valī syāt tatrārma
                            baḍiśenāvalambitaṃ nātyāyataṃ-nātidīrghaṃ yathābhavatitathā+avalambitam|
                            tataḥ-anantaraṃ, mucuṇḍyā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā mocayet| atha mokṣitaṃ ca
                            viccheditaṃ ca sat kanīnakamupānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitaṃ maṇḍalāgrena
                            chindyāt| vyavahitānāmapi padānāmarthayogyatāvaśādeva sambandho+atra
                            yojyaḥ| kanīnakaṃ rakṣet| kanīnakavyadhādaśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate|
                            apāṅgapradeśāccārmaṇi vṛddhe tathā kanīnakaṃ vīkṣamāṇasya chindyāt|

samyak chinnaṃ madhvādibhiḥ pratisāritaṃ ghṛtenoṣṇena siktaṃ
                            mākṣikasarpiṣā+abhyaktaṃ badhnīyāt| tṛtīyādidineṣu ca muktvā kṣīreṇa
                            karañjabījasiddhena secayet| dviharidrādibhiśca kvathitaiḥ śītaiśca
                            madhuyutaiḥ sekaṃ kuryāt| saptame dine muñcedeva|

samyak chinne+armaṇi svāsthyaṃ bhavet| hīnāticchedajān rogān
                            sekāñjanādyairyathāyogaṃ lekhanairbṛṃhaṇaiśca jayet|
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā||27||

triphalāyā ekatamasya harītakyāderdravyasya tvacaṃ pānīyakalkitāṃ
                            śarāvapihitāṃ kapāle dagdhvā cūrṇayet| tata eva triphalāyāḥ pṛthak
                            śeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthageva caikaikaṃ bhāvitā sā maṣī śoṣitā punaḥ peṣyā
                            lavaṇadvayayutā| trīṇyetānyañjanāni paraṃ lekhanāni timiraghnāni
                            nimirvakti|

sirājāle yāḥ sirā kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhairna sidhyanti tāsāmarmavat
                            cikitsā, piṭikānāṃ ca|

śukreṣu doṣavaśāt kadācit rūkṣā kadācit snigdhā triphalā hitā| tathā
                            ghṛtaṃ tiktamūrdhvamasṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate|

trivṛtkvāthena trīn vārān ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ kṣataśukre pibet| paścātsirayā
                            raktaṃ haret| nayanādvā jalaukobhirharet| tathā+a+ajadugdhenotpalādibhiḥ
                            siddhena saśarkareṇa secanaṃ hitam| athavotpalādikvathitena jalena
                            secayet| rāgāśruvedanāśāntau satyāṃ lekhanamañjanaṃ hitam|

jātimukulādibhirvartayaḥ pittāsraṃ prasādayanti| kṣataśukraṃ ca
                            ghnanti|

gajādyudbhavairdantaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāphenayutaiścuturthāṃśakamaricaiḥ
                            kṣataśukrakamapi vyāpi dantavartiriyaṃ nivartayet|
                            apiśabdācchuddhaśukrakamapi| sa0-tamālapatrādibhirvartirgomūtreṇa
                            sarvaśukrakahṛt| sa0-ratnani-mauktikādīni, dantāḥ-gajādīnām, śṛṅgāṇi
                            chāgādīnām, dhātavo-gairikādyāḥ, tryūṣaṇādīni, tathā vraṇasādi
                            bheṣajaṃ-svarṇakṣīryādi, etadañjanaṃ
                            savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraharam| sa0-nimnaṃ śukrakaṃ
                            snehapānādibhirunnamayet| sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ ca
                            tarpaṇapuṭapākenonnamayet|

śuddhaśukre haridrādikvāthena secanaṃ hitam| athavā rodhrapoṭālyā
                            koṣṇāmbumagnayā|

bṛhatīcūrṇādibhirāmalakajalena piṣṭaistāmrabhājanaṃ lepitaṃ
                            yavādibhirdhūpayet| anantaraṃ tatra guṭikāstoyamākṣikapiṣṭāḥ kuryāt|
                            etāśca mahānīlā iti prathitāḥ paraṃ śuddhaśukraghnāḥ|

sthire śukre ghane cāturasyāsya bahuśo raktaṃ mokṣayet| śirovirekādīn
                            puṭapākāṃśca punaḥpunaḥ kuryāt|

imau ślokārdhauktau yogau gha(ha)rṣaṇāya kuryāt|
                            śaṅkhādibhirmākṣikāntaireko yogaḥ, surādibhiḥ kusumāntairanyaḥ|

dhātryādirase kṣāro lāṅgalikaja uṣitaḥ śoṣitaścūrṇaḥ
                            śukraharṣaṇamañjanam|

śaṅkhamadhuyutā mudgā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭā athavā+añjanam| madhūkātsāro
                            madhuyuto+añjanam| athavā bibhītakānmajjā mākṣikānvitā| saṃ-gavādidantāḥ
                            śaṅkhaḥ samudrapheno vā pārthajalena piṣṭāvartihṛṣṭaśukrahṛt|
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhirlikhet||48||
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālaśākapatrādibhirlikhet|
sirāśukre punaradṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukra iva kāryā|

pāṇḍrādikaṃ chāgadugdhena piṣṭaṃ sasarpiṣkairyavairāmalakapatraiśca
                            paryāyeṇa dhūpitā vartirne(ra)trāñjanaṃ param|

asādhyāyāmajakāyāṃ śukre cānyatra roge tatprakāre+asādhye vedanopaśamaṃ
                            snehapānādibhirvidadhīta| bībhatsatāṃ-nindyatāṃ, jetuṃ
                            śukrasyotsedhasādhanaṃ kuryāt|

nālikerāsthyādijaṃ bhasma adbhiḥ srāvayet| tābhiradbhiḥ karabhāsthijaṃ
                            cūrṇaṃ bhāvayet| taccūrṇamañjanamasādhyeṣu śukreṣu vaivarṇyaharam|
                            śīlitaṃ caitadeva śukrāṇāṃ sādhanāyālaṃ-śreṣṭham|
ajakāṃ pāṛśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam||55||
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca||56||
saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire||56||
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā||57||

ajakāṃ pārśvataḥ sūcyā vidhvā jalaṃ ca niḥsrāvyānantaramaṅguṣṭhena samaṃ
                            vasārdreṇa-vasayā dravīkṛtya, vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena pūrayet| baddhaṃ
                            baddhaṃ vimucya sa saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe sati tathā kṛṣṇabhāge same
                            sthite sati snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyam| kṣīraghṛte ca nasyam| evamapi kṛte
                            punarādhmāne sati bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyāṃ yuktyā kuryāt|
                            yathā+aticchedena dṛṣṭernimajjanaṃ na syāt| sa0-śukreṣu ca nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ
                            yathāyogaṃ pakvaṃ pānādau vidadhyāt| kim ? ityāha-tathā
                            ghṛtapānasecanena labdhabalā dṛgantaḥ pratataṃ prayuktaistīkṣṇāñjanairna
                            hīyate-na hāniṃ yāyāditi| upajātirvṛttam| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitā-
                            sitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 11||

asmādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogavijñānamāha| tatrāpi pūrvaṃ timiraṃ
                                lilakṣayiṣurāha- sa0-[ male- ] doṣe vātādyanyatame, sirānusāriṇi
                                tathā prathamaṃ-bāhyaṃ, paṭalaṃ śrite satyavyaktaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati|
                                vyaktamapi kadācinnimittamantareṇa paśyati| eṣa timirākhyo roga iti
                                vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
bhūtaṃ tu yatnādāsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate||2||

dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ prāpte+abhūtamapi paśyati, na kevalaṃ bhūtam| bhūtaṃ tu
                            yatnena paśyati, taccāsannameva| dūre na ca sūkṣmaṃ paśyati|
                            dūrāntikasthaṃ ca rūpaṃ vaiparītyena manyate,-dūrasthaṃ nikaṭasthaṃ,
                            nikaṭasthaṃ dūrasthamityarthaḥ| doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne dvitīyapaṭalāśrite
                            eva maṇḍalānīvālokate| dṛṣṭimadhyasthe doṣa ekameva vastu dviprakāraṃ
                            paśyati| bahudhāsthite doṣa ekameva vastu bahuprakāraṃ paśyati|
                            dṛṣṭerabhyantarāśrite doṣe hrasvaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca tayorviparyayaḥ|
                            hrasvaṃ ca mahāntaṃ, mahāntaṃ ca hrasvamiti vaiparītyena paśyati|
                            adhaḥsthite doṣe samīpasthaṃ padārthaṃ nekṣate| upariṣṭātsthite doṣe
                            dūragaṃ na paśyati| pārśvasthe doṣe pārśve rūpaṃ na paśyet| ayaṃ sarva
                            eva timirasaṃjño rogaḥ|
yathā varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirhīyeta ca kramāt||7||

tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ sthite doṣe kācatvaṃ prāpnoti| tena kācenordhvamīkṣate na
                            tvadhaḥ| tacca tanuvastracchannasadṛśam| dṛṣṭiścātra doṣānusāreṇa
                            rajyate| yathā vātena śyāvetyādi| krameṇa ca dṛṣtirhīyate|

evamapyupekṣamāṇasyācikitsitasya tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ muktvā caturthapaṭalaṃ
                            gato malo-doṣaḥ, liṅganāśaṃ-dṛṣṭināśaṃ ca, kurvan dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ
                            chādayet|

tatra-timireṣu madhye, pavanena timire sati vyāviddhamiva paśyati| tathā
                            calaṃ dhūmāvilamaruṇābhāsaṃ muhuḥ-punaḥ-prasannaṃ
                            cālokate-prakṛtisthanayanena paśyati, pavanasya calarūpatvāt| tathā
                            jālādīni muhuḥ paśyati| āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, anāsikaṃ-nāsikārahitaṃ, paśyati|
                            tathā candradīpādīnāmanekatvaṃ vakramavakramiva ca manyate| vṛddhaḥ kāco
                            rajodhūmāvṛtāmiva ca dṛṣṭiṃ kuryāt| tathā spaṣṭā+aruṇā+a+abhā yasyāstām|
                            tathā vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā| tathā hatadarśanām| sa evaṃbhūto liṅganāśaḥ|
                            iti vātajāstimirakācaliṅganāśā uktāḥ|

vāte tu dṛksirāḥ saṅkocayati sati dṛṣṭimaṇḍalamantaḥ praviśati| sā
                            gambhīrā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā| 'munibhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|
kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛgeva ca paśyati||14||

pittodbhave timire vidyudādidīpitaṃ tathā mayūratittiripatrābhaṃ prāyeṇa
                            nīlaṃ ca paśyati| kāce kācanīlasadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ syāt|
                            tādṛgeva-kācanīlābhāsaṃ, paśyati| kāce kācanīla sadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ śyāt|
                            tādṛgeva kācanīlābhasaṃ paśyati| tathā+arkendu pariveṣādīn paśyati|
dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hṛsva hrasvadarśinī||15||

liṅganāśād dṛṣṭiśca bhramaranīlā nirālokā snigdhā ca syāt| pittena
                            hrasvasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| sā ca hrasvā-hrasvasaṃsthānā, tathā
                            hrasvadarśinī-alpadarśinī|

pittabidagdhasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ pītavarṇā syāt| tathā pītābhaṃ darśanaṃ yasyāḥ
                            sā pītābadarśanā ca|
kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati||16||
sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syālliṅganāśe tu lakṣyate||18||

kaphena timire sati prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ cālokate| tathā
                            śaṅkhādibhirivācitaṃ paśyati| kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkādibhirivācitaṃ
                            paśyati| dṛk śuklābhā syāt liṅganāśe tu dṛśyate mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ
                            snigdhastathā dṛṣṭivināśanaśca| jalasyeva binduścalaḥ
                            padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ| ātape cāsou binduḥ saṅkucati| chāyāyāṃ prasarati|
                            tathā śaṅkhādiśuklimā syāt|
raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati||20||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭistadṛk ca paśyati||21||

raktena timire sati raktābhaṃ tathā tama iva ca paśyati| kācena raktā
                            kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| tādṛgeva-rakta kṛṣṇaṃ vā, paśyati| liṅganāśe ca
                            tādṛśyeva-kācavat, dṛṣṭistathā niṣprabhā hatadarśanā ca syāt|

saṃsargasannipāteṣu saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān-vyāmiśralakṣaṇān,
                            timirakācaliṅganāśān vidyāt| tathā+akasmāt-nimittamantareṇa,
                            taiḥ-saṃsargasannipātaiḥ, vyaktaṃ-spaṣṭaṃ, kadācidākulamīkṣaṇaṃdarśanaṃ,
                            yasya sa evaṃbhūto narastimire syāt| śeṣayoḥ-kācaliṅganāśayoḥ dṛṣṭau
                            citro rāgaḥ syāt|
dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ||23||
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi||24||

yasyāturasya nakulasyeva dṛṣṭirdoṣairnicitā dyotyate-dedīpyate, sa
                            nakulāndhaḥ| tatra-nakulāndhe, divā citraṃ paśyati, na tu
                            niśi-rajānyām|
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado+aparaḥ||25||

arke+astaparvatasya mastake nyastā gabhastayo yena tasmin sati stambhaṃ
                            prāptā doṣā dṛśaṃ chādayanti| sa evaṃbhūto doṣāndho nāma rogaḥ| divā
                            kathaṃ paśyati ? ityatra yuktimāha- saṃ-malā ahni divākararaśmibhiḥ
                            spṛṣṭāstathā dṛṣṭipathādbhraṣṭā vilīnāḥ santaḥ, atra-rātryandhe, spaṣṭaṃ
                            darśanaṃ dadati| divākarakaraspṛṣṭā iti hetau prathamā|
rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā||28||

uṣṇena taptasya sahasā-jhaṭityeva, śiśirajalanimajjanāt
                            tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkta ūṣmordhvamakṣṇi yāti| tataḥ-ūṣmaṇa ūrdhvagamanāt,
                            akṣṇi dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| śuklabhāgaśca malino bhavati| ahani-dine, āvilaṃ
                            darśanaṃ jāyate, rātrau cāndhyam| sā dṛṣṭiruṣṇavidagdhākhyā|

atyantamamlāśanāt-amlabhakṣaṇāt, doṣaiḥ saraktairyā dṛṣṭirācitā
                            kledakaṇḍūkaluṣānvitā syāt| sā vidagdhāmleti dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ||30||

śokādisantaptasya narasya vātādayo dhūmenevāvilāṃ dhūmadarśanāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ
                            kuryuḥ| sa dhūmaro nāma rogaḥ|

sahasaiva-atarkitasya, puṃso+alpasattvasya rūpamadbhutaṃ paśyato
                            bhāsvaraṃ bhāskaraprakāraṃ paśyato vā vātādayo locanāśritā dṛṣṭiṃ
                            muṣitadarśanāṃ vaiḍūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthāmiva pīḍārahitāṃ
                            kurvanti| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tejaḥ saṃśoṣya| ityeṣa aupasargiko liṅganāśaḥ|
ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaśca yāpyāḥ, śeṣāṃstu sādhayet||33||

atra-eṣu madhye, kaphādvinā
                            liṅganāśān-vātapittasaṃsargasannipātaraktajoupasargikān ṣaṭ, tathā
                            gabhīrāṃ hrasvajāmapidṛṣṭimityaṣṭau varjayet| ṣaṭ
                            kācāḥ-vātapittakaphasaṃsargasannipātaraktajāḥ, nakulāndhaśceti sapta
                            yāpyāḥ| śeṣāṃśca dvādaśa sādhayet, tatra
                            vātapittakapharaktasaṃsargasannipātaiḥ pṛthak timirāṇīti ṣaṭ, saptamaḥ
                            kaphena ca liṅganāśaḥ, aṣṭamaḥ pittavidagdhā dṛṣṭiḥ, navamo doṣāndhaḥ,
                            daśama uṣṇavidagdhā, ekādaśo vidagdhāmlā, dvādaśo dhūmaraḥ, iti| evaṃ
                            dṛṣṭimaṇḍale rogāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyāḥ kathitāḥ| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne dṛṣṭiroga- vijñānīyo nāma
                            dvādaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 12||

sa0-nanu, dṛṣṭirogavijñānādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogapratiṣedho jñāpyaḥ|
                                upapannamāha bhavān| kiṃ tu dṛṣṭitogacikitsitasya bahuvaktavyatvāt
                                pṛthagadhyāyo vaktuṃ yuktaḥ| tatrāpi kramaprāptastimirapratiṣedha
                                iti timirapratiṣedhārambha eva yuktaḥ| kācādīnāṃ
                                tvalpavaktavyatvādatraivābhidhānam| tato bahuvaktavyatvāt
                                pṛthagadhyāyo liṅganāśasya| iti sarvaṃ yuktam|

timiramupekṣayā kācatvaṃ yāti| kāco+apyupekṣita āndhyaṃ gacchati| ataḥ
                            kāraṇānnetrarogeṣu madhye timiraṃ dāruṇaṃ śīghraṃ sādhayet|

jīvantyāḥ palaśatamapāṃ droṇe pādāvaśeṣitaṃ pacet| tatkvāthe
                            ghṛtaprasthaṃ dviguṇakṣīraṃ prapauṇḍarīkādibhiḥ karṣaparimāṇaiḥ
                            kalkitairvipācayet| niśi pītaṃ tatparaṃ timirāpaham|

tathā drākṣādibhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ-karṣāṃśaiḥ, jīrṇasya-purāṇaghṛtasya
                            prasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacet| tacca kācādīn hanti|

paṭolādikaṃ parpaṭāntaṃ pṛthak palonmitamāmalakānāṃ prasthaṃ
                            nalvaṇe-droṇe+ambhasi, kvāthayet| tadāḍhake mustādibhiḥ sapippalīkaiḥ
                            piṣṭaiḥ-kalkitaiḥ, ardhapalikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tacca ghṛtaṃ
                            ghrāṇādirogajit, vidradhyādirogajit, viśeṣeṇa śukrādighnam|
                            etatpaṭolādyaṃ ghṛtam|

triphalāyāḥ palāṣṭakaṃ jalāḍhake pādaśeṣaṃ kvāthyam| tena kvāthena
                            tulyakṣīreṇa triphalāpalakalkayukto ghṛtārdhaprasthaḥ pakvaḥ śarkarayā
                            mākṣikeṇa vā yutaṃ tattimirī pibet| ghṛtena vā tena yuktaṃ
                            triphalākvāthaṃ doṣadūṣyādivaśāt pibet| etacca
                            triphalāghrutamucyate|

yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ sahasitādrākṣairajākṣīrādibhiḥ pṛthaksvarasaiḥ
                            samaiḥ prasthapramāṇaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet| etanmahātraiphalaṃ
                            suṣṭru dṛṣṭivikārajit|

traiphalena ca sarpiṣā triphalāṃ yaṣṭīyuktāṃ mākṣikeṇa ca pariplutāṃ
                            rātrau lihāno māsamekaṃ hitāśī sannāmalakodakaṃ piban gārutmataṃ
                            cakṣurlabhata iti bhagavānnimirāha|
tāpyādibhiḥ saṃyojitā triphalā yathākāmaṃ varā timiraghnī syāt|

athavā triphalākvāthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ timirarogaharamabhyaset| apūpādīn vā
                            triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān śīlayet|

pāyasaṃ triphalāyutaṃ va śītaṃ samadhuśarkaraṃ prātaradyāt| bhaktasya
                            pūrvaṃ vā| harītakīṃ vā mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
                            yutāmanārataṃ timirāturo+adyāt|

srotojāt catuḥṣaṣṭimaṃśāṃstāmrādibhiḥ
                            pratyekamekāṃ-śairyutānandhamūṣodarasthitān dhmāpayitvā
                            samyagāvṛttaṃ-āvartitaṃ śilāyāṃ, tataḥ-anantaraṃ, madhurādigaṇakvātheṣu
                            tanniṣecayet pṛthak pṛthak saptavārān| tato vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkānāṃ
                            tribhirbhāgairyutametaccūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvatimiraghnaṃ prayuñjīta|

māṃsyādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaiścandre+aśvinīyukte satyakṣiyugmamañjayet
                            timirādiśāntimicśan| ārye mukhacapale|

maricasaindhavayordvau bhāgau, pippalīsamudraphenayordvau bhāgau,
                            sauvīrāñjanasya bhāgā nava, etaccitrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphāmayajit|
                            gītirāryā|

drākṣādisvaraseṣu pṛthak pṛthak divyajale ca srotoñjanaṃ saptakṛtvo
                            niṣecayet| taccūrṇikṛtaṃ śaṅke sthitaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādakṛdañjanaṃ
                            sarvākṣirogeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ videhapatinirmitam|

bādaraṅgāraistutthaṃ nirdagdhaṃ pūrvavat krameṇa chāgakṣīraghṛtamākṣike
                            niṣecitaṃ, tasmāt-nirdagdhācca tutthāt paladvayaṃ, tāpyādibhiḥ
                            kārṣikairyaṣṭīpalena ca yuktaṃ, mūṣāntardhmāpitaṃ cūrṇitaṃ, kācādīn
                            hanti| susevito+ayaṃ bhāskaraścūrṇo viśeṣeṇa timiraṃhanti| yathā
                            ravirandhakāramityupamāśleṣo+alaṅkāraḥ|

bujaṅgasya-sīsakasya triṃśadbhāgāḥ, gandhapāṣāṇasya bhāga pañcakaṃ,
                            śulbatālakayordvau dbau bhāgau, vaṅgasya-trapuṇa eko bhāgaḥ,
                            añjanādbhāgatrayamandhamūṣādhmātaṃ vipakvamañjanaṃ dvitīyo bhāskara
                            ivaloke timirāntakaram| bhujaṅgādīnāṃ śodhitanāmatra prayogaḥ, na tu
                            māritānām|

gomūtre chagaṇarase+amlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike
                                ca||33||

yattutthaṃ jvalitamanekaśo niṣiktaṃ tatkuryādgaruḍasamaṃ narasya
                                cakṣuḥ||33||

tattutthaṃ narasya garuḍanayanatulyaṃ nayanaṃ kuryāt| katamam ? yaddīptaṃ
                            sat gomūtrādiṣvanekaśaḥ-saptakṛtvo, niṣiktam| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|
yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yatsīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||34||

taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā+anañjanā
                                vā||35||

taimiryārmasrāpapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca
                                hanti||35||

yatsīsaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ triphalākvāthādikaṃ pṛthak pṛthak spatakṛtvaḥ
                            pāyitaṃ tasya sīsasya śalākā nayane yuktā sahāñjanā+añjanena rahitā vā
                            taimiryādīn hanti| śālinīvṛttam| dravyaśalākeyamiti prathitā|

pāradasīsakau samāṃśau, tayoḥ samamañjanaṃ,
                            ṣoḍaśāṃśakarpūrayutamidamañjanaṃ timirāpahaṃ bhavati|

nirdagdhaṃ samadhṛtamañjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo+ayaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti
                                gārdhram||37||

yo gṛdhrastaruṇaraviprakāśagallastasya samayamṛtasyāsyaṃ mukhaṃ,
                            gośakṛdbhiḥ-gomayakarīṣaiḥ, nirdagdhaṃ-bhasmāsātkṛtaṃ, tasya
                            samamañjanaṃ-srotojaṃ, samadhṛtaṃ-samabhāgaṃ, peṣyaṃ-cūrṇayitavyam| ayaṃ
                            yogo nayanayoḥ-netrayoḥ, balaṃ gārdhraṃ-gṛdhratulyaṃ, karoti|

kṛṣṇasarpasya vadane sahaviṣkamañjanamaniḥsṛtadhūmaṃ dagdhaṃ
                            māṃsīpatrakamiśritaṃ cūrṇītamupayuktaṃ sat cakṣurbhinnatāramapi rakṣati|
                            bhinnatāramapītyanena śaktyatiśayamasyāha| na tu bhinnatārasya
                            kathañcidrakṣaṇaṃ syāt| anyatrāpyevaṃvidho nyāyo+ayamanusaraṇīyaḥ|
                            svāgatāvṛttam|

kṣīrakumbhe mṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ nyasya vṛścikāṃśca caturastrisaptāhaṃ
                            kledayitvā viloḍayet| tasmin yannavanītaṃ bhavet, tena navanītena
                            kukkuṭaṃ puṣṇīyāt| tasya kukkuṭasya
                            purīṣeṇāndho+apyañjanānniścitamīkṣate|

kṛṣṇasarpasya vasā śaṅkhaḥ katakaphalaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| iyaṃ rasakriyā
                            drāgevāndhānāṃ dṛṣṭipradā|

daśa maricāni, vaṭṭamākṣikādardhakarṣaṃ, tutthātpalaṃ, madhuyaṣṭikāyāḥ
                            karṣaḥ, etatsarvaṃ kṣīrārdraṃ
                            paścāddagdhamapratisārasaṃjñamañjanamatiśreṣṭhaṃ timire| gītirāryā|

akṣabījādibhirjalapiṣṭairguṭikāḥ chāyayaiva pariśuṣkāḥ-na tvātapena,
                            timirāṇi laghu nāśayanti| svāgatāvṛttam|

maricādibhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ ṣaṇmākṣika iti yogastimirādighnaḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika
                            iti ko+arthaḥ ? kīdṛśaḥ samāsaḥ ? brūmaḥ| mākṣikaśabdenādilopākhyayā
                            tantrayuktyā vaṭṭamākṣika ityucyate| ṣaṭpūraṇo vaṭṭamākṣiko yasminniti
                            samāsaḥ| tenāsmin yoge ṣaṣṭho vaṭṭamākṣika ityavatiṣṭhate|
                            gītirāryā|

ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ srotoñjanaṃ tāmramayaḥ
                                saśaṅkham||45||

ratnādibhiścūrṇāñjanam| ratnānyatra vajramarakatādīni yathālābhaṃ
                            grāhyāṇi| lohitagairikaṃ-lohitaṃ gairikam, kecittu lohitaṃ-kuṅkumamāhuḥ|
                            etaccūrṇāñjanamaśeṣadṛṣṭirogaharam| upajātivṛttam|

tilatailamakṣatailaṃ ca samāṃśaṃ mārkavasvaraso+asanācca
                            kvāthaścetyayasaḥ pātre vipakvaṃ dṛṣṭerbalametannasyaṃ karoti| āryā|

idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ, sāmānyaṃ cikitsitam saṃ-ataḥ-anantaraṃ, pratidoṣaṃ
                            sādhanaṃ śṛṇu|

[tatra-] teṣu timirādiṣu madhye, vātotthe timire daśamūlakvāthena ghṛtaṃ
                            kṣīre caturguṇe triphalākalkapakvaṃ pibet| anantaraṃ
                            triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kvāthaṃ kṣīreṇa saṃyutameraṇḍatailānvitaṃ virecanaṃ
                            yojayet|

mūlajālayutāyā jīvantyāḥ palaśataṃ jaladroṇe pacet| tasmin
                            jale+aṣṭabhāgaśeṣe kṣīratulye tailaprasthaṃ balātritayādibhiḥ
                            palonmitairmadhuyaṣṭikāpalaiścaturbhirlohapātre vipācayet| lohabhāṇḍa
                            evaṃ māsaṃ sthitaṃ tannasyenordhvajatrujān rogān hanti| viśeṣeṇa
                            dṛṣṭyāśrayān vātapittarogān parākaroti| keśādiṣu
                            puṣṭilāvaṇyakāntikaram|
vasā+añjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate||56||

vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā vasā+añjane śasyate| gṛdhrasarpakukkuṭotthā vā vasā
                            pṛthaṅ madhuyaṣṭikāyutā śreṣṭhā|

pratyañjane ca srotoñjanaṃ māṃsarasādiṣu krameṇa taptaṃ taptaṃ
                            saptakṛtvaḥ niṣiktaṃ pūrvavadyojyam| etacca paraṃ timirahṛt|

tathaiva kṛṣṇahariṇānmedaso dugdhe siddhāt khajenāloḍitāt teja uddhṛtya
                            madhikośīracandanaiḥ saha pakvaṃ tarpaṇamuttamam|

puṭapākaṃ tu prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca-tarpaṇapuṭāpākavidhyuktaṃ (hṛ.sū.a.
                            24/14-16), prayojayet|
atra ca-vātaje timire, vātapīnasa iva nirūhamanuvāsanaṃ ca prayojayet

pittaje timire jīvanīyaiḥ phalatrikena ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayitvā tataḥ
                            snigdhasya sataḥ sirāṃ vyadhayet|

sauvīrāñjanādikamañjanaṃ śastam| kiyatkiyatpramāṇam ?
                            ityāha-pañcāṃśamityādi| tadevaṃ pañca bhāgāḥ sauvīrāñjanasya, pañcaiva
                            tutthakasya, śṛṅgyāmalakānāṃ bhāgāstrayaḥ, sphaṭikakarpūrasya bhāga
                            ekaḥ, iti sthitam| evametadañjanaṃ timirahṛt kuryāt| gītirāryeyam|

kṣīreṇa caturguṇena jīvanīyādibhirājyaṃ-ghṛtaṃ, pakvaṃ nasye
                            śreṣṭham|

śleṣmotthatimire+amṛtādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītavataḥ sirāṃ vidhyet|
                            virecanaṃ ca pūgādibhiḥ kvāthaṃ dadyāt|

hnīberādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ payonvitardvirpañcamūlakvāthe tailaṃ pakvaṃ
                            nāvanaṃ hitam|

śaśādijā dvijāḥ-dantāḥ, eṣāmeva lālāṭaṃ-lalāṭe bhavamasthi, tathā
                            śvetagovālādīni, strīkṣīracchāgadugdhābhyāṃ piṣṭā
                            vartistimiraśukraharetyarthaḥ|

raktaje timire pittavadupakramaḥ| [śītaiḥ-] śītavīryaiḥ
                            śītasparśairannapānauṣadhasekalepādibhiśca, raktaṃ prasādayet|
saṃsargaje sannipātaje ca timire yathādoṣodrekaṃ cikitsitam|
sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭairlepo mukhasya ca||76||

madhūkādibhiḥ sakṣīraṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam| madhūkādibhireva
                            jalena piṣṭairmukhalepo hitaḥ|
sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirobastau ca śasyate||77||
natādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nāvane śirobastau ca śasyate|
tatsrutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacetkṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet||78||

uśīrakvāthe pippalīsaindhavaṃ rajīkṛtaṃ dadyāt| tacca srutaṃ sat
                            ghṛtānvitaṃ punaḥ pacet| ghane cāsmin śīte ca kṣaudraṃ kṣipet| etat
                            sarvotthe timire hitamañjanam|

rātricāriṇāṃ prāṇināmasthīni majjapūrṇāni srotoñjanayuktāni jale vahati
                            māsaṃ viṃśatirvā niśā vāsayet| tataḥ-paścāt, uddhṛtya śoṣayet| tani ca
                            meṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpairyutāni madhūkena ca, cūrṇitāni sānnipātike
                            timire+añjanaṃ śreṣṭham|

kāce+apyayeṣā-pūrvoditā kriyā, sirāṃ hitvā| sirā+api kasmānnānumīyate ?
                            ityāha-yantretyādi| siropayogiyantranipīḍitā malā āndhyāya yataḥ syuḥ|
                            srāvye tu rakte jalaukaso dadyāt|

ajāmūtreṇa piṣṭaiḥ kauntyādibhirvā vartirniśāndhyaghnī|
                            saṃ-kālānusāryādayo+ajākṣīreṇa piṣṭā vartayo niśāndhe hitāḥ|
tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭhamañjanam||88||

pippalīryakṛnmadhye sanniveśyādahan pacet| tataḥ pippalyaḥ śuṣkā
                            madhughṛṣṭā rātryandhe paramañjanam|
māhiṣe ca plīhayakṛtī tailasarpiṣā saha bhakṣayet|
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet||89||
bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam||90||

jīvantyāśca pallavāni sarpiṣā pakvāni bhuñjīta| tathā atimuktakādīni
                            patrāṇi ghṛtasiddhāni khādet| agastipatraiḥ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pāne ca
                            pūjitam|

amlapittoṣṇairvidāho-vidagdhatvaṃ, amlapittoṣṇavidāhaḥ|
                            dhūmarākhyaścāmlapittoṣṇavidāhaśca tasmin| tatra
                            dhūmarākhyaḥ-"śokajvarādi" (a. 12/29) ityādi lakṣaṇaḥ| "bhṛśamamlāśanāt"
                            (a. 12/28) ityādinā+amlavidagdhā| "bhavetpittavidagdhākhyā" (a. 12/16)
                            iti pittavidagdhā| "uṣṇataptasya" (a. 12/26) ityādinā uṣṇāvidagdheti|
                            tasmin dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe+atipurāṇasarpiṣā+abhyaktaṃ snigdhaṃ
                            śītairviśodhayet| śītaiśca sarvato lepayet|

gośakṛdādibhirvapakvamañjanaṃ śasyate| svarṇagairikādīnāṃ cūrṇairāvāpo
                            yasyāṃ sā, evaṃvidhā rasakriyā va śasyate|
kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam||93||
medādibhiḥ kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailasahitaṃ pakvaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|
kṣīrodbhavam sarpistarpaṇaṃ hitam| evamaśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ kāryaḥ|
yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||96||

[ tatra- ] tasmiṃśca timirarogisadṛśadarśane, yathāyogaṃ doṣadūṣyadeśādīn
                            vīkṣyauṣadhaṃ prayuñjīta|

santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena
                                ghṛṣṭam||97||

sūryoparāgādivilokanenopahatadarśanasya snigdhahimādi santarpaṇaṃ kāryam|
                            ādiśabdenātisūkṣmātibhāsurādiparigrahaḥ| survaṇaṃ ca ghṛtena
                            ghṛṣṭamañjanaṃ hitam| upājātivṛttam|

vyartho loko+ayaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne+api
                                vitte||98||

netrarakṣāyāṃ sadā yatno vidheyo yāvajjīvitābhilāṣitvam| yasmādandhānāṃ
                            tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāṃ vidyamāne+api dhane loka eva nirarthakaḥ syāt|
                            rātriṃdivaśabdo+atrācaturādisūtre nipātitaḥ| vaiśvadevīvṛttam|
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā||99||

tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara sthāne timirapratiṣedho
                                nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ||13||

ahitādāhārāt satataṃ nivṛttiḥ, atibhāsurādyālokanāccoparatiḥ,
                            ityetannimināmrā muninā paramaṃ nṛṇāṃ nayanasya rakṣaṇamuditam|
                            aupacchandasikaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyām
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne timira- pratiṣedho nāma
                            trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 13||

liṅganāśastimirapratiṣedhātpṛthagucyate, bahuvaktavyatvāt|
                                sa0-sujātaṃ-suṣṭhu ghanībhūtaṃ, liṅganāśaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ kaphodbhavaṃ
                                vidhyet| śeṣāstu liṅganāśā asādhyā iti na tān vidhyet|
                                tathā+a+avartakyādibhirvakṣyamāṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirupadravairvivarjitam|
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayetpunaḥ||3||

sa liṅganāśo yasmādasañjāto viṣamo-na samasaṃsthānaḥ, tathā
                            dadhimastusadṛśastathā tanuḥ-na ghanaḥ, śalākayā+avakṛṣṭo+api san
                            punarūrdhvam pravartate| tīvrāṃ rujaṃ karoti| punarapi-kṛtavyadho+api
                            san bhūyo+api, dṛṣṭimācchādayet| śleṣmalairāhārairāśu pūryate|
                            so+aparaiśca-aśleṣmalairāhāraiḥ, sopadravai(va)ścirātpūryate|

yasmācchlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaśca
                            śuklatvācchuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā,
                            abhibhavādānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|

yasmācchlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaśca
                            śuklatvācchuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā,
                            abhibhavādānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|
viṣamā chinnadagdhābhā tathā sarujā chinnāṃśukā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|
chatrābhā naikavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā||7||
chatrābhā+anekavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā syāt|
svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite||11||

atheti maṅlārthaḥ| kṛtamaṅgalasya śuddhasya tathā sambhojitātmana
                            āturasya sādharaṇe kāle prakāśe deśe pūrvāhṇe jānutulyāsanasthito vaidya
                            āturasya yantritasyopaviṣṭasya, tathā svinne+akṣiṇī yasya tasya
                            svinnākṣasya| kaiḥ ? mukhavāyubhiḥ| tathā+aṅguṣṭhena malite nayane sati
                            dṛṣṭau malamutplutaṃ-udgataṃ dṛṣṭvā, svāṃ nāsikāṃ vīkṣamāṇasya mūrdhni
                            niṣkampaṃ dhārite sati kṛṣṇamaṇḍalādardhāṅgulaṃ
                            hitvā+apāṅgāccāṅgulacaturbhāgaṃ muktvā tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ
                            niścalaṃ yathā bhavati tathā dhṛtāṃ daivacchidrasya pārśvaṃ nayet
                            ūrdhvamāloḍayanniva| savyaṃ netraṃ dakṣiṇakareṇa, vāmena ca hastena
                            dakṣiṇamakṣi, vidhyet|
sthire doṣe cale vā+ati svedayedakṣi bāhyataḥ||16||

suviddhe sati śabdaḥ syāt| tathā+arug jalalavasya ca srutiḥ syāt|
                            sāntvayan rogiṇamanu-paścāt, netraṃ stanyena secayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ,
                            śalākāyā agreṇa dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ nirlikhet| katham ? apīḍayan| tathā
                            śanairnāsāṃ prati kaphaṃ nudan| tata ucchiṅghanācca dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaṃ
                            kaphaṃ haret| doṣe cale sthire vā satyakṣibāhyato+ati svedayet|
                            anantaraṃ rūpeṣu-vastuṣu, dṛṣṭeṣu satsu śanaiḥ śalākāmārkarṣet| tato
                            ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā paṭṭikayā baddhākṣaṃ viddhādanyena pārśvena
                            śāyayet| dvayorakṣṇorvyadhe sati tamuttānaṃ nivāte śayane+abhyaktaśiraḥ
                            pādaṃ hite rataṃ śāyayet|
kṣavathvādīn saptāhaṃ nācaret| atra ca snehapīta iva yantraṇā|

śaktyanusāreṇa ca taṃ laṅghayet| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ koṣṇena ghṛtena seko
                            hitaḥ| tathā vyoṣāmalakayuktaṃ vāṭhyaṃ dravaṃ saghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ bhuñjīta
                            vilepikāṃ vā| tryahādantaraṃ nayanaṃ muktvā kvāthairvātaghnaiḥ sevayet|
                            saptame tu dine sarvathaivākṣi mocayet|

dṛṣṭeśca yantraṇāṃ kuryāt| atisūkṣmabhāsurādīn nekṣetetyarthaḥ|
                            sthairyalābho yāvadakṣṇi syāt| sthirībhūtāyāmapi dṛśi sūkṣmaṇi rūpāṇi
                            bhāsurāṇi ca sahasā nāvalokayet|

ahitairācaritaistathā vedhadoṣācca śophādīnāmadhimanthasya codbhūtiḥ|
                            tāṃśca yathāyogamupakramet|
dūrvādayaḥ kalkitāḥ saghṛtā mukhālepe prayoktavyā rūgrāgaśamāya|
manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryādvedhe rūḍhe+añjanaṃ mṛdu||29||

vātaghnaśṛte kṣīre caturguṇe sarpiḥ padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu
                            śasyate| saṃ-evamapyanupaśāntau snigdhasvinnasya sirāṃ mokṣayet|
                            manthoktaṃ copakramaṃ yuñjīta| vedhe rūḍhe sati mṛdvañjanaṃ hitam|
āḍhakyādibhiḥ saguḍā vartirdivyāmbupiṣṭhā viddhe nayane yojyā|

ājena tāmramamunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva
                                piṣṭam||31||

piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitamanātapaśuṣkamakṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca
                                dṛṣṭeḥ||32||

jātyādikamajākṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭametena ca tāmraṃ pratanu pradigdhaṃ
                            saptāhātpunarajākṣīreṇa caitat piṣṭaṃ piṇḍāñjanaṃ chāyāśuṣkaṃ viddhe
                            nayane prasādanaṃ hitam| dṛṣṭeśca balakṛt|

yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho
                                nāma catu rdaśo+adhyāyaḥ||14||

srotojādibhirajākṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ piṇḍāñjanaṃ pūrvavaditi| vasantatilakaṃ(ke)
                            vṛttam(tte)| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma
                            caturdaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 14||
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītamacchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ||2||

netre vātenābhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāha ityādinā liṅgānirdeśaḥ|
                            snigdhoṣṇaiścopaśamanaṃ-sukham, ityupaśayanirdeśaḥ|

vātabhiṣyando mohādupekṣito+adhimantho bhavet| tatrādhimanthe,
                            karṇanādādikaṃ syāt| araṇiśabdaḥ puṃstrīliṅgaḥ|
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā||5||

adhimantho+api pramādādupekṣito hatādhimantho bhavet|
                            tena-hatādhimanthena, anekarūpā rujā jāyante| vraṇaśca dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭihā
                            syāt|

manyādibhyo vāyuranyato vā tīvrāṃ vyathāṃ pravartayet (yan) nayanaṃ
                            saṅkocayati| kimbhūtam ? paicśilyarāgaśopharahitam| tathā paryaśru| sa
                            anyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ|
tadvat-anyatovāta iva, jihmaṃ netramūnaṃ-hīnaṃ vā, vātaparyaye syāt|
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ||8||

adhimanthe kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ nataṃ śuklamaṇḍalaṃ connataṃ prasekādi ca
                            syāt|

raktasyandena raktāśrurājyādikaṃ nayanaṃ syāt| pittasyandalakṣaṇaṃ
                            ca|

manthe sati tāmraparyantaṃ tathotpāṭanena samānā rug yasya tadevaṃbhūtaṃ
                            nayanaṃ syāt| bandhūkapuṣpatulyarāgam| tathā tāmyati sparśanākṣamaṃ
                            lohitanimagnanimbābhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pāvakasadṛśaṃ ca darśanaṃ syāt|

adhimanthāśca yathāsvaṃ sarve syandādhikavyathāḥ, tathā
                            śaṅkhādiṣvatiśayena rukkarāḥ syuḥ|

vātapittottaraṃ netraṃ gharṣādimat syāt| tathā rūkṣe dāruṇe ca vartmanī
                            yasmistathā kṛcchrādunmīlanimīlane yasmiṃstathā+akṣisaṅkocanena
                            viśuṣkatvaṃ tathā śītecchā śūlapākena ca yutamakṣi syāt| ayaṃ
                            śuṣkākṣipāko nāma uktaḥ|

tribhirmalaiḥ-doṣairvātādibhiḥ, saraktaiḥ saśopho nāma netrarogo bhavet|
                            tatra-saśophe, śopho+atirug dāhaṣṭhīvanādimān bhavet| tadā śuklamaṇḍalaṃ
                            pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate| aśru ca muhuruṣṇaṃ muhuḥ śītamityādi ghanaṃ
                            ca|

pāka iti pākaśabdenākṣipākātyaya upalakṣyate| ādyantalopākhyayā
                            tantrayuktyā

pittaraktolbaṇairdoṣairannasāro+amlatvaṃ nītaḥ śirābhirnetramārūḍhaḥ san
                            śyāvalohitaṃ nayanaṃ karoti| tathā śophādiyutam| bhṛśaṃ
                            cāspaṣṭadarśanam| ityayamamloṣitaḥ|

ityevaṃ ṣoḍaśa sarvagā rogā uktāḥ| prakṛtatvāt sarvanetragā iti
                            gamyate|
eteṣu rogeṣu madhye sākṣipākātyayaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ tyajet|

raktotpanno hanti tadvattrirātrāt mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya
                                eva||24||

vātajo+adhimanthaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| mithyācārāditi
                            sarvatrānuvartate| śleṣmajo+adhimanthaḥ saptarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti|
                            raktajaścādhimanthastrirātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| paittikaścādhimantho
                            mithyopacārāt sadya eva dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| śālinīvṛttam| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogavi- jñānīyo nāma
                            pañcadaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 15||

sa0-syandeṣu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāṃ tīkṣṇameva gaṇḍūṣādikamupavāsaṃ ca
                                syandavantaṃ kārayet, vātotthaṃ kopaṃ muktvā|

dāhādiśāntyai biḍālakaṃ kuryāt| sarvatra syande patrailādibhiḥ
                            saindhavāntairbiḍālakaṃ kuryāt|
saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ||3||

saindhavādi ghṛtamaṇḍena bhṛṣṭaṃ vā pavanaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā rodhraṃ
                            yojyam| māṃsyādibhiḥ pittaraktayorbiḍālakaṃ kuryāt| manaḥśilādibhiḥ
                            kaphaje| sarvaje tu syande sarvaiḥ-pūrvoktairmilitaiḥ, biḍālakaṃ
                            kāryam|

caturbhāgapramāṇā manohvā yasmiṃstaccaturmanohvam| dviḥ-dvau vārau,
                            aṣṭāṣṭabhāgapramāṇaḥ śābarako yasmiṃstat dviraṣṭaśābarakam| tena
                            sitamaricasyaikaṃ bhāgaṃ manaḥśilāyāścaturo bhāgān rodhrasya ṣoḍaśa
                            bhāgān sañcūrṇya etatsūkṣmavastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre-sadyaḥprakupite,
                            nayane+avaguṇṭhanaṃ hitam| gītiḥ samukhacapalā|

taccūrṇaṃ sakṛdavacūrṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva
                                kopam||6||

āraṇyāḥ kulatthāśchagaṇarase-gośakṛdrase, paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnāstathā
                            nakhairvituṣīkṛtāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamekavāramevāvacūrṇanāt sadya eva netrāṇāṃ
                            kopaṃ vidhamati-jayati| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|

ghoṣādibhiḥ susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhairmūtī-poṭalikā,
                            tāmrasthakāñjikanimagnamūrtiḥ pīḍāṃ nānāvidhāṃ netre dhāritā jayati|
                            indravajrāvṛttam|

ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ
                                siddham||8||

dārvyāḥ palaṃ jalapalaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śṛtamaṣṭabhāgaśeṣaḥ seko madhuyutaḥ
                            sarvadoṣakupite cakṣuṣi hitaḥ| āryā gītiḥ|

ekaikadoṣajāṃ sannipātajāṃ vā nayanayornānāvidhāṃ pīḍāṃ śīghrameka eva
                            śobhāñjanakarasaḥ sakṣaudro jayati| rathoddhatāvṛttam|
taruṇamurubūkapatraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddhamāje kṣīre||10||

eraṇḍasya taruṇaṃ patraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya-saṃkṣudya, chāgadugdhasiddhaṃ
                            vātābhiṣyande pīḍāṃ sadya eva nihanti| doṣādivaśāt saktupiṇḍī uṣṇā vā
                            rujaṃ hanti| āryā gītiḥ|

vātaje+abhiṣyande bilvādibhireraṇḍamūlādibhiḥ saha kvāthaḥ kṛtaḥ koṣṇo
                            hitamāścyotanam| hrīberādiṣu sādhitaṃ sajalenājena payasā uttamaṃ
                            śūlāścyotanaṃ prasādanaṃ bhavet| hrīberaṃ-vālakam| vakraṃ-tagaram|
                            mañjiṣṭhādibhiḥ kvāthaḥ sasitaḥ śiśiraḥ seko raktapittaghnaḥ|

kaserukādirajo vastre śithilaṃ sthitaṃ divyajale kṣiptaṃ syande
                            raktapittaje hitam|
puṇḍrādibhirmūtī strīkṣīre saśarkare plutā chāgadugdhe vā dāhādihṛt|

śvetarodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ vasanasthaṃ stanyena
                            mṛditaṃ pittādijit|

nāgarādirasaḥ śleṣmaṇyāścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam| sa0-sānnipātike+abhiṣyande
                            miśrairauṣadhaiḥ-etairevānantaroktaiḥ, āścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam|

pavane purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| pitte śarkarayā yutaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| kaphe
                            vyoṣasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yavakṣārāvacūrṇitaṃ pītvā rudhiraṃ srāvayet| bhūyaḥ
                            snigdhaṃ tato virecayet|

ānūpavesavāreṇa śirovadanalepanamuṣṇena kāryaṃ śūle sati| dāhe tu sati
                            kṣīraghṛtānvitaiḥ śītaiḥ pralepaḥ kāryaḥ|
timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca paryālocya yathāyogaṃ cikitsitaṃ yuñjyāt|

eṣa eva vidhiraśeṣeṣu manthādiṣvapi śasyate| sa0-sarvathaivāśāntau manthe
                            bhruvorupari dāhayet|

rūpyaṃ godadhnā rūkṣeṇa limpet| tasmin dadhni nīlatvamāgate śuṣke ca
                            mastunā vartirvātākṣiroganāśinī|
jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet||25||
ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param||27||

praprauṇḍarīkādikamaṣṭapalaṃ pṛthagjaladroṇe pacet| rase pūte punaḥ śṛte
                            ghane ca puṣpāñjanāddaśa palāni, marīcātkarṣaṃ ca kṣipet|
                            kṛtaścūrṇo+athavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandotthān rāgādīn hanti| tathā sadya
                            eva dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet| eṣa pāśupatākhyo yogo bhiṣajāṃ paraṃ
                            rahasyam|

śuṣkākṣipāke ghṛtasya pānamakṣṇośca jīvanīyasiddhena ghṛtena tarpaṇaṃ
                            hitam| aṇunā tailena nasyaṃ hitam atra ca kṣīraṃ koṣṇaṃ saindhavayutaṃ
                            pariṣeko hitaḥ|

nāgaraṃ stanyapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtānvitamañjanaṃ hitam| ānūpaprāṇijā vā vasā
                            kiñcitsaindhavaśuṇṭhīyutā [ añjanaṃ ] śasyate|

keśān ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān mallakasampuṭe dagdhvā ghṛtapiṣṭā
                            lohapātrasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭhamañjanam|

saśophe+alpaśophe vā snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet| snigdhasya
                            punardrākṣādibhirvirekaḥ|

śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ vastrasthitamuṣṇāmbunā mṛditaṃ sekaḥ
                            śūlahṛtparam|

tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ
                                vedanāghnam||34.5||

tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ
                                variṣṭhaḥ||34.5||

lohabhāṇḍe tāmraṃ gomūtreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpirdhūpitaṃ netre prayuktaṃ
                            pīḍāhṛt| gavyadadhisarastāmre ghṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavayukto netre prayukto
                            varīyān vedanāghnaḥ sandhāvaḥ|

śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ patrairdhūpitaṃ
                                tadyavaiśca||35.5||

netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ
                                cātitīvrām||35.5||

śaṅkhaṃ stanyena tāmre ghṛṣṭaṃ śamīpatrairyavaiśca ghṛtāktairdhūpitaṃ
                            tatsandhāvasaṃjñaṃ netre prayuktaṃ śīghraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāmatidāruṇāṃ ca
                            hanti| śālinyau vṛtte|

udumbaraphalaṃ lohe stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamīpatrairdhūpitaṃ
                            dāhādijit|

śigrupallavarasaḥ sughṛṣṭastāmrasampuṭe ghṛtena dhūpitaḥ śophādīn
                            hanti|

mṛtkapālaṃ tilāmbhasā kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ tathā
                            nimbapatrairghṛtābhyaktairdhūpitaṃ gharṣādijit|
stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayecca taiḥ||40||

sandhāvena netre+añjite vigatauṣadhavedane sati stanyenāścyotanaṃ hitaṃ
                            kāryaṃ trīn vārān| taiśca-sandhāvaiḥ, paraṃ-tribhyo vārebhyo,
                            nāñjayet|

tālīsapatrādibhirmūtrapiṣṭaistāmramālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet| tataḥ
                            saptāhādūrdhvaṃ gomūtreṇaiva guṭikāḥ kuryāt| tāśca chāyāviśoṣitāḥ
                            stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣādighnāḥ|

eteṣāṃ pṛthak cikitsā yathāsvamuktā| sa0-atha bhaṇiṣyate cikitsā
