                            vidhiṃ-vraṇapratiṣedhoktaṃ, kuryāt|

prāyo bāhulyena sadyovraṇa etatsāmānyaṃ karma| sa0-pṛthakpṛthag viśeṣeṇa
                            karma bhaṇiṣyate|
ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet||14||
ghṛṣṭe vraṇe pīḍāṃ prāgupaśamayya cūrṇāni yojayet|

vicchinne pravilambani ca vraṇe sīvanaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena, tathā
                            bandhanaṃ pīḍanaṃ ca paścād yojayet|
asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netramadīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat||16||
tato+asya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ||17||

sphuṭitaṃ locanamasādhyam| asphuṭitaṃ tu yannetramavadīrṇaṃlambate, tat
                            sve sthāne sanniveśyāvyāvidhasiraṃ padmapatrāntaritena hastena pīḍayet|
                            anantaramasyāturasya ghṛtaṃ chāgaṃ sakṣīrairyaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ pakvaṃ
                            secanādau hitam| yatastad ghṛtaṃ paraṃ sarvanetrābhighātajit|

galapīḍanamavasanne netre vamanādayaḥ kāryāḥ, prāṇāyāmo vā| tathā
                            kṣanetrakriyā cātra hitā|
karṇe sthānād bhraṣṭe syūte sati tailena śrotaḥ pūrayet|
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram||21||

kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ vāte+api niryāte sati samaṃ sthāpayitvā syūtvā ca
                            nirantaraṃ śīghraṃ badhnīyāt| atrājena ghṛtena ca pariṣekaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|
                            uttānāḥ san bhojanaṃ bhuñjīta| suyantritaśca svapyāt|

śākhāsu hatamāturaṃ tiryaksthitaṃ śarīre samyaksthāpite syūtvā
                            vellitabandhena ghanena vāsasā badhnīyāt| asaṅgate vraṇe carmaṇā
                            goṣphaṇābandho vidheyaḥ|
pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā||24||
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ||25||

vilambumuṣkasya pādau netre ca vāriṇā prekṣya vṛṣaṇau praveśya sīvyet|
                            katham ? tunnasaṃjñayā sevanyā| tathā kaṭyāṃ paṭṭakamāsajya
                            goṣphaṇābandhaṃ kuryāt| snehasekaṃ na kurvīta| yataḥ snehaseke satyasmin
                            vraṇaḥ klidyati|
kālānusāryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ vṛṣaṇayo ropaṇam|
chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ||27||

niḥśeṣeṇa chinnāṃ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktyā kośabandhena badhnīyāt|
                            anantaraṃ vraṇamivācaret|
viddhe śalyāhṛte sati bhaṅgādvidalite kriyā kāryā|

śirasaḥ śalye nipatite sati vālavartiṃ praveśayet|
                            anyathā-vālavarterapraveśāt, mastuluṅgasrāvādvāyuḥ ṛddhaḥ enaṃ-
                            vraṇinaṃ, hanyāt| vraṇe rohati satyekaikaṃ kacaṃ śanairnayet|
aṅgādanyasmācchalye hṛte sati tatra vraṇe snehavartiṃ nidhāpayet|

ye vraṇā dūrāvagāḍhādiguṇāstāṃścakratailena-kohlakādyudbhavena tailena,
                            secayet| kimbhūtena ? sūkṣmanetreṇārpitena-kṣiptena|
bhinne koṣṭhe raktena pūrṇe sati mūrcchādyāḥ syuḥ|

āmāśayasthe rudhire raktamudvamatyapyādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca
                            viśasyate-vyāpadyate|

pakvāśayasthe lohite śūlasahitaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet| nābheradhobhāge
                            śaityam| chidrebhyo rudhirasyaivāgamanam|

āśayo+abhinno+api sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhirlohitena syandamānenābhipūryate|
                            pārśve mūtreṇa bastiriva|

teṣu madhye+antarlohitaṃ vraṇinaṃ śītapādaṃ śītocchvāsaṃ śiśirakaraṃ
                            śītavakraṃ lohitākṣaṃ pāṇḍuvadanamānaddhaṃ ca varjayet|

āmāśayasthe rakte vamanaṃ hitam| pakvāśayagate virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca
                            vigatasnehairuṣṇaiśca viśodhanairhitam|

yavādīnāṃ rasaiḥ sneharahitairannaṃ bhakṣayet| peyāṃ saindhavānvitāṃ vā
                            pibet|
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati||41||

klinnāntrabhedena bhinnāntrabhedena ca koṣṭhabhedo dviprakāra uktaḥ|
                            prathame-klinnāntrākhye, mūrcchadayo+alpāḥ-kiñcideva, syuḥ|
                            dvitīye-bhinnāntrākhye, atiśayena bādhakāḥ syuḥ| klinnāntro dehī saṃśayī
                            syād jīvane| bhinnāntro na jātu jīvati|

yasya viṇmūtramārutā yathāyathaṃ mārgaṃ prāptāḥ vigatopadravaśca sa naro
                            bhinnakoṣṭho+api san jīvati|

antramabhinnaṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśanīyamantare| na
                            tvato+anyathā-bhinnamityarthaḥ| anye
                            tvevamācakṣate,-utpaṅgilaśirasāmarkoṭaśīrṣeṇa, grastaṃ bhinnamapyantraṃ
                            praveśyam| saṃ-antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ tṛṇādibhirdigdhaṃ payasā prakṣālya
                            sarpiṣā+abhyaktaṃ klṛptanakhaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ praveśayet|

śuṣkamantraṃ kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ bahughṛtapariplutamaṅgulyā galaṃ pramṛśet
                            jalenodvejayet| tathā-evaṃ, antrāṇyantaḥ praviśanti tatkālaṃ ca
                            pīḍayanti|

vraṇasūkṣmātvādantrasya bahutvāt [vā] koṣṭhamanāviśadantraṃ jaṭharaṃ
                            tatpramāṇena pāṭayitvā praveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyagantre sati
                            paścād vraṇaṃ sīvyet| sthānāccyutamantraṃ jīvitaṃ harati| kupitaṃ ca
                            tat-antraṃ, paṭṭena veṣṭayitvā paścādghṛtena pariṣecayet| anantaraṃ
                            citrātailānvitaṃ koṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet| śakṛto mṛṛdūkaraṇāya pavamānasya
                            ca pravartanāya| yathoktāṃ ca vraṇayantraṇāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ
                            yāvadanuvarteta|
dṛḍhaṃ badhvā ca sūtreṇa varddhayetkuśalo bhiṣak||51||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe+anne ghṛtaṃ pibet||53||

jaṭharānmedaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā vā mṛdā+avakīryāthavā
                            ślakṣṇacūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyairmūlairavakīrya tato mūlena samaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca kṛtvā
                            sūtreṇa badhvā tīkṣṇena vahniprataptena śastreṇa kuśalo vaidyaḥ sakṛdeva
                            varddhayet| anyathā chinnayā rujā+a+aṭopo mṛtyurvā syāt| tato vraṇe
                            samākṣike baddhe+anne ca sujīrṇe sati ghṛtaṃ pibet| athavā śarkarādibhiḥ
                            śṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ pibet| tacca ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vā rujādāhahṛt| anantaraṃ
                            pūrvokto vidhiḥ| tatra medogranthiṣu kathitaṃ tailamabhyañjane
                            hitam|
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ||55||
tālīsādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ sadyovraṇeṣu ropaṇaṃ paramuktam|

gūḍhaprahāreṇābhihate, tathā viṣamaṃ patite, tathoccakaiḥ patite ca,
                            vātaraktaharādikaṃ kāryam|

viśliṣṭadehādikaṃ naraṃ tailadroṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinaṃ vāsayediti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmāṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sadyovraṇaprati- ṣedho nāma
                            ṣaḍviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 26||
samāsāditi bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ, bahudhā tu tat||3||

pātādibhirasthnāṃ bhaṅgaḥ| sa ca dvedhā-dviprakāraḥ, sandhīnāṃ
                            bhaṅgo+asandhervā| sandhibhaṅge prasāraṇa ākuñcane cāśaktiḥ
                            sandhimuktatā ca| itarasmin-asandhibhaṅge, atiśophaḥ,
                            sarvāsvavasthāsvatiśayena rujā, alpe+api ceṣṭite+aśaktiḥ, pīḍyamāne ca
                            saśabdatā, syāt| iti saṅkṣepeṇa bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇamuktam|
                            taccabhaṅgabhedenānekadhā bhidyate| saṃ-tasya-bhaṅgasya, sarvasya
                            sādhanaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, yathopayogāya syāt tathopadekṣyate|
prajyāṇudāri yattvasthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat||4||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat||7||
jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||7||

prājyāśca te+aṇavaśca prājyāṇavaḥ,-prabhūtasūkṣmāḥ| tairdrārāḥ-dāraṇāni,
                            vidyante yatrāsthni tat| prabhūtāṇudāri yadasthi tadduḥsādhyam|
                            yaccāsthi sparśe-sparśane sati, śabdaṃ karoti tacca duḥsādhyam|
                            yatrāsthileśo dāritaḥ-pāṭitaḥ, asthnāṃ madhyaṃ praviśet tacca
                            duḥsādhyam| yaccābhighātena bhagnam| kimbhūtam ? kiñcidevāvaśeṣitaṃ
                            bhavet, tacca duḥsādhyam| yacconnamyamānaṃ kṣatasamaṃ syāt, tacca
                            duḥsādhyam| tathā yanmajjani majjati, tathā kṛśādīnāmapi yat, tacca
                            duḥsādhyam| saṃ-kaṭyāṃ-kaṭipradeśe, yatkapālaṃ bhinnaṃ vidāritaṃ yacca
                            sandhivimuktaṃ yacca sandheścayutaṃ yacca jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ bhagnaṃ
                            ca yat tadvivarjayet-pariharet|

lalāṭamasaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ-bhinnaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ ca nopakramet|
                            śaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanānāṃ madhye yacchinnaṃ bhavet, tacca varjayet|
                            saṃ-tathā+asthi samyaguddhṛtamapi durnyāsādinā yad vikriyāṃ gacchet,
                            tacca varjayet| āditaḥ-prathamameva, yaccāsthi durjātaṃ-asamyagutpannaṃ
                            syāt, tacca duḥsādhyam| athavā+asthisandhiryo durjātaḥ syāt, sa ca
                            duḥsādhyaḥ| durjātaṃ ca durjātaśca durjātam| "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena"
                            ityekaśeṣaḥ| saṃ-tathā taruṇāsthīni-nāsākarṇākṣikoṣāṇi,
                            bhujyante-kuṭilīkriyante| tathā nalakāni bhaṅgaṃ yānti| kapālāni ca
                            vidāryante| anyāni cāsthīni bāhulyena sphuṭanti| etatsarvaṃ
                            duḥsādhyam|

atha-eṣāṃ bhaṅgasthitiṃ jñātvā, avanatamasthyunnamanīyam| unnataṃ
                            cāsthyavapīḍayet| atikṣiptamasthyāñchet| adhastādgataṃ copari vartayet|
                            saṃ-iti-evaṃprakāraiḥ, etaiḥ-āñchanādibhiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ,
                            sarvāñcharīragān sandhīṃścalānacalāṃśca niścalaṃ saṃsthāpya
                            vastrakhaṇḍajaiḥ paṭṭairbahusarpiṣkaiḥ sukhāvahairveṣṭayitvā+anantaraṃ
                            kadambādijairvalkalairvaṃśotthairvā śakalaiḥ-khaṇḍaiḥ, vistīrṇaistathā
                            tanubhiḥ-na tu sthūlaiḥ, suniveśitaistathā komalaistathā
                            pratistambhayuktaiḥ kuśāsaṃjñaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari kuryāt|
śithilena hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate||16||

ślathena bandhena sandheḥ sthairyaṃ na sampadyate| atigāḍhena tu bandhena
                            rujādyudbhavaḥ|

uṣṇe ṛtau tryahāttryahānmokṣayet| śīte ca ṛtau saptāhānmokṣayet|
                            sādhāraṇe-śaradvasantākhye, pañcahānmokṣayet| athavā bhāṅgavaśena
                            doṣavaśena mokṣayet|

tato nyagrodhādigaṇadravyakaṣāyeṇa śītena secayet bhaṅgasandhīn|
                            taṃ-sarujaṃ, pañcamūlaśṛtena kṣīreṇa secayet| saṃ-avasthādiviśeṣaṃ
                            vijñāya cakratailaṃ vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ vijānatā vaidyena
                            vā+avacāraṇīyam|
prātaḥ prātaḥ pibedbhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam||21||

bhagno naro gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ madhuradravyasādhitaṃ śītalaṃ
                            lākṣayā yuktaṃ prātaḥ pibet|

savraṇasya bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ|
                            atha śeṣaḥ kramo bhaṅgakathito vidheyaḥ|

vraṇamāṃsāni lambāni madhughṛtenālipya vraṇān vaidyaḥ sandadhyāt|
                            kṛtasandhānāṃśca tān yathāsvaṃ bandhairyojayet|

tān-vraṇān, susthitān samāṃśca viditvā phalinyādibhī rajīkṛtairācūrṇayet|
                            dhātakīrodhrayoścūrṇena vā| tathā-evaṃ kṛte sati, vraṇā drāgeva rohanti|
                            saṃ-iti-anena prakāreṇa, bhaṅgaścikitsitaḥ|

śītartau śtiradhātostathā māṃsalasya stokadoṣasya vraṇaḥ sukhasādhyaḥ|
                            anyathā-ato viparyayeṇa, dāruṇaḥ-kṛcchrasādhyo+asādhyo vā|

yathoktaṃ vidhiṃ kurvatāṃ
                            pūrvamadhyāntavayasāmekadvitriguṇairmāsairyathākramaṃ sandheḥ sthairyaṃ
                            jāyate|
yantraṇārtha tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ||28||
jaṅghorvoḥ pāṛśvayordvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ||28||

kaṭyādibhagnānaṃ kapāṭesthirhitā| yantraṇārthaṃ ca kīlāḥ-kīlakāḥ, pañca
                            sthirasthitihetavaḥ kāryāḥ| teṣāṃ ca sthānānyāha-jaṅghorvodvau dvau
                            kīlakau, tala ekaḥ kīlakaḥ, śroṇyāṃ bhagnasya pṛṣṭavaṃśe tu bhagnasya
                            pārśvayordvau dvāveka iti| ata evāha śroṇyāṃ vetyādi|
                            vaktrasya(kṣasya)kṣakayośca bhagnasya pañcaiva kīlakā yojyāḥ|
                            viśeṣastvato nopariṣṭāt kīlako yojyo yuktivaśāt|

ciravimuktāṃstu sandhīn pūrvaṃ snigdhān paścāt svinnān mṛdūkṛtān
                            yathoktairvidhānairbuddhyā ca viśeṣeṇa yathātmīyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayet|

asandhau bhagne rūḍhe ca viṣamolbaṇasādhite sati bhaṅgamāpothya-bhaṅktvā,
                            paścādbhaṅgaṃ yamayet| anantaraṃ bhagnavadācaret|
bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak||32||

bhagnaṃ yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti tathā vaidyo yatnaṃ kuryāt| yataḥ sandhiḥ
                            pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ san śleṣaṃ na yāti|

vātavyādhikathitān snehān (ci.a. 21/66)
                            catuṣprayogān-pānanasyābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ, balyān-balāya hitān, bhagnasya
                            yojayet| tathā bastikarma-"prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte" (hṛ.sū.ā. 19/63)
                            ityādinoktaṃ, abhyaset|

bhagnaṃ naraṃ mātrayā śālyādibhiḥ puṣṭikṛdbhiḥ
                            sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhiravidāhibhirupakramet| sa0-tasya-bhagnasya,
                            glānirna śasyate| yataḥ sā-glāniḥ, sandhiviśleṣaṃ kurute|
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam||35||
bhagno lavaṇādikaṃ rūkṣaṃ cāhāraṃ na seveta|

kṛṣṇān tilān vahati-asthire jale, saptarātrīrvigatareṇūṃstathā
                            dṛḍhavasanasaṃyatān vāsayet| etāṃśca praviralān vikīrya pratidinaṃ
                            saṃśoṣayet| tathaiva-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, kṣīre sthitānanudinaṃ
                            pratisārya śoṣitān sapta rātrīrevaṃ madhuyaṣṭīkvathite ca jale
                            vāsayedviśoṣayecca| vasantatilakāvṛttam| punarapi ca
                            pītakṣīrāṃstāṃstilān pūrvavadevātiśayena śoṣitānapagatatuṣaṃstathā
                            virajasaḥ sañcūrṇya naladādyaiḥ sucūrṇitairyojayet| āryā|
                            tānevāha-naladetyādi| aupacchandasikam| padmakādītyādi|
                            kimbhūtairnaladādibhiḥ ? padmakādigaṇasahitaiḥ sucūrṇitairyojayitvā
                            caitat tilapiṣṭaṃ sakalacorakādigandhadravyasiddhena kṣīreṇa saha
                            pīḍayet| tatastattailaṃ sairyakā(śaileyā)dibhirnaladādibhiśca
                            kalkīkṛtairdugdhasahitaiḥ pacet| indravajrā| etat
                            gandhatailamativīryamasthisthiratvakṛdāmayāśca pavanapittotthānativīryān
                            vyāpino+apyāśu jayati vividhaiḥ-pānanasyādibhiḥ, upayogaiḥ| svāgatā|
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhaṅgaprati- ṣedho nāma
                            saptaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 27||

hastyaśvādigamanādibhirarśonidānoktairaparairapi
                            niṣevitairaśubhapurākṛtakarmavipākena sadyo vā sādhunindābhiḥ
                            pāyoraṅgule dvyaṅgule vā yo vraṇo+antarbāhyo vā bāhu lyena piṭikāpūrvā
                            duṣṭaraktamāṃsago bastimūtrāśayasamīpagatatvāt syandanasvabhāvaḥ sa
                            bhagandaraḥ syāt| saṃ-bhagādīn sarvān dārayati, kriyārahitasya puṃsaḥ|
                            teṣu-bhagādiṣu, śīryamāṇeṣu khaiḥ-chidraiḥ, sūkṣmairbahubhiḥ krameṇa
                            vātādīn vamati|

bhagandarākhyo vraṇo doṣaiḥ pṛthak tridhā| yuktaiśca doṣaistridhā|
                            sarvairekaḥ| āganturaṣṭamo gaditaḥ|
apakvaṃ śophaṃ piṭikāṃ kathayanti| pakvaṃ śophaṃ bhagandaramāhuḥ|

piṭikāṃ gūḍhamūlādiguṇāṃ bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt| ato+anyathā-viparyayeṇa,
                            piṭikāmātrāṃ vijānīyāt|
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍumatī kaphāt||9||

śleṣmapavanāt piṭikā pāṇḍurādiguṇā syāt| kaphapittajastu bhagandaraḥ
                            "arśaḥsa(durnā)māśritya" (ślo.15) ityārabhyāgre pratipādayiṣyati| teneha
                            tatpiṭikā tantrakṛtā nābhihitā|

sarvairdoṣaiḥ pādāṅuṣṭhatulyā nānāvidhavyathā śūlādibhirupadrutā piṭikā
                            syāt|
tāśca piṭikāḥ pramādāt-ayatnāt, pakvāḥ sadyo vraṇatāṃ yānti|

teṣu madhyādvātajā piṭikā śataponakavat-tita uvat, sūkṣmadvāraiśchidraiḥ
                            krameṇa cīyate| kiṃ kurvāṇaiḥ ? acchaṃ-tanuṃ, āsrāvaṃ saha
                            phenamanavarataṃ sravadbhiḥ| ayaṃ śataponakasaṃjño bhagandaraḥ|

kaphottho bhagandaro bahupicchaparisrāvī syāt| sa ca parisrāvī
                            kathyate|

vātapittāt parikṣepītyucyate| tatra gudaṃ parikṣipya gatiḥ puraprākāraṃ
                            paritaḥ parikheva ca jāyate|
vātakaphād ṛjusaṃjño bhagandaraḥ| tatra ṛjvyā gatyā gudo dīryate|

pūrvotthaṃ durnāma samāśritya kaphapitte yadā kupyataḥ, tataḥ-tatkopāt,
                            arśomūle śophaḥ kaṇḍvādimān syāt| saḥ-śophaḥ, pakvabhinno+asya-arśaso,
                            mūlamāśveva kledayan gatibhirajasraṃ sravati| sa śopho+arśobhagandara
                            ucyate|

sannipātotthaḥ śambukāvartasaṃjñaḥ śambukāvartasamaḥ syāt| asmin-sarvaje
                            bhagandare, rugvegaistīvrairgatayo gudaṃ dārayanti|

asthilavo māṃsagārdhyena bhukto yadā tiryak-unmārgaṃ, nirgacchan gudaṃ
                            kṣiṇoti, tadā kṣātādgatiḥ syāt| tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ gatau māṃsakothena ca
                            tasmin kṛmayo bhavanti| te ca kṛmayaḥ tasya-bhagandariṇo, gudaṃ
                            bhakṣayantaḥ parito vidārayanti śīghrameva| asāvunmārgī
                            kṣatajaścocyate|
pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam||22||

teṣāṃ madhyāt kṛcchrasādhanāḥ ṣaṭ-ekadoṣajā dvidoṣajāśca| sannipātajaṃ
                            kṣatajaṃ ca tyajet| pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ yadbhagandaraṃ tattyajet|
                            tathā sevanīmāśritya yajjātaṃ tacca varjayet|

athāsya-bhagandarasya, piṭikāmeva-piṭikāvasthāmeva, yatnaṃ kṛtvā
                            śudhdyādibhistathopakramet yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti|

pāke tu satyupasnigdhamavagāhena ca sveditaṃ tato+arśasamiva yantrayitvā
                            suṣṭhu bhagandaraṃ paśyet-avāṅmukhaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ vā, antarmukhaṃ
                            bahirmukhaṃ vā, ityevaṃ suṣṭhu nirūpya| arvācīnamiti "vibhāṣāñceradik
                            striyām" iti svārthe khaḥ|
bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet||25||

anantaramantarmukhameṣiṇyā eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet| bahirmukhaṃ ca
                            bhagandaraṃ niḥśeṣaṃ pāṭayitvā tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet jvalanena vā|
                            uṣṭrakandharaṃ-uṣṭragrīvaṃ, kṣāreṇaiva sādhu kṛtvā vaidyaḥ sādhayet-na
                            tvagninā|

śataponakākhyamekāntarā nāḍīḥ kṛtvā pāṭayet| tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣā api nāḍīḥ
                            pāṭayet| anyathā-ekahelayaiva, gude pāṭite sati mṛtyuḥ syāt|

parikṣepiṇi ca bhagandare nāḍīkathitaiḥ kṣārasūtrakairevaṃkramāt,
                            sādhayet|

kṣatajo bhagandarastyaktvā-pratyākhyāya, cikitsyaḥ| anantaraṃ
                            śalyavataḥ-saśalyasya, śalyamāharet| tathā kṛmighnaṃ lepaṃ bhojanaṃ ca
                            dadyāt| pīḍāyāṃ ca satyāṃ piṇḍasvedādayaḥ susnigdhā hitāḥ|

bahucchidre ca bhagandare sarvatraivālocya caturaśchedān gotīrthakādikān
                            kuryāt| tāneva chedānāha-gotīrthetyādi|
pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ||31||

śastreṇa pārśvaṃ gatena yaśchedaḥ sa gotīrthakākhyaḥ, sa ca
                            kāvyagatagomūtrikākāraḥ| sarvato yaśchedaḥ sa sarvatobhadrākhyaḥ, sa ca
                            sarvatobhadrakāvyākāraḥ| ya ekasmin pārśve cedaḥ, sa ca
                            dalalāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-kuṭārahitahalākāraḥ| pārśvadvaye yaśchedaḥ sa
                            lāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-sampūrṇahalākāraḥ|

vraṇān sarvāṃścāsrāvamārgān niḥśeṣaṃ kṛtvā+agninā dahet| evaṃ kṛte sati
                            punarvikāraṃ vraṇo na yāti|

abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ
                                hitametadeṣām||34||

jyotiṣmatyādibhirabhyaṅgārthaṃ tailaṃ pacet| bhagandarāṇāmeteṣāmetat
                            paramaṃ-atiśayena, hitaṃ gadanti| vasantatilakāvṛttam| vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca
                            madhukādi drutavilambitam|

viḍaṅgasārādayo mākṣikatailayuktā līḍhāḥ kṛmyādivraṇaropaṇāḥ syuḥ|
                            māgadhikākaṇāḥ-pippalītaṇḍulāḥ| aupacchandasikaṃ vṛttam|

amṛtādikamidaṃ krameṇa bhāgavṛdhdyā vṛddhaṃ madhunā drutaṃ piṭikādīn
                            jayet| vaitālīyam|

māgadhikādikairbilvadhṛtaiḥ-pṛthak palamitaiḥ, triphalāpalaṣaṭkasahitaiḥ
                            sarvaistulyena guggulunā yutairmadhusametairmiśritairmātrayā
                            bhakṣitaiḥ(?) samastavyādhiharaṇaṃ syāt|

guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca
                                pṛthaksyāt||40||

guggulupalāni pañca, pippalyādayaḥ palāṃśikāḥ, tvagelayoḥ pṛthak karṣam|
                            tadetanmadhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhādighnam| svāyambhuvākhyo guggulureṣa
                            prasiddhaḥ| dodhakaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)|

tadeva-guggulvādikaṃ dravyaṃ, śuṇṭhīcūrṇayutaṃ daśamūlakvāthena
                            subhāvitaṃ viśeṣeṇa vātarogajit|

triphalādirajo+asanakvāthena bhāVvitaṃ tulyamahiṣākhya(kṣa)mākṣikaṃ
                            śīlayan kuṣṭhādīn hanti| ro narau lagayutā rathoddhatā|
bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni||43||

bhagandareṣu sarveṣvayamupakramaviśeṣo+abhihitaḥ| śeṣāṇi tu vraṇāni
                            prakaṭasādhanāni| teṣu vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanācca samyagviditvopakramaṃ
                            yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt| upajātiḥ|
sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ pariharedadhikaṃ vā||44||

bhagandare vraṇe rūḍhe+api turagapṛṣṭhagamanādikaṃ varṣaṃ yāvadadhikaṃ vā
                            pariharediti| svāgatāvṛttam| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhagandara pratiṣedho
                            nāmāṣṭāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 28||

bhagandare vraṇe rūḍhe+api turagapṛṣṭhagamanādikaṃ varṣaṃ yāvadadhikaṃ vā
                            pariharediti| svāgatāvṛttam| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhagandara pratiṣedho
                            nāmāṣṭāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 28||

medomāṃsaraktasthitāḥ kaphapradhānā doṣā vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ,
                            kurvanti, sa grathanād granthiḥ smṛtaḥ|

teṣu madhye vātādāyāmādiguṇaḥ śvayathuḥ syāt| sa ca vibhinno
                            lohitamacchaṃ sravati|
pittātsadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā, pacyate drutam||4||

pittena dāhayutaḥ pītacchavirathavā raktaḥ| śophaḥ śīghraṃ pacyate|
                            bhinnaḥ sa uṣṇamasṛk sravati|
śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān, pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sravedghanam||5||

kaphena nīrujo ghanaḥ śophaḥ śītasparśaḥ śarīrasamānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍūyutaśca
                            syāt| sa pakvaḥ pūyaṃ ghanaṃ sravet|

doṣairduṣṭe lohite sati granthirbhavet| jantuṣu-kṛmiṣu, vṛddhiṃ gacchatsu
                            sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya svāpānvitaḥ śophaḥ pittasamānalakṣaṇaḥ syāt|

māṃsalairāhārairmāṃsaṃ dūṣitaṃ granthi snigdhādiguṇayuktaṃ kaphākāraṃ
                            karoti|
vāyunā kurute granthi bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam||8||

medurairbhojanairmedaḥ pravṛddhaṃ vāyunā māṃse nītamathavā tvaci nītaṃ
                            medogranthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhādiguṇaṃ śleṣmasamānākāraṃ tathā
                            śarīrakṣayavṛddhibhyāṃ kṣayodayau yasya taṃ tādṛśaṃ karoti| sa ca
                            granthibhinnaḥ san ghanaṃ tāmramasitaṃ sitaṃ ca medaḥ sravati|

asthibhāṅgenābhighātena vā+asthnyunnatamavanataṃ vā yat syāt,
                            so+asthigranthiḥ |
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca||11||
niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ||11||

saṃ-padāteḥ sahasaiva jalāvagāhād vyāyāmādvā pratāntasyaglānasya,
                                pavanaḥ kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ sirājālaṃ sampīḍya tathā saṅkocya
                                vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa
                                sirāsaṃjñaḥ| niḥṣphuramiti "sphuratisphulatyoḥ" ityādinā ṣatvam|

aruḍhe vraṇe tathā rūḍhamātre-sadyorūḍhe vraṇe, sarvarasāśino
                            narasyāthavā sārdre vraṇe bandharahite śarīre+aśmābhihate vā vāto
                            raktamasrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇaṃ kuryāt| dāhādiyuta eṣa
                            vraṇagranthiḥ smṛto munibhiḥ|

doṣāsramedojā granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ| na punaḥ sthūlāḥ kharāścalāstathā
                            marmasthāḥ kaṇṭhasthā udarasthāśca granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ |
tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat||15||

grantheryanmahat tadarbudam| tasya cārbudasya lakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṭ prakāram|
                            katham ? doṣaistrīṇi, raktamāṃsamedobhistrīṇīti| tacca-arbudaṃ,
                            medaḥkaphabāhulyāt sthiratvācca prāyaḥ pacanaṃ na yāti|
sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca||16||

sirāsthitaṃ raktaṃ doṣo-vātādyanyatamaḥ, saṅkocyāntaḥ abhyantare, ca
                            prapīḍya pācayet| tatpakvaṃ ca sadānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitaṃ
                            māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ vṛddhiṃ gacchati| vṛddhaṃ ca sadāśu satataṃ duṣṭaṃ
                            rudhiraṃ prabhūtaṃ sravati| tat-evaṃvidhaṃ, śoṇitārbudaṃ gadyate|
                            māṃsārbudamedorbudayośca lakṣaṇaṃ
                            tadgranthilakṣaṇenaivoktaprāyatvānnehoktam|

teṣu-ṣaṭsvarbudeṣu madhye,śoṇitamāṃsaje dve arbude nopakramet| aparāṇi
                            catvāri sādhayet|

adhaḥkāyaṃ vaṅkṣaṇoruprabhṛti doṣā gatāḥ kapholbaṇā māṃsalohitagāḥ kālena
                            pādau samāśritya nibiḍaṃ śvayathuṃ śanaiḥśanairvidadhati|
                            tadetadchlīpadaṃ pracakṣate |

ślīpadaṃ vātāt paripoṭena yuktaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇamahetupīḍaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca
                            syāt|
kaphena guru snigdhaṃ rujārahitaṃ māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ mahacca syāt|
tat-ślīpadaṃ, varṣātikrāntaṃ sumahat suparisrāvaṃ ca tyajet|
ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe+anūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam||22||

pāṇyādiṣvapi pādavacchlīpadaṃ jāyata ityeke vadanti|
                            taccānūpadeśe+atiśayena rogasvabhāvājjāyate|

medasthāḥ kaṇṭhādigā doṣāḥ savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān
                            vārtākāmalakākārānavagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃścirapākāṃśca kurvate| te
                            ca-gaṇḍāḥ stokapīḍāḥ pacyante| anye ca sravanti| apare cātikaṇḍurāḥ,
                            kaṇḍuṃ rānti dadata iti kaṇḍurāḥ| naśyantyanye| anye jāyante
                            dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| iyaṃ-īdṛśī, gaṇḍamālā apacī cocyate| dūrveva
                            kṣayavṛddhibhāk|

śām-pakvaśophasyābhedanādapathyasevinaśca puṃso vraṇe pūyo
                                māṃsādīnanupraviśya dūraṃ vrajati| sā dūragamanāt gatirityucyate|
                                nāḍīva saṃsruternāḍītyucyate| anyeṣāṃ tu tantrakṛtāṃ mata ekā
                                nāḍyanṛjuḥ-vakrā, nāḍītyucyate| saiva nāḍyanekagatirgatirityucyata
                                iti |

sā-nāḍī, pṛthagdoṣaistrisaṅkhyā, sannipātena caturthī, pañcamī śalyahetuḥ
                            |
kaphāt ṅanapicśilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśicābhyadhikledā syāt|
kaphāt ṅanapicśilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśicābhyadhikledā syāt|

antaḥsthitaṃ śalyamanāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca
                                sā+asya||31||

phenānuviddhaṃ tanumalpamuṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca
                                nityam||31||

antare sthitaṃ śalyamanākṛṣṭaṃ sannāḍīṃ karoti| asya ca-śalyavataḥ
                            puṃsaḥ, sā-nāḍī, phenilaṃ tanvādiguṇaṃ ca pūyaṃ nityameva sarujaṃ vahata
                            iti| upajātivṛttam| iti
                            śrīmṛṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthya
                            rbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāma ekonatriṃ- śo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||
                            29||

bṛhatyādibhiḥ siddhena sarpiṣā śuddhikāmaṃ naraṃ snehayet| tataḥ
                            śuddhasya-kṛtavamanavirekasya sataḥ, tīkṣṇairdravyairlepanaṃ kāryam
                            |
saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ||2||
eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ, pittāsraje punaḥ||3||
jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ, kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ||3||

eṣa kramo viśeṣeṇa vāte kāryaḥ| pittāsraje granthau jalaukasaḥ| sarvadā
                            śītaṃ pralepādikaṃ hitam| kaphaje granthau vātodbhavagranthivihitaḥ
                            kramaḥ|

evamapyapakvamenaṃ granthiṃ sādhu yathā bhavatyaśeṣaṃ ca tathā chittvā
                            sthite rakte satyagninā dahet| śeṣaḥ kasmānna kriyate ? ityāha-saśeṣa
                            iti| yasmāt saśeṣo granthirniścayenaiva punarāpyāyate-vṛddhiṃ yāti|

medoje+apyetat kāryam| taṃ ca-medodbhavaṃ granthiṃ, tilakalkadigdhena
                            dviguṇavāsasā channaṃ santaṃ taptaiḥ phālādibhirupaspṛśet| athavā
                            śastreṇa pāṭayitvā medasi niḥśeṣamuddhṛte satyagninā dahet|
sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ, tathā||7||

sirāgranthau ca nave sāhacaraṃ tailaṃ peyam| tathā vātaghnairupanāho hito
                            bastikarma sirāvyadhaśca|
arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam||8||
arbude granthāviva sarvaṃ yathāyogaṃ sutarāṃ hitaṃ kuryāt |

ślīpade vātotthe snigdhe svinna upanāhite ca gulphasya dvayaṅgula upari
                            sirāṃ vidhyet| taṃ ca-ślīpadinaṃ, māsameraṇḍodbhavaṃ tailaṃ gomūtrayutaṃ
                            pāyayet| jīrṇe cairaṇḍataile purāṇamannaṃ śālyodanaṃ śuṇṭhīśṛtena
                            kṣīreṇa sahāśnīyāt| traivṛtaṃ vā pibet| evamapyaśāntau vahninā dahet|
                            tathā gulphasyādhastātsirāṃ mokṣayet|
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit||11||
paitte tu ślīpade sarvaṃ pittajiccikitsitaṃ hitam|

kaphaje tu sirāmaṅguṣṭhake vidhvā yavānnaṃ śīlayet| kaṣāyaguṇayuktāni
                            dravyāṇi mākṣikānvitāni hitāni| tathā vardhamānā dvitryādikrameṇa
                            harītakyo hitāḥ| sarṣapairvārtākīmūlena ca limpet|
                            dhānya(dhanva)yā-yavāsakayā vā, niśuṇṭhyā limpet|

apacyāmūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ dantyādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pātavyam| tathā
                            kaphamedoharaṃ dhūmādikamabhyaset| sirayā raktaṃ haret| rasāñjanaṃ
                            gomūtreṇāloḍitaṃ pibet|

āmān granthīnnākulyādibhirālimpet| kaṭhinān granthīllavaṇapoṭalyā svinnān
                            paścādaṅguṣṭhādinā mardayet |

pākonmukhān granthīn srutaraktasya pittaśleṣmaghnairdravyairjayet|
                            athavā+apakvāneva granthīnuddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyāmupakramet |

kākādanyādibhiḥ kalkairdvikarṣonmitairviṣakarṣayutaiḥ karañjatailasya
                            prasthaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarasasyāḍhake pacet| tena (anena) tailena gaṇḍamālā
                            cirotthā pūyavāhinī cāsādhyaprāyā+api pānādibhiḥ sidhyati|

lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarase caturguṇe tailaṃ pakvaṃ
                            nasyādyairapacījit| lāṅgalikīkandakalkaḥ pādo yasmistaile tadevam |

bhadraśrīdārvādibhiḥ palikairgomūtrapiṣṭairviṣasya cārdhapalena
                            yuktairbrāhmīrasādibhiḥ saṃyutaṃ sarṣapatailaprasthaṃ pakvaṃ
                            pānādyairabhyastaṃ kuṣṭhādīn śīghrameva hanti |

vacāharītakyādibhiḥ kalkitaistailaṃ pakvaṃ pītaṃ nirmūlāmapacīṃ
                            kuryāt|

śarapuṅkhāmūlaṃ tandulajalena piṣṭaṃ nasyena lepanena ca
                            duṣṭāruḥprabhṛtīn hanti|
tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca pūjitam||28||

uttamakāraṇyādīnāṃ mūlaistailaṃ kṣīratulyaṃ siddhaṃ nasye+abhyaṅge ca
                            hitam| uttamaivottamaketi "anyatarasyām" iti hrasvaḥ| uttamakā
                            cāsāvaraṇiśca(ṇī ca) uttamakāraṇītyarthaḥ|
                            uttamakāraṇī-karambhaḥ(mbhā)|
aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhirvāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ||29||

gavādīnāṃ khurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena vimiśritena lepo hitaḥ| kṛṣṇasarpo
                            dagdha iṅgudītailena, kāko vā svayaṃ mṛta iṅgudītailena, lepanaṃ hitam
                            |

evamapyaśāntau satyāṃ rogasyāparapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritaṃ
                            basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā jvalanena dahet |
sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ||30||

sthitasya puṃsa ūrdhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena pārṣṇipradeśāt tāvanmātraṃ
                            mitvā tata ūrdhva granthīn haret, iti nimimuniḥ prājyāśayo vadatīti|

pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendrabastiṃ ca
                                gadānyapārśve||31||

pārṣṇiṃ lakṣīkṛtya dvādaśāṅgulāni mittvā indrabastiṃ muktvā
                            gadasyāparapārśve vidārya madhyānmatsyāṇḍasadṛśāni jālāni karṣet, evaṃ
                            suśrutasya vacanam| upajātivṛttam|

gulphāntaṃ yāvat karṇādārabhya prāṇinaḥ suṣṭhu mitasya karṇānāṃ
                            hrasvalambatvenāniyatasthānatvāt sthānaniyamaṃ karoti| ghrāṇārjava iti|
                            etaduktaṃ bhavati| nāsāgrāt karṇaṃ prati sṛṣṭatve sati sumitasya karṇād
                            gulphaṃ yāvanna tvevameva, tathā tasya narasya khuḍakād
                            gulphādaṣṭabhāgaṃ bibhajya-tyaktvā,
                            indrabasteradhastādbhīttvā+akṣamātraṃ karṣet, ityapare vadanti|
                            indravajrāvṛttam|
paittiṃ tu pāṭitāṃ satīṃ tilādibhiḥ pradehayet|
śalyajāṃ gatiṃ chinnāṃ śodhitāṃ ca tilamadhvājyairlepayet|

śastreṇa chedanānarhāṃ gatiṃ samyageṣitāmeṣiṇyā bhittvā+ante kṣārayuktena
                            sūtreṇa punaḥpunardārayet|
yā vartyo yāni tailāni tannāḍīṣvapi śasyate||37||

duṣṭeṣu sūkṣmamukheṣu gambhīrādiṣu vraṇeṣu yatsādhanaṃ kathitaṃ, yā
                            vartaya uktāḥ, yāni tailāni, tat-etaccikitsitaṃ, nāḍīṣvapi yujyate|
cañcoḥ phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ lepena paraṃ nāḍīvraṇahṛt|

ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya patraṃ
                                vanitāpayaśca||38||
srugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hantyacireṇa nāḍīm||38||

ghoṇṭāphalādikaḥ strīkṣīrasrugarkadugdhayuta eṣa kalko vartīkṛto drāgeva
                            nāḍīṃ hanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma
                            triṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||30||

samudralavaṇādikaṃ kalke+abhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ
                            cāmīṣvabhyasyamāneṣvavidyamānagatiriva gatiḥ śīghraṃ naśyati| capalā
                            capaleṣu nareṣu bhūtiḥ-vittaṃ, yatheti| upajātirāryā ca| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛda yaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne
                            granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||
                            30||

tābhyāṃ-vātakaphābhyāṃ, yavaprakhyā-yavasaṃjñā| sā yavaprakhyā-yavākārā,
                            maṃsāśritā ghanā kaṭhinā ca|
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ||3||

granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā, kimbhūtāḥ ? amukhāstathā+alajīva
                            vṛttāḥ-vartulāḥ, stokapūyā ghanā unnatāśca kacchapītyucyate| sā ca
                            kacchaponnatā syāt|

karṇasyopariṣṭāt parito vā piṭikā kaṭhinā tīvrarujā śālūkanibhā
                            panasikāsaṃjñā|
medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ||5||

vātakaphābhyāṃ śālmalīkaṇṭakasadṛśāḥ piṭikā rujānvitā ghanā
                            medogarbhāstaruṇānāṃ mukhe syuḥ| tāśca mukhadūṣikāḥ|
te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmamiva kaṇṭakaiḥ||6||

padmakaṇṭakasaṃjñāste vedyāḥ, yaiḥ kaṇṭakairnīrujaiḥ
                            śvetavarṇairvātakaphajaiḥ padmamiva śarīraṃ cīyate|

pittena yā piṭikā vartulā pakvodumbaraphalanibhāmahādāhajvarakṛcca, sā
                            vivṛtākhyā vivṛtamukhā syāt|

gātreṣu-avayaveṣu, vaktrasya cāntare dāhādiyutā
                            masūrapramāṇāstadvarṇāstatsaṃjñā masūrikā ghanāḥ piṭikāḥ|
tābhyo masūrikābhyo dāruṇatamāḥ sphoṭā mahārujā visphoṭāsaṃjñāḥ|

padmakarṇikānibhā yā piṭikā piṭakairācitā, sā vātapittābhyāṃ viddhākhyā
                            syāt|

tābhyāmeva-vātapittābhyāṃ, gardabhīsaṃjñā maṇḍalākārā vistīrṇā
                            tathotsannā sarāgapiṭakairācitā|

kakṣānikaṭeṣu pradeśeṣu sā gardabhī kakṣetyucyate| sā ca vātāt syāt|
                            tasyāmeva pittena sūkṣmāḥ piṭikā lājākārā ghanāḥ kakṣāsaṃjñā eva
                            syuḥ|

gharmasvedayukte śarīre piṭikā rujāyutā ghanā rājikāvarṇā rājikākārā
                            rājikāpramāṇā rājikāsaṃjñāḥ|

pittādhikairdoṣairmandairyaḥ śopho visarpa iva visarpati,
                            tathā+apākastanustāmravarṇo jvarakārī ca, sa jālagardabhaḥ syāt|

pittolbaṇairmalairjvaravato māṃsadāraṇāḥ sphoṭāḥ kakṣāpradeśeṣu
                            ye+agnisadṛśā jāyante, sā+agnirohiṇītyucyate| pañcāhena saptarātreṇa
                            pakṣeṇa vā jīvitaṃ hanti|

vidārīkandavat kaṭhinā kakṣāyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇe ca vidārī syāt| kakṣā ca
                            vaṅkṣaṇaṃ ca kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇaṃ tasmin| "pāṇyoḥ"(?) ityādinā hrasvaḥ|
durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ||18||

medaḥpavanakaphaiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayairgranthiḥ syāt| sa ca bhinno
                            vasāghṛtamadhunibhaṃ sravet| tasmin pavano+adhiko māṃsaṃ viśoṣya
                            grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ kuryāt| tato doṣāstāṃ-śarkarāṃ, nicitāṃ durgandhaṃ
                            lohitaṃ klinnaṃ vividhavarṇaṃ srāvayanti| tat evaṃvidhaṃ, śarkarārbudaṃ
                            vidyāt|

pāṇitale pādatale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vā granthirvalmīka iva
                            śanairupacīyate| tadvatvalmīkavat, bahūni ca tānyaṇūni ca,
                            tairbhūrisūkṣmairvadanairupalakṣito rugdāhakaṇḍūkledabahulo
                            valmīkākhyo+asau tridoṣajaḥ|
granthiḥ kīlavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat||21||

śarkarādibhirunmathite pāde kaṇṭakādibhirvā kṣate kīlasadṛśo
                            granthirutsanno jāyate, tatkadaraṃ nāma|

apānākhyo vāyurvegasandhāraṇādapānāśrayaṃ mārgaṃ bāhyāntaraṇūkaroti|
                            tato+asya-āturasya, kṛcchreṇa śakṛnniryāti| ayaṃ rogo ruddhagudo
                            mataḥ|

pittānilaṃ kartṛ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaraṃ pākaṃ kuryāt| taṃ cipyaṃ
                            tathā+akṣatarogamupanakhaṃ ca vidyāt|
abhighātāt kṛṣṇavarṇo rūkṣaśca kharaśca nakhaḥ kunakhākhyaḥ|
kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam||27||
śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ śarīrasamaṃ lāñchanamāhuḥ|
paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt||29||

vātapittācchokādikruddhāt tanu śyāmavarṇaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ
                            vadanti| mukādanyatra nīlikā| paruṣacchavistathā paruṣasparśaṃ
                            śyāmavarṇaṃ ca vyaṅgaṃ vātāt syāt| pittena tāmrāntaṃ kiñcinnīlam|
                            kaphena śvetāntaṃ sakaṇḍu ca syāt| raktādraktāntaṃ kiñcittāmramoṣayutaṃ
                            cimicimāyate ca|

pavanena kaphaḥ preritastvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati| anantaraṃ tvak pāṇḍuḥ
                            krameṇa ca vicetanā alpakaṇḍūrvikledarahitā ca jāyate| sā prasuptitaḥ
                            prasuptiḥ syāt|

asamyagvamanena preritapittaśleṣmānnanigrahairmaṇḍalānyatiśayakaṇḍūni
                            lohitāni bahūni ca utkoṭhaḥ syāt|

iti-anena prakāreṇa, ṣaṭtriṃśat kṣudrarogā vibhāgenoktā iti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudraroga vijñānīyaṃ
                            nāmaikatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 31||

pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ yāvadeṣa vidhiḥ| tena
                            granthi(alajī)kacchapaśālūka(panasikā)pāṣāṇagardabhānāṃ pūrvoktaṃ
                            kāryamityavatiṣṭhate| tāṃśca pakvān ajagallikāṃ ca
                            vraṇavadupakramet|
aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ||4||

mukhadūṣike rodhrādayaḥ pralepaḥ, vaṭapallavayuktā nārikelaśuktayo vā|
                            evamapyanupaśame vamanaṃ nasyaṃ ca hitam| lalāṭe ca sirāmokṣaḥ|

padmakaṇṭake nimbāmbunā kṛtavamano nimbakvāthapakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ sakṣaudraṃ
                            pibet| nimbakarṇikārābhyāṃ lepaḥ|

vivṛtādīn jālāntānnirivellikāṃ ca pittavisarpamiva cikitset| agnirohiṇīṃ
                            ca pratyākhyāya cikitset|
vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca||6||
valmīkaṃ pravṛddhādiguṇaṃ hastapāde jātaṃ ca varjayet|

itarat punarvalmīkaṃ śuddhasya rakte hṛte śyāmādibhiḥ
                            salavaṇakarṇikāraguḍūcībhirlimpet|
pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāśca śodhayet||10||
śastreṇa samyaganu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā||10||

pakve tu [valmīke] duṣṭamāṃsāni sarvāśca gatīḥ śodhayet| kena ? śastreṇa|
                            katham ? samyak| paścāt kṣāreṇāgninā ca (vā)|

cipyaṃ śuddhyā-virekādikayā, jitoṣmāṇaṃ santaṃ śastrakarmaṇā
                            sādhayet|
alase tu caraṇau kañjikasiktau kāsīsādibhiḥ sanimbapatrairālimpet|

lāñchanādiṣu triṣu-lāñchanavyaṅganīlikāsu, yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
                            kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ tvagbhiraṅkuraiśca kṣīrapiṣṭairlepayet|

vyaṅgādiṣu cāyaṃ lepo+arjunavalkaṃ kṣīrapiṣṭaṃ vā| mañjiṣṭhā
                            mākṣikasahitā vā| śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī sanavanītā vā|

raktacandanādayo vyaṅgaharā mukhakāntikarāḥ 'lepāḥ' iti prakṛtatvād
                            gamyate|
dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha||18||
piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mauśalī jaṭā||21||

jīrakadvayādayo lepe prayuktāḥ payasā piṣṭā vaktracandraṃ
                            nirastavyaṅgalāñchanaṃ vidadhati| vaktramevenduḥ, vyaṅgameva
                            lāñchanamiti rūpakālaṅkāraḥ| masūrā bhṛṣṭā nistuṣāśca kṣīrapiṣṭāḥ
                            sarpirmākṣikānvitā lepaḥ| śālmalīkaṇṭakāstīkṣṇāḥ kṣīrapiṣṭā vā lepaḥ|
                            kolasya-amlabadarasya, majjā śaśāsṛkkṣaudrapiṣṭo guḍānvito lepaḥ|
                            saptāhaṃ bījapūrasyāntarasthitaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mākṣikayutaṃ vā lepaḥ| mouśalī
                            jaṭā-śālmalīmūlaṃ, chagalīkṣīrapiṣṭaṃ sakṣaudraṃ vā lepaḥ| gavyamasthi
                            tālapatrīmūlānvitaṃ saghṛtamākṣikaṃ vā lepaḥ
jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ||22||
lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam||22||

jambvāmrapallavādiko lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ| tindukaṃ ca svarasena piṣṭaṃ
                            lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ|

yavādīn darvīlepaṃ yāvad gomūtre pācayet| etadabhyaṅgād drāgeva nīlikādīn
                            hanti| vaktraṃ śatapatrasadṛśaṃ karoti| caraṇau paṅkajapatratulyau
                            vidadhāti|

kuṅkumādikaṃ sanīlotpalamañjiṣṭhaṃ palapramāṇaṃ jalāḍhake paktvā tena
                            pādāvaśeṣeṇa lākṣādibhiśca piṣṭaiḥ kārṣikaistailasya kuḍavaṃ chāgīkṣīraṃ
                            dvikuḍavaṃ pacet| tat-tailaṃ, nasyaṃ śīlitaṃ nīlikādīn hanti|
                            mukhopacayakaraṃ varṇakaraṃ ca|

mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavastuvarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ nepālī
                                haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam||31||

patraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candanayugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ pataṅgaṃ
                                kanakatvacaṃ kamalajaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram||31||

sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasā+a+ajyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu
                                cāgnau||32||

siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅganīlyādināśe vaktre chāyāmaindavīṃ cāśu
                                dhatte||32||

kanakasya tvak-kanakatvak, tāṃ kanakatvacam| mañjiṣṭhādīni vasā ghṛtaṃ
                            majjā gokṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣakvātha etadagnau pakvaṃ vyaṅgādināśe
                            siddhaṃ-avyāhataśakti| mukhasya kāntiṃ cāndramasīṃ śīghraṃ karoti|
                            śārdūlavikrīḍitaśālinyau vṛtte|
prasuptau vātakuṣṭhavihitaṃ kuryāt| vahninā ca dahet|

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma
                            dvātriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||32||

koṭhe ca sarvaṃ kuṣṭhoktamiti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma
                            dvātriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||32||

vanitāsambhogānnivṛttasya sahasā-akasmādeva, strīvyavāyaṃ bhajataḥ| kecit
                            karādinaiva vyavāyābhāsaṃ kurvanti tannivṛttyai strīgrahaṇam| athaveti
                            vakṣyamāṇaguṇāṃ striyaṃ sevamānasya| kimbhūtām ? vātādyadhiṣṭhitastathā
                            saṅkīrṇaḥ-saṅkaṭo, malino+aṇuḥ-sūkṣmo, rajomārgo yasyāstāṃ tathāvidhāṃ
                            striyam| tathā+anyayoni-mahiṣyādim| tathā+anabhilaṣantīm|
                            tathā+agamyāṃ-bhaginyādim| tathā navaprasūtām| tathā dūṣitaṃ
                            saviṣajantvādibhirjalaṃ spṛśato, ratānteṣvapi naiva vā jalaṃ spṛśataḥ|
                            vivardhayitumicchayā tīkṣṇān pralepasekādīn vā prakṛtatvāt guhye
                            prayacchataḥ| tathā muṣṭyādipātanaistathā vegarodhanena tathā
                            dīrghātikharasparśanena ca yāni vighaṭṭanāni, taireva doṣā duṣṭā guhyaṃ
                            prāptāstrayoviṃśati vakṣyamāṇān upadaṃśādīn kurvanti|

atra-eṣu madhye, upadaṃśaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ| katham? ityāha-doṣaiḥ pṛthak
                            trayaḥ, raktena caturthaḥ, sannipātena pañcamaḥ|

eṣāṃ madhye vātenopadaṃśe meḍhre śopho bhavati| dāruṇāḥ pīḍāḥ
                            stambhastathā tvacaḥ paripoṭanam|
śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītalo guruḥ||7||

sarvadoṣaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ śvayathuśca muṣkayoḥ syāt| tīvrā ruk
                            śīghrapākādiśca|
eteṣāṃ madhye raktajo yāpyaḥ| sannipātottho mṛtyuhetuḥ|

doṣairguhyaraktamāṃsāśrayaiḥ kruddhairmeḍhrasyāntarbahirvā kaṇḍūlā
                            māṃsakīlakāḥ-śaṅkavo, jāyante| tathā picchilaraktasrāviṇaḥ| tathaiva
                            yonau chatrasadṛśāḥ syuḥ| te māṃsakīlā arśāṃsi gadyante| upekṣitāśca
                            meḍhre jātāḥ puṃstvaṃ ghnanti| bhage jātā ārtavaṃ ghnanti|

guhyasya bāhyato+antare vā kapharaktajāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapapramaṇāḥ
                            sarṣapākārā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ|
piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataśca yāḥ||12||

piṭikā bahavo dīrghā madhye ca yā dīryante, so+avamantho vedanāromāñcavān
                            kapharaktābhyāṃ syāt|
uttamākhyāṃ pittaraktajāṃ meḍhrapiṭikāṃ māṣasamāṃ mudgābhāṃ vidyāt|

piṭikācitā yā piṭikā syāt, tathā padmakarṇikākārā puṣkarakarkaṭābhā, tāṃ
                            puṣkariketi vidyāt|

yā piṭikā viṣamā samunnatā tathā kaṭhinā kuṭilā ca pavanenāṣṭhīlikā
                            gaditā|

vāyunā vimardanādiduṣṭena meḍhrajaṃ carma sarugdāhaṃ nivartate|
                            kvacit-kadācit, pākamapi yāti| tat-carma, maṇeradhaḥ piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ
                            pralambaṃ ca syāt| tatsakaphaṃ-kaphena tu saha, kaṇḍūkāṭhinyayutaṃ
                            nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ syāt|
kṛcchreṇa rohati yacca duḥsphuṭitaṃ carma, tat kathitamavapāṭikā|
vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet||19||

vātena carma dūṣitaṃ maṇau saktaṃ cet sroto ruṇaddhi| tato
                            mandadhāramarujaṃ mūtrameti| maṇeśca vikāśarodhaḥ| sa evaṃ vidho rogo
                            niruddhamaṇisaṃjñaḥ|
liṅgaṃ śūkairākīrṇamiva syāt, tad grathitasaṃjñaṃ kaphajam|

yatpunarmeḍhraṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ sarvataḥ-paritaḥ, citaṃ
                            vātaśoṇitakopāt, taṃ śataponakaṃ vidyāt|

īṣallohitaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiśca pīḍitaṃ liṅgaṃ vedanāśca
                            dāruṇāḥ, taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ, raktārbudaṃ jānīyāt|

māṃsārbudaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ granthyādirogavijñānīye(u. a.29)| tacca
                            tridoṣajam|
vidradhiśca tridoṣajaḥ| sa ukto vidradhyādinidāne (ni. a. 11/9)|

liṅge kṛṣṇāni māṃsāni bhūtvā parito viśīryante pakvāni sannipātena|
                            tān-evaṃprakārān, tilakālakān vidyāt|

eṣāṃ madhye māṃsārbudādīṃścaturastyajet-nopakramet| śeṣān-ṣoḍaśa rogān,
                            śīghramupakramet|
srasaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca||30||
tāṃstāṃśca svān gadān vyāpadvātikī nāma sā smṛtā||31||

viṣamasthāṅgaśayanādibhiryonau pavanaḥ kupito rujādīn kuryāt| tathā
                            pipīlikopasarpaṇamiva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanaṃ, tathā
                            phenilādiguṇārtavasrutiṃ, tathā vaṅkṣaṇādau bhraṃśaṃ rujāṃ, krameṇa ca
                            gulmaṃ kuryāt| taṃstāṃśca-anekavidhān, rogan kuryāt| sā-evaṃvidhā,
                            vyāpat vātikī smṛtā|

maithunādatibālāyāḥ pavanaḥ pṛṣṭhajaṅghoruvaṅkṣaṇaṃ pīḍayan yoniṃ
                            sandūṣayet| prākcaraṇeti sā syāt|

vegodāvartanena māruto yoniṃ prakarṣeṇa pīḍayati| tataḥ sā-yoniḥ,
                            phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrādudāvṛttaṃ visṛjati| eṣā vyāpadudāvṛttākhyā|

yadā tu vāyuḥ sutamutpannamutpannaṃ raukṣyādduṣṭārtavajaṃ hanti, tadā
                            jātaghnī syāt|

atisuhitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyā nidhuvane pavano+annenotpīḍito yoneḥ
                            sambandhini srotasi sthito mukhaṃ yonereva vakrīkuryāt, asthimāṃsena
                            saha dāruṇapīḍaṃ, sā+antarmukhītyucyate|

vātalāhārasevinyāṃ mātari vāyuḥ kupitaḥ striyo garbhasthāyāḥ sūkṣmadvārāṃ
                            yoni kuryāt| sūcīmukhī sā syāt|
karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sā+ativedanā||38||

ṛtau vegadhāraṇādvāyurduṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṅgrahaṃ karoti| yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca
                            karoti| sā śuṣkasaṃjñā+atirujā syāt|
vametsaruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā||39||

ṣaḍahenāthavā saptāhena garbhāśayādvāyuḥ sarujo nīrujo vā yasyāḥ śukraṃ
                            vamet, sā vāminī gaditā|

vātopataptāyāṃ yonau strīgarbhe bījadoṣānnaradveṣiṇī stanarahitā ca strī
                            syāt| sa ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñā+anupakramā|
duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ||40||

pavano duṣṭo yonyāsyaṃ viṣṭabhya garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca vivṛtamukhīṃ bhraṣṭāṃ
                            vātikīmiva suduḥkhāmutsṛṣṭapiśitāṃ prakṛtatvādyoniṃ kurute| tāṃ
                            mahārujāṃ mahāyoniṃ vadanti|

yathāyogaṃ dūṣaṇaiḥ-sarvaroganidānādyuktaiḥ, duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonau sthitaṃ
                            yoniṃ dāhādyanvitāṃ karoti, tathā bhṛśoṣṇādiguṇayutārtavām| sā paittikī
                            vyāpat|

śleṣmā+abhiṣyandakaraṇahetubhiḥ kupito yoniṃ pīḍārahitāṃ śītalādiguṇāṃ
                            tathā tadvidhā-pāṇḍupicchilā, srutiryasyāstāṃ tathāvidhāṃ kuryāt|
                            sā-evaṃvidhā, vyāpat ślaiṣmikī syāt|

yasyāḥ vātapittābhyāṃ rajaḥ kṣīyate dāhakārśyavaivarṇyayutaṃ, sā
                            lohitakṣayākhyā|

pittalāyāḥ striyā narasaṃyoge kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt pittānvitena vāyunā
                            yonirdūṣitā śūnādiguṇā bastyādigurutvādividhāyinī tathā śroṇyāditodakarī
                            syāt| sā pariplutākhyā|

akṣālanāttu yoniḥ sambhūtakṛmiḥ kaṇḍūyutā, kaṇḍvā ca hetunā sutarāṃ
                            suratābhilāṣiṇī viplutākhyā|

marudakālavāhanāt kapharaktamiśrito yonau karṇikāṃ rajomārganirodhinīṃ
                            kuryāt| sā karṇinī gadyate|
iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati||52||
tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃścāpnoti dāruṇān||52||

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma
                            trayastriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||33||

iti- samāptau| evaṃ yonirogāḥ 'kathitāḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| yairāmayairyoniḥ
                            śukraṃ na pratīcchati| tato garbhaṃ nādatte| rogāṃśca
                            dāruṇānasṛgdarādīnaśrute| vātapittakaphaiścābādhān-pīḍāviśeṣān,
                            prāpnoti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma
                            trayāstriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 33||
śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ||1||

upadaṃśe+acirodbhūte liṅgasya madhye sirāṃ mokṣayet| śiśirāṃ ca cikitsāṃ
                            lepasekādibhiḥ kuryāt| viśeṣeṇa virecanena śuddhiṃ vidadhīta| pakve
                            pāṭite ca tilakalkājyamadhubhirlepaḥ|
tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacejjale||3||
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ, tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam||4||

jambvādyaṅkurān śallakyādīnāṃ tvacaḥ kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tvacastriphalāṃ ca
                            jale pacet| sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| tena ca kvāthena tailaṃ pakvaṃ
                            ropaṇaṃ syāt|
kapāle triphalā dagdhā saghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param||6||
karpare triphalā dagdhā ghṛtānvitā paraṃ ropaṇam|

sāmānyametat sādhanam| sa0- pratidoṣaṃ tu śophatulyaṃ cikitsitaṃ
                            jñeyam|
na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam||7||
pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ||7||

yathā ca pākaṃ na yāti tathā+atiyatnaḥ kāryaḥ| yataḥ pakvaiḥ snāyvādibhiḥ
                            prāyeṇa meḍhro naśyati|
arśasāṃ chinnānāṃ dagdhānāṃ copadaṃśatulyā kriyā kāryā|

sarṣapikāḥ śastreṇa likhitāḥ kaṣāyadravyairjambvādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ
                            sūkṣmacūrṇairavacūrṇayet| taireva kaṣāyaistailaṃ pacet| tadabhyañjanaṃ
                            vraṇaropaṇaṃ syāt|

kumbhīkāyāṃ lohitaṃ mokṣayet| pakvāyāṃ tu vraṇe śodhite sati
                            tindukādibhirlepaḥ| tindukādibhireva siddhaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇaṃ syāt|

uttamākhyāṃ piṭikāṃ baḍiśoddhṛtāṃ samyak chedayitvā kaṣāyāṇāṃ
                            kalkaiścūrṇaiḥ kṣaudrayuktairupakramet|

puṣkarikāyāṃ saṃvyūḍhe ca pittavisarpavihitaṃ cikitsitaṃ hitam|
                            saṃ-tvakpākasparśahānyoḥ secanam|

mṛditaṃ nāma liṅgarogaṃ vakṣyamāṇena (ślo.42) balā tailena secayet| tathā
                            madhurairdravyaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sukhoṣṇairghṛtasnigdhairupanāhaśca
                            kāryaḥ|
svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet||15||
maṇau punaḥpunaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate||16||

nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ liṅgarogaṃ ghṛtenābhyajya svedayitvā copanāhayet trirātraṃ
                            pañcarātraṃ vā susnigdhaiḥ śālvalādibhiḥ| tato bhūyaḥ svedayitvā
                            snigdhaṃ carma maṇiṃ samānayet| kiṃ kṛtvā ? maṇiṃ śanaiḥ prapīḍya|
                            praviṣṭe maṇau copanāhaṃ punaḥpunaḥ kuryāt| bhojanaṃ cātra snigdhaṃ
                            hitam|

niruddhe-niruddhākhye niruddhamaṇau, nāḍīṃ dvidvārāṃ jatunā sṛtāṃ liptāḥ
                            snehāktāṃ liṅge nyasya liṅgaṃ balātailādibhiḥ snehaiḥ siñcet|
                            tryahāttryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nāḍīṃ kṣiptvā srotodvāraṃ vṛddhiṃ nayet|
                            evamapyasiddhau dhīmān vaidyaḥ sevanīṃ pariharan śastreṇa pāṭayet|
                            tataḥ-pāṭanādanantaraṃ, sadyaḥkṣatavidhānaṃ yuñyāt|

yonivyāpatsu viṣaye prāyeṇa pavanavijayi cikitsitaṃ yuktam| snehanādi
                            vātotthāsu vyāpattiṣu viśeṣeṇa śasyate| saṃ-yato vātamantareṇa yoṣito
                            yonirna duṣyati| tasmāttaṃ mārutaṃ, jitvā parasya doṣasyauṣadhaṃ
                            kuryāt|

tāṃ-striyaṃ, balātailaṃ (ci. a.21/73), miśrakākhyaṃ(ci. a.14/89), vā,
                            sukumārakāhvayaṃ (ci. a.13/41), pāyayet| tathā yoniṃ snigdhāṃ svinnāṃ ca
                            duḥsthitāṃ samāṃ sthāpayet| jihyāṃ-kuṭilāṃ yoniṃ, hastena namayet|
                            saṃvṛtāṃ tu vyadhayet-prasārayedityarthaḥ| niḥsṛtāṃ ca praveśayet|
                            vivṛtāṃ tu satīṃ parivartayet| yataḥ sthānād bhraṣṭā yoniḥ striyaḥ
                            śalyarūpā bhavet|

vamanādīni ca karmāṇi mṛdūni-akharāṇi, strī(striyā) kārayitavyā(ni)|
                            sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭācca, viśuddhāyā nāryāḥ pariśiṣṭaṃ
                            karma-bastyādikaṃ, kriyate|

kāśmaryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ kārṣikairghṛtātprasthaṃ pacet| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pītaṃ
                            yonivātavikāraharaṃ suṣṭhu garbhadaṃ ca|

vacādikaṃ piṣṭvā prasannayā+a+aloḍya ghṛtabharjitaṃ khādet
                            yonipārśvārtyādiśāntaye|

vṛṣakādīni madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet| tathā pippalī sthūlajīrake vā
                            madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet|
guḍūcyādibhiḥ kvāthaiḥ pariṣecanaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ hitam, prakṛtatvādyoneḥ|
śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca||35||

pittalānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ śītādikāḥ kriyāḥ sekādyāḥ kāryāḥ| snehanārthaṃ
                            ghṛtāni ca deyāni|

śatāvarīmūlatulācatuṣṭayāt kṣuṇṇapīḍitād rasena dugdhasamena sarpiṣa
                            āḍhakaṃ pacejjīvanīyādibhiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ| pakve śīte ca
                            mākṣikapalāṣṭakaṃ, kaṇāṣṭapalaṃ, sitāpalāni ca daśa, kṣipet| tasmācca
                            karṣamātraṃ lihyāt yonyādidoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyādiguṇaṃ ca|
garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam||41||

anenaiva krameṇa kṣīraṃ sarpirvā jīvanīyaiḥ pakvaṃ garbhapradaṃ
                            pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paraṃ hitam|
vātapittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat||44||

balāyā droṇadvayasya kaṣāye ghṛtatailayorāḍhakaṃ pacet| kṣīre caturāḍhake
                            kṛṣṇādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayoktapramāṇaiḥ| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pānena
                            vātapittarogān hatvā garbhaṃ dhatte| mudgādīnāṃ parṇyā pratyekaṃ
                            sambandhaḥ,- mudgaparṇī pīluparṇī māṣaparṇīti|

raktayonyāṃ lohitaṃ varṇairlakṣayitvā+anubandhaṃ ca yathādoṣodayaṃ,
                            raktasthāpanaṃ bheṣajaṃ prayuñjīta|
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃśca nāśayet||49||

pāṭhādikaṃ puṣye gṛhītvā sañcūrṇya kṣaudrānvitaṃ tandulāmbhasā pibet
                            arśoviṣayādiṣu| ye ca doṣā jantukṛtā bālānāṃ, tāṃśca yonidoṣādīn hanti|
                            puṣyānugasaṃjñametaccūrṇaṃ hitamātreyapūjitaṃ ca| sa0- yonyāṃ balāsenā
                            duṣṭāyāṃ sarvameva rūkṣoṣṇaṃ hitam|
tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā||53||

dhātakyādibhiḥ kārṣikaiśchāgamūtre dviguṇe, kṣīre ca dviguṇe,
                            tailaprasthaṃ pacet| tattailamabhyaṅgādiṣu yojyam| anena tailena
                            śūnādiguṇā yoniḥ sidhyati|

palāśādijaścūrṇo durgandhādiṣu stambhanamiṣyate| āragvadhādivargakvātho
                            (hṛ.sū. a. 15/17) durgandhādau pariṣekaḥ|

stambdhānāṃ kharasparśānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ mṛdutvakaraṃ vesavārādidhāraṇaṃ
                            vidheyam| vesavāraḥ-kuṭṭitasvinnasaṃskṛtamāṃsaviśeṣaḥ| kṛsarā ca pāyasaṃ
                            ca kṛsarāpāyasam|
durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāttailaṃ vā kalka eva vā||59||

durgandhānāṃ yonīnāṃ sarvagandhadravyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaḥ-kvātho, hitaḥ|
                            tatpakvaṃ tailaṃ tatkalka eva vā| athavā sarvagandhānāṃ cūrṇaḥ
                            pūtigandhā(ndhya) pahaḥ|

śleṣmalānāṃ yonīnāṃ kaṭuprāyā gomūtrayutāśca bastayo hitāḥ| pitte
                            madhuyaṣṭīkṣīrayuktā bastayaḥ| vāte tailāmlayutā bastayo hitāḥ|
evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ||61||

evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, yoniṣu viśuddhāsu satīṣu striyo garbhaṃ labhante|
                            prākṛte bīje+aduṣṭe sati tathā jīvasyopakramaṇe kṣepe sati|

narasya pañcabhiḥ karmabhiḥ śuddhasya, indriyaṃ,śukraṃ, doṣāṇāṃ
                            varṇairduṣṭaṃ parīkṣya tadghnaiḥ-doṣaghnaiḥ, upakramet|
dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm||64||
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param||66||
phalasarpiriti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat||66||

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogapratiṣedho nāma
                            catustriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||34||

mañjiṣṭādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ piṣṭairghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇaṃ pacet|
                            taddhṛtaṃ sarveṣu yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu śasyate| āyuṣyādi guṇaṃ paraṃ
                            puṃsavanaṃ mriyamāṇagarbhāṇāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca hitam| phalasarpiriti nāmnā
                            prasiddham| kutaḥ ? yasmāt puṣpe-ārtavasamaye, pītaṃ phalāya jāyate|
                            tathā paraṃ bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ śarīravṛddhikaraṃ ceti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyaroga pratiṣedho nāma
                            catustriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 34||

samudre surāsurairamṛtārthaṃ viloḍyamāne+amṛtotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ puruṣo
                            dāruṇadṛṣṭiḥ samiddhadhāmā caturdaṃṣṭro harivarṇakaco dahanatulyanetro
                            jātaḥ| taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvanaṃ viṣādaṃ gatam| ata evāsau
                            jagadviṣadanāt viṣasaṃjñaḥ| brahmaṇa huṃkṛtastu sannasau
                            vañcanasvabhāvaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ hitvā sthāvarajaṅgamākhye mūrtī adhitasthau|
                            puruṣarupī tiṣṭhedasau tato brahmā śāpaṃ dadyāt|

yadviṣaṃ sthiraṃ-sthāvaraṃ, kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitaṃ vīrye atyulbaṇaṃ tat
                            kālakūṭādibhedabhinnam| phalādiṣvapi tad bhavati, kintu kande
                            vīryātikṛt| ādiśabdena saṅgrahoktā bhedā gṛhyante| yathā (saṃ.u. a.
                            40)-"kālakūṭaṃ vatsanābhaṃ sāktukaṃ vālakaṃ kardamakaṃ vairāṭaṃ mustakaṃ
                            śṛṅgī puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāviṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ markaṭakaṃ karkaṭaṃ
                            kāśapuṣpakamindrāyudhaṃ tathā tailam|" iti (tyādi) bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|
                            eṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ tatroktam| tadahi vistarataragranthaśaṅkayā noktam|

sarpādidaṃṣṭrāsu tu yadvyavasthitaṃ tajjaṅgamam| tacca dāruṇam|
                            daṃṣṭretyupalakṣaṇārtham, nakhaviṣāṇamūtrādīnāmapi puro viṣatvena
                            vakṣyamāṇatvāt|

garasaṃjñaṃ tu kṛtrimam| yasmāttat kriyate| ata eva vividhāni
                            vakṣyamāṇānyauṣadhāni yasmiṃstadevam| tacca yogavaśācchīghraṃ hanti|
                            tathā vividhayogavaśāccirācciraṃ hanti| śophādīṃśca vidhatte|

tatsarvaṃ viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiguṇaṃ syāt| guṇanirdeśanādasya
                            raukṣyādvātamuṣṇatvāt pittaṃ karotīti jñāpyate| nanu,
                            raukṣyādibhirguṇairvāyoḥ kopo na yujyate, raukṣyādīnāṃ guṇatvādvāyośca
                            dravyatvāt| brūmaḥ| vāyorye raukṣyādayo guṇāsteṣāmeva viṣasthai
                            raukṣyādibhirguṇairvṛddhiḥ kriyate| te ca vāyorātmabhūtāḥ, tannāśe
                            vāyornāśaḥ syāt, yathā tantunāśe paṭanāśaḥ| tasmādyuktaḥ pavanasya
                            raukṣyādibhirguṇaiḥ prakopaḥ| evaṃ pitte+api yojyam|
                            kaṭvamlādikathane+api viṣasyāvyaktarasatvam, anekarasasambhavādekasyāpi
                            ca vyaktasyānupalabdheḥ| vyavāyitvaṃ cāsya drāgevākhilakāyasya vyāpteḥ|
                            tathā apāki,-viṣasya hi mantratantrābhyāmantareṇa pākābhāvāt,
                            pakve+apyanne viṣasyāpakvasyevopalabdheḥ| ata eva śamitamapi
                            kiñcitkāraṇaṃ prāpya punaḥ kupyati|

tathā viṣamojaso viparītaṃ tīkṣṇādibhirdaśabhirguṇairyuktam|
                            tīkṣṇādyairanvitamiti hetau prathamā| tīkṣṇādiguṇayuktatvādojaso
                            viparītamityarthaḥ| tathā vātapittotaraṃ narāṇāṃ drāgeva jīvitaṃ
                            harati|
viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam||9||

yasmādviṣaṃ śarīraṃ prāpya pūrvaṃ raktaṃ sarvaśarīragataṃ dūṣayati,
                            paścāt kaphapittavātānāśayasahitān dūṣayati| anantaraṃ kaphādibhiḥ
                            samameva hṛdayamāśritya śariranāśāya sampadyate| nanu, viṣasya
                            tīkṣṇādibhirguṇairyugapat tridoṣakopitvādraktakopitvācca pūrvaṃ śoṇitaṃ
                            dūṣayati paścātrīn doṣāniti yaduktaṃ tadayuktimadiva dṛśyate| atra
                            bhaṇāmaḥ viṣaprabhāveṇa raktamākṛṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ saha tena saṃyuktaṃ viṣeṇa
                            dūṣyate, tato yugapadeva doṣatrayakopaḥ, tato doṣaiḥ śoṇitena saha
                            hṛdayaṃ vyāpya sarvasrotāṃsi baddhvā dehocśedāya pravartata iti na
                            kiñcidatrānupapannam|
jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrcchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ||11||
sthāvarasya viṣasyopayuktasya prathame vege rasanāśyāvatādi jāyate|
dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā||12||
viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām||12||

dvitīye vege vepathvādayaḥ| viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ hṛdaye vedanāṃ
                            vidhatte|
durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane||13||

tṛtīye ca vege tāluśoṣaḥ āmāśaye+atirujā syāt| netre cāsya durbalādiguṇe
                            bhavataḥ| pakvāśayagate todādayaḥ syuḥ|

caturthe vege mūrdhno+atigurutvaṃ jāyate| caśabdāt pūrvoktā
                            rasanāśayāvatādayaḥ syuḥ| evamagre+api caśabdārtho bodhyaḥ|

pañcame vege kaphaprasekādiḥ| sarvadoṣāṇāṃ prakopaḥ| pūrvoktāśca|
                            pakvāśaye vyathā ca|
saptame skandhādibhaṅgaḥ, saptānāṃ dhātūnāṃ dūṣaṇānmṛtyuśca syāt|

prathame viṣavege tu kṛtavamanaṃ śiśirajalasecitaṃ śīghramevāgadaṃ
                            saghṛtamākṣikaṃ pāyayet|

dvitīye viṣavege pūrvavat-śītāmbusecitaṃ, vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānu-paścāt,
                            agadaṃ pāyayet|
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ kṣipet||20||

saptame vege+avapīḍo-rogānutpādanīyokto (hṛ.sū. a. 4/6), deyaḥ| athavā
                            mastake kākapadaṃ kṛtvā saraktaṃ piśitaṃ nyaset|

kośātakyādīnāṃ kvāthe yavāgūṃ siddhāṃ śītāṃ sasarpiṣkamākṣikāṃ yuñjayāt|
                            sūryavallī-karavīrakākārapuṣpī| kṣaudrasāhvayaṃ-vaṭamākṣikam|
                            vegāntare-vegamadhye, sarvaviṣaghnīm| kṛtaṃ karma yasya tasyaivaṃ
                            kāryam|
namo vaidūryamāte huluhulu rakṣa māṃ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ||29||

añjanādīni dravyāṇi| kanyā kṛtopavāsā snātāśuklavastrā
                            taiḥ-pūrvoktairdravyaiḥ, mākṣikasiktaiḥ puṣyanakṣatre viprān
                            pūjayitvā+anantaramagadavaramimaṃ kalpayet| vaidyaśca samīpastho mantraṃ
                            nama ityādikaṃ paṭhet| piṣṭe cāgade dvitīyo mantro harimāyyādiko+atra
                            yojyaḥ| nikhileṣu viṣādiṣu pānādimaṇibandhādi yojito+ayaṃ candrodayo
                            nāmāgadaḥ paraṃ śāntaṃ(nti) svastyayanam|

svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣiviṣākhyāṃ
                                viṣamabhyupaiti||33||

mūrcchan vaman gadgadavāk vimuhyan bhavecca
                                dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ||35||

bhavennaro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā
                                vihaṅgaḥ||36||

sthitaṃ rasādiṣvathavā vicitrān karoti dhātuprabhavān
                                vikārān||36||

yadviṣaṃ purāṇaṃ, viṣaghnauṣadhibhirvā hatavīryaṃ, yadvā dāvāgnītyādibhiḥ
                            śoṣitaṃ, svabhavenaiva vā guṇairna suṣṭhu yuktaṃ, tad
                            dūṣīviṣasaṃjñāmupaiti| tathā vīryasyālpatvādetadavibhāvyaṃ-alakṣyam|
                            tathā kaphenāvṛtaṃ varṣavṛndaṃ ca tatsthāyi| tena-dūṣīviṣeṇa, pīḍito
                            bhinnapurīṣavarṇādikaḥ syāt| tathā mūrcchāṃ gacchan vamannasphuṭavāk
                            tathā vimuhyan tathā dūṣyenopalakṣita udare yāni liṅgāni (hṛ.ni. a.
                            12/20), taiḥ sevitaśca bhavet| āmāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe kaphavātarogī syāt
                            pakvāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe+anilapittarogī syāt| upajātayaḥ| dhvastāḥ kacāḥ
                            śarīraṃ ca yasya sa dhvastaśirotuhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ pakṣīva bhavet|
                            rasādiṣu ca sthitaṃ nānāvidhān dhātuprabhavān vikārān karoti|
                            upendravajrāvṛttam|

tacca purovātādibhirduṣṭaṃ saddhātūn dūṣayati yataḥ, tato+api
                            hetordūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam|

dūṣīviṣapīḍitaṃ naraṃ susvinnamūrdhvamadhastācca śodhitaṃ santaṃ
                            dūṣīviṣāri-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, mākṣikeṇāplutamagadaṃ lehayet|

pippalyādiko+ayamagado nāmnā dūṣīviṣāriḥ| na cānyasminnapi vāryate| kintu
                            viśeṣeṇa prayujyate|
śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām||44||

viṣadigdhena-viṣaliptena śastreṇa, viddho naraḥ punaḥpunaḥ pratāmyati|
                            tathā vaivarṇyaṃ prayāti| drāgeva viṣādameti| asya ca-viṣadigdhena
                            viddhasya, śarīraṃ kīṭairiva vyāptaṃ cimicimāyate| śroṇyādayaścāsya
                            sarujāḥ syuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ kṣarati| tṛḍādiyutaḥ kṣaṇenaiva ca
                            dṛṣṭikāluṣyādikaraḥ syāt| tathā vraṇa īṣadraktaprayantaḥ śyāvamadhyo
                            mahārujaḥ syāt| tathā śūyate pākaṃ yāti| teṣāṃ sadya eva ca māṃsaṃ
                            kṛṣṇatāṃ gatvā praklinnaṃ saddīryate nityameva picchilayutaṃ parisravaṃ
                            kuryāt|

amarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutaṃ vidadhīta| sa0- śalyamākṛṣya taptena
                            lohena vraṇaṃ paścāddahet| athavā muṣkakādikṣāreṇa pratisārayet|
                            śukanāsādibhiśca lepayet vraṇam|
vraṇe ca pūtimāṃse pittavisarpa iva cikitsā kāryā|

nānākāntāḥ yoṣitaḥ patye saubhāgyārthaṃ rājñaśca(rājñe vā) nikaṭavartino
                            narāścārātipreritā garayuktaṃ bhojanaṃ dadati|
viṣāṇāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ yogo gara iti smṛtaḥ||50||

nānāprakāraprāṇyaṅgaśakṛtāṃ tathā viruddhauṣadhibhasmanāṃ viṣāṇāṃ ca
                            stokavīryāṇāṃ yo yogaḥ, sa gara iti smṛtaḥ|
manyate kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ gauro, goraṃ ca kālakaḥ||53||

tena gareṇa pāṇḍvādiguṇaḥ kāsādipīḍitaśca syāt| vātena pratilomena
                            yuktastathā svapnacintāparaḥ syāt| tathā bṛhajjaṭharayakṛtplīhavān
                            dīnavāgādiguṇaśca syāt| svapne śṛgālādīn paśyati| prāyeṇa
                            śuṣkavṛkṣodapānāni lokate| ātmānaṃ ca gauraḥ san kṛṣṇaṃ manyate|
                            kṛṣṇaśca gauraṃ manyate| tena-garaviṣeṇa, vihatendriyaḥ san
                            vikarṇaghrāṇacakṣuṣaṃ paśyet|

etaiḥ-uktairupadravaiḥ, aparaiścānuktairdāruṇaiḥ kliṣṭaḥ san garapīḍitaḥ
                            kaścidacikitsitaḥ sadya eva nāśamaśnute|

garāturaḥ kṛtavamanaḥ san tat-pūrvoktaṃ, pathyaṃ pānabhojanaṃ bhuktvā
                            śuddhahṛdayaḥ suvarṇaṃ śīlayet| kiṃ kurvan ?
                            sūtrasthānoktavidheḥ-"śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet|"
                            (hṛ.sū. a. 7/28) iti smaran| vidheḥ smarannityatra "adhīgartha-"
                            ityādinā vidhiśabdāt karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|

mākṣīkadhātukāñcanayoścūrṇaṃ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaṃ leho dāruṇaṃ
                            garayogajaṃ viṣaṃ hanti|

mūrvādīni takrādibhiramlena vā-bījapūrarasādirasena, garopahatāgniḥ pumān
                            pibet|

viṣaprakṛtyādiyoge sati viṣasaṅkaṭaṃ kathitam| [atra-] asmiṃśca
                            viṣasaṅkaṭe, viṣārtaḥ śatamadhya eko jīvet| tatra
                            viṣaprakṛtiḥ-pittaprakṛtiḥ| kālo-varṣāḥ| viṣānnaṃ-sarṣapādi|
                            viṣadoṣaḥ-pittam| dūṣyaṃ-raktam| ādiśabdena sātmyādīnāṃ grahaṇam|

prāvṛṣi ca jalaprabhavatvādviṣaṃ saṃkledaṃ guḍavad yāti|
                            visarpati-prasarati, ghanāpāye-vigatavarṣāsamaye| tat-viṣaṃ, agastyo
                            hinasti-alpaśakti karoti| tasmādghanātyaye-śaratsamaye, mandavīryatvaṃ
                            prayāti|

iti-evaṃ pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, prakṛtyādikaṃ buddhvā-yatnena nirūpya,
                            tataḥ karma kuryāt|

ślaiṣmikaṃ viṣaṃ vamanairuṣṇādiguṇaiḥ pralepaiśceddaśairbhojanaiśca
                            kaṣāyādiguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ nayet|

paittikaṃ viṣaṃ virecanaistathā+atiśītalaiḥ sekaiḥ pralepaiśca tathā
                            bhojanaiḥ kaṣāyatiktamadhurairājyayutaiśca śamayet|

viṣe sraṃsanaṃ-virecanaṃ, pralepo vā bhojyamauṣadhaṃ vā nāghṛtaṃ śastam|
                            kiṃ tarhi ? sarvameva tat saghṛtaṃ śastam| sa0- sarveṣu viṣeṣu
                            sarvāvastheṣu ca ghṛtatulyaṃ nānyadauṣadhaṃ kimapyasti| viśeṣeṇa ca
                            vāte+atirikte|

tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma
                                pañcatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||35||

kaphagataṃ viṣamalpayatnena sādhyam| pittāśayāśrayaṃ yatnena sādhyam|
                            vātāśayāśritaṃ suṣṭhu duḥkhena sādhyate+asādhyaṃ vā syāditi| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma
                            pañcatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 35||
tridhā samāsato bhaumāḥ, bhidyante te tvanekadhā||1||

darvīkarādibhedena bujaṅgāḥ saṅkṣepeṇa triprakārā bhaumāḥ| te tu
                            yonibhedena vistarato+anekadhā bhidyante| viśeṣāścehānupayogino yataḥ,
                            tato na nigadyante|

darvīkaramaṇḍalirājīmantasteṣāṃ viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ krameṇa ca
                            vātapittakaphānāṃ kopanaṃ syāt| yadyapi viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ,
                            tathā+apyatiśayārthaṃ punariha guṇakathanam| viśeṣācca viṣaṃ hyuṣṇameva
                            kathitaṃ na śītalam|

ete ca-darvīkarādyayaḥ, tāruṇyādiṣu yathākramaṃ vṛṣṭyādiṣu ca viṣolbaṇā
                            bhavanti| vṛṣṭiśabdeneha śrāvaṇādayaścatvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| evaṃ
                            śītātapadyāścatvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| vyantarāḥ-vijātayaḥ, ṛtusandhiṣu
                            viṣādhikāḥ syuḥ| ṛtusandhiḥprāguktaḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 3/58)|

rathāṅgādidhāriṇaḥ phaṇāvanto drutagatayo bhujaṅgā darvīkarā iti munibhiḥ
                            smṛtāḥ|

abhogāḥ-alpabhogāḥ tathā nānāprakārairmaṇḍalaiścitāḥ
                            prāṃśavo+aśīghragatayo maṇḍalino vedyāḥ|

vijātayo+adhunocyante - godhāsutastu gaudhero viṣe darvīkaraiḥ
                                samaḥ||7||

godhāputro gaudheraḥ| nanu, gaudhera iti nāmnaiva godhāsutaḥ pratyapādi|
                            tathā ca "godhāyā ḍhrak" ityapatyārthavyutpādito+ayam| satyamāha bhavān|
                            yādṛcchikanāmaśaṅkānirāsāya tvetat| sa ca darvīkarairviṣeṇa tulyaḥ,
                            taireva jātatvāt| catuṣpāt-catuṣpādo+asau|

vyantarāṃścaiteṣāmeva saṅkareṇa jānīyāt| yataśca te saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇāḥ|
                            tasmāt sannipātaprakopānāḥ syuḥ|

āhārādibhiḥ kāraṇairbhujaṅgā daśanti| teṣu yathottaraṃ viṣasyādhikyaṃ
                            kathitam|
ādiṣṭāt sarpāt hetuṃ viditvā viditvā yathāsvaṃ cikitset|
daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ, trīṇi tāni tu||12||

yasmin kāye lālāparikledamātram upalabhyate, na punardaṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśam|
                            tat-evaṃbhūtaṃ, tuṇḍāhataṃ kathayanti| ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā
                            daṃṣṭrāpade raktavarjite tad vyālīḍhasaṃjñam| dve damṣṭrāpade saśoṇite
                            vyāluptaṃ vidyāt| trīṇi tu daṃṣṭrāpadāni māṃsacchedāt santatāsravāhīni
                            daṣṭakamādiśet| daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvat-daṣṭakamiva, daṣṭanipīḍitaṃ
                            syāt| eṣu madhye dvayamādikathitaṃ nirviṣaṃ vadet|
                            paścimaṃ-daṣṭanipīḍitākhyaṃ, asādhyaṃ vadet| vyāluptadaṣṭakaṃ tu
                            kṛcchrasādhyamityarthādgamyate|

sarpajaṃ viṣaṃ na śoṇitamaprāpya śarīraṃ dūṣayate, api tu prāpya| kintu
                            raktaṃ stokamapi prāpya viṣaṃ vardhate| yathā tailaṃ jalaṃ prāpya
                            prasarati tathaiva| āheyamiti "dṛtikukṣi" ityādinā bhavārthe ḍhañ|

bhīroḥ-sabhayasya puṃsaḥ, sarpasaṃsparśāddhetoryadbhayaṃ tena vāyuḥ
                            kruddhaḥ kadācicchophaṃ vidhatte| tat sarpāṅgābhihataṃ syāt|

durgāndhakāre kenacitprāṇinā viddhasya daṣṭaśaṅkayā viṣodvegādayaḥ syuḥ,
                            tacchaṅkāviṣaṃ nigadyate|

saviṣo daṃśo vyathyate, kaṇḍvādiyuto dahyate, jālakavat kiñcit grathitaḥ|
                            asmādviparītaśca nirviṣaḥ syāt|
śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ||19||
dvitīye granthayo vege, tṛtīye mūrdhni gauravam||20||
dāho hidhmā ca, ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam||21||
mūrcchā vipāko+atīsāraḥ, prāpya śukraṃ tu saptame||22||

darvīkarāṇāṃ prathame viṣavege śyāvavarṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ syāt| tena
                            ca-tādṛśā raktena, mukhanayanādau śyāvatā syāt| kīṭakāśca gātre
                            sarpantīva| dvitīye viṣavege granthayaḥ syuḥ| tṛtīye śirogurutvādayaḥ
                            syuḥ| caturthe ṣṭhīvanādayaḥ| pañcame sandhiviśleṣaṇaṃ tandrā
                            parvabhedanaṃ dāho hikkā ca| ṣaṣṭhe ca vege hṛdayapīḍādyāḥ| saptame
                            śukraṃ prāpya skandhādibhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭānivartanaṃ syāt|

maṇḍalinā daṣṭasya prathame vege raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pītībhavati| tena ca
                            raktena pītāṅgatā dāhaśca| dvitīye śvayathūdbhūtiḥ| tṛtīye
                            daṃśavikledādayaḥ| caturthe vege jvaro dāhaḥ| pañcame sarvaśarīragato
                            dāhaḥ|
pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ, dvitīye gurutā+ati ca||25||

rājimatā duṣṭasya raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gaccati| tena hetunā gātrāṇāṃ
                            pāṇḍutā| dvitīye vege+atigātragurutvam| tṛtīye daṃśavikledādayaḥ|
                            caturthe mūrdhno garimādayaḥ| pañcame gātrabhaṅgādayaḥ| sa0-
                            śeṣayoḥ-ṣaṣṭhasaptamayorlakṣaṇaṃ, pūrvavat-darvīkaravat, vadet|
kuryātpañcasu vegeṣu cikitsāṃ, na tataḥ param||27||
pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| na tu tasmātparam, asādhyatvāt|

jalāplutādayaḥ sarpā alpaviṣā jñeyāḥ| divyādhyuṣito deśo-yatra devatāḥ
                            kṛtasannidhānāḥ, taṃ deśaṃ caranti| [
                            "śmaśānacaityavalmīkayajñāśrayasurālaye| catuṣpathe jalasthāne
                            jīrṇodyāneṣu koṭhare|| kṣīradrume nimbatarau nirjhare girigahvare|
                            cakravajragadākuntatriśūlāṅkajaṭādharāḥ|| raktāsyanayanā ye ca te
                            syurāśīviṣopamāḥ| na teṣu kālaniyamo na ca vegeṣvanukramaḥ|
                            mantratantrabalānnāpi prasahya vinivartanam|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| ]
                            (saṃ.u.a. 41)
naiḥ-ṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet||32||

śmaśānādiṣu daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca daṣṭaṃ tyajet| yāmyaṃ-bharaṇī|
                            āgneyaṃ-kṛttikā| naiḥ-ṛtaṃ-mūlam| naiḥ-ṛtākhyo muhūrto-sandhyodaya
                            eva|

yaḥ śuklamukhanayanaḥ patatkacaḥ stabdharasanaḥ punaḥpunarmūrcchan
                            śītocchvāsaḥ, sa na jīvati| [ "vepathurvedanāstīvrā
                            grīvābhaṅgo+akṣiraktatā| mūrcchā galagrahaśchardiḥ pretarājasya
                            kiṅkarāḥ|| jāmbavapratimo daṃśaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhavadunnataḥ| raktaṃ khebhyaḥ
                            samastebhyo vartate na tu daṃśataḥ|| romaharṣo na śiśiraiḥ
                            śvayathurlohito+asitaḥ| hṛṣṭamehanatā vakravaktratvaṃ yasya taṃ
                            tyajet||" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| )) (saṃ.u. a. 41)
hidhmā śvāso vamiḥ kāso daṣṭamātrasya dehinaḥ||33||
