jāyante yugapadyasya sa hṛcchūlī na jīvati||34||
yasya dehina ekakālameva hidhmādayo hṛcchūlaṃ ca syāt, sa na jīvati|

yaśca phenaṃ vamati niścetanaḥ śyāvapādādistathā nāsāvasādādayaśca, yasya
                            puṃso viṣapītasya tathā daṣṭamātrasya viṣaliptakenābhihatasya ca
                            sāmānyenaitāni rūpāṇi tasya jīvitakṣaye samprāpte syuḥ|
                            viṣapītasyetyāhitāgniṣūktatvāt paranipātaḥ|

tīkṣṇairnasyairna cetanā-na caitanyam| tathā kṣatācchinnādraktāgamo na
                            bhavati| tathā daṇḍena-laguḍena, āhatasya rājiḥ-lekhā, na bhavati|
                            yamasamīpaṃ prayātasya-gamiṣyato narasya| prayāta syeti
                            "vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā" iti bhaviṣyati ktaḥ|
rakṣan kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān viṣamāśu śamaṃ nayet||38||

ato+anyathā-sādhyatve sati, tvarayā-sadyo drāgeva, kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān
                            jvalitagṛhamiva rakṣan viṣaṃ śīghraṃ śāntiṃ nayet|
mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ||38||

śarīriṇo daṣṭasya daṃśe mātrāśaratulyakālaṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā dehaṃ
                            prakramate rudhirādīn dhātūn dūṣayat| prakramata iti "propābhyām" iti
                            taṅ|
kuryācchīghraṃ yathā dehe viṣavallī na rohati||40||

asminnantare-avasare, daṃśasyotkartanādikaṃ karma capalaṃ vidadhīta,
                            yathā viṣavallī kāye na rohati| viṣaṃ vallīveti "upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ"
                            iti samāsaḥ|
loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaischittvā cānu sasambhramam||41||

daṣṭamātraḥ puruṣastameva sarpaṃ-daṣṭāraṃ, śīghrameva khādet (daśet)|
                            athavā loṣṭaṃ dharaṇīṃ daśanaiśchittvā paścācca jhaṭiti niṣṭhīvena
                            daṃśamālimpet| karṇamalena vā+a+alimpet|

daṃṣasyopariṣṭāccaturaṅgule+ariṣṭāṃ kṣaumādibhirveṇikayā siddhaiśca
                            mantrairupalakṣito mantrairupalakṣito mantrajño badhnīyāt| bandhena hi
                            viṣaṃ stabhyate| jalaṃ yathā setubandhena| asya ca daṣṭasya, sirā viṣaṃ
                            bandhanapīḍitā na vahanti|

anu-paścāt, niṣpīḍya daṃśamuddharet marmasandhiṃ varjayitvā| tathā-evaṃ
                            kṛte sati, viṣavego na jāyate| yathā-aṅkuro bījanāśāt|
karoti bhasmasātsadyo vahniḥ kiṃ nāma tu kṣatam||46||

maṇḍalināṃ ca daṃśaṃ pittalatvāddhetormuktvā, athāparaṃ daṃśaṃ hemādibhiḥ
                            prataptaiḥ śīghraṃ dahedulmukena vā| yato+agniḥ sadya eva bhasmatāṃ
                            sarvameva vastu nayati| kṣataṃ tu kiyanmātram|

athavā pittalaprāyaḥ syāt tadā mṛdādibhiḥ pūrṇavadano+ariṣṭāmadhyaṃ
                            pracchāya-pracchānaṃ kṛtvā, ācūṣet| māṃsalaṃ tu sthānaṃ viśeṣeṇa
                            pracchāyācūṣet| tathā daṃśena sārdhamaṅgamagadena punaḥpunarlepayet|
                            candanośīrānvitenodakena secayecca śarīram|
viṣe pravisṛte vidhyetsirāṃ sā paramā kriyā||48||
rakte nirhriyamāṇe hi kṛtsnaṃ nirhrīyate viṣam||49||

viṣe pravisṛte sati sirāṃ vidhyet| sā hi uttamā kriyā| yato+asyāsṛji
                            nirhriyamāṇe viṣaṃ sarvameva nirhriyate, tadāśritatvāt|

saviṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ durgandhaṃ syāt| vahnau ca kṣiptaṃ caṭacaṭāyate|
                            viśuddhaṃ ca raktaṃ doṣānusāreṇa pūrvavat-sirāvyadhavidhyuktena (hṛ.sū.
                            a. 27) lakṣaṇena, vidyāt|
sirāsu tu śophādinā+anupalabhyamānāsu śṛṅgaṃ jalaukaso vā yuñjyāt|

srutaśeṣaṃ ca lohitaṃ viṣoṣmaṇā pravilīnaṃ lepādibhiḥ
                            punaḥpunarupayuktairatiśītalaiḥ stambhayet|

askanne-asrute+astyāne, hi rakte viṣavegena mūrcchādyā bhavanti| tāṃśca
                            śītairlepādibhirjayet| tathā romāñco yāvacchīte na syāt
                            tāvadbījecca|
skanne tu rudhire sadyo viṣavegaḥ praśāmyati||53||
asre tu skanne sati viṣavegaḥ śīghrameva praśāmyati|
viṣaṃ karṣati tīkṣṇatvād hṛdayaṃ tasya guptaye||53||

viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiyogād hṛdayaṃ karṣati| tasya-hṛdayasya, guptaye-rakṣaṇāya,
                            ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudramagadaṃ vā pibet ghṛtāplutam| asya-puruṣasya,
                            hṛdayāvaraṇe sati śleṣmā hṛdaye cayaṃ yāti|

pravṛttāḥ-sañjātāḥ, gauravotkleśahṛllāsā yasya sa evaṃ bhūtastaṃ dravaiḥ
                            kāñjikādirahitairvamanairvāmayet viṣaharaiśca vāmayet| evaṃ kṛte sati
                            tasya-viṣārtasya, śarīraṃ viṣaṃ na vyāpnoti|

bhujaṅgadoṣādikaṃ susūkṣmayā buddhyā samyagālocya viśiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ
                            samācaret|

sinduvāritamūlādikaṃ jalānvitaṃ darvīkarairdaṣṭe pānaṃ nasyaṃ mākṣikaṃ
                            kuṣṭhasahitaṃ hitam|

kṛṣṇabhujaṅgadaṣṭasya rakte hṛte sati daṃśaṃ guñjānākulībhyāṃ limpet|
                            tīkṣṇena mūlaviṣena vā limpet| kṣaudrādiyutaṃ ca sarpiḥ pānam|

tandulīyakādikaḥ pānādibhiragadaḥ phaṇināṃ rājīmatāṃ ca dāruṇe viṣe
                            hitaḥ|

sugandhādayaḥ samāḥ-samabhāgāḥ, ardhabhāgena surasapatrādikamiti
                            samākṣiko maṇḍalino viṣe viśeṣeṇāgado hitaḥ|

pañcavalkādiko mākṣikayuto himavānnāmāgado maṇḍaliviṣaṃ lepena hanti,
                            śophādihā ca| śirīṣapippalavaṭaplakṣavetasānāṃ pañcānāṃ
                            tvak-pañcavalkamucyate|
mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet||65||

vaṃśatvagādiko+aṣṭāṅgo+agado gomūtrapiṣṭo gonasaviṣaṃ hanti| vaṃśasya
                            tvagbīje|

kāṇḍacitrāyāḥ-sarpaviśeṣasya, daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi nikhanet| tata
                            uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpairdhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet| dhānyasya mṛd
                            dhānyamṛt| tathā purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ triphalācūrṇayutaṃ pibet| jīrṇe virikto
                            yavānnaṃ śālyādikaṃ sūpena saṃskṛtamadyāt|

karavīrārkayoḥ kusumamūlaṃ lāṅgalikādīṃśca kāñjikena kalkayet| eṣo+agadaḥ
                            sārvakārmiko vyantaradaṣṭānāṃ hitaḥ| sārvakārmika iti
                            "anuśatikāditvāt(dīnāṃ ca)" [iti] ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|

śirīṣakusumarase saptavāsarāṇi sitamaricaṃ bhāvitaṃ bhujaṅgadaṣṭānāṃ
                            pānādau hitam|

tagarakuṣṭhayordve pale ghṛtamākṣikayoścatvāri palāni| takṣakeṇāpi
                            daṣṭānāṃ tatpītaṃ śarmadam|
atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve vistrāvya śoṇitam||74||

darvīkṛtāṃ ca prathame vege pūrvaṃ raktaṃ visrāvyānantaraṃ
                            madhughṛtayutamagadaṃ śīghrameva pibet|
dvitīye vege vamanaṃ vidhāya tathaivāgadaṃ pibet|
caturthe vege kṛtavamanaḥ pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ pibet|

ṣaṣṭhapañcamayorvegayoḥ puruṣaṃ śiśirairmuhurliptaṃ siktaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ
                            vamanaṃ pāyayet| yavāgūṃ ca viṣaghnaiḥ kṛtāṃ pāyayet|
māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet||78||

saptame vege tīkṣṇamagadamañjane nasye ca yuñjyāt| tataḥ śastreṇa
                            kākapadamavagāḍhaṃ mūrdhni vidhāya tatastasya-daṣṭasya, tasmin kākapade
                            māṃsaṃ saśoṇitaṃ nyaset, athavā carma nikṣipet|
tṛtīye vamitaḥ peyāṃ vege maṇḍalināṃ pibet||79||
tṛtīye maṇḍalināṃ vege vamitaḥ peyāṃ pibet|
ṣaṣṭhe+atīkṣṇamagadaṃ padmakādiṃ vā gaṇaṃ (hṛ.sū. a. 15/12) yojayet|

rājīmatāṃ prathame vege+atiśayena pracchāyālābunā raktaṃ haret|
                            pūrvavaccāgadaṃ pibet|

ṣaṣṭhe+añjanamatitīkṣṇaṃ yojayedavapīḍaṃ ca| nanu, atra kecidvegā noditā
                            eva| teṣu kiṃ vidheyam ? ityāha-
garbhīṇyādiṣu mṛduṃ kriyāṃ yojayet| sirāṃ ca na vyadhayet|
tvaṅmanohvā niśe vakraṃ rasaḥ śārdūlajo nakhaḥ||82||

tvagādikamidaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītaṃ sarvāṇi viṣāṇi hanti|
                            vajrivajramivāsurānityupamālaṅkāraḥ|

bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ
                                surāhvam||84||

phalatrikaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca vastasya mūtreṇa
                                susūkṣmapiṣṭam||84||

bilvamūlādikaṃ chāgamūtreṇa
                            suślakṣṇapiṣṭamañjanādibhirbhujaṅgādibhirārtān puruṣān bhūtopadrutāṃśca
                            svasthayati| upajātivṛtte|
bhūyo vegāya jāyet śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā||86||

daṃśādapi-kiṃ punaḥ kāyāt, sarvaṃ viṣamuddharet| śeṣaṃ hi viṣaṃ
                            punarvegāya sampadyate, dūṣīviṣāya vā|

viṣāpagame sati vāyuṃ kupitaṃ snehādibhirupakramet,
                            tailādivarjitairvātanāśanaiḥ| pittaṃ pittajvaraharaiḥ kvāthaiḥ
                            snehabastibhiścopakramet| āragvadhādigaṇena (hṛ. sū. a. 15/17)
                            samākṣikeṇa kaphamupācaret|
sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu||89||

sitādikaṃ mantrapūtajalena sahitaṃ pānam| prokṣaṇaṃ
                            prakṛtatvānmantrapūtajalena vegaśo+aṅgaśaśca| tathā sāntvanaharṣaṇaṃ
                            sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt, śaṅkāviṣapīḍite ca yuñjyāt|
tathā droṇāṃ mahādroṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim||92||
karketanādīni viṣāṇi ca vīryavanti viṣaśāntyarthaṃ dhārayet|

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma
                            ṣaṭtriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||36||

chatravān jharjharahastaśca caret, viśeṣeṇa rātrau| tayoḥ
                            chatrajharjharayoḥ, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ chāyāśabdābhyāṃ vitrastāḥ sarpāḥ
                            praṇaśyanti, tasmādevamācaraṇīyamiti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma
                            ṣaṭtriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 36||

sarpāṇāṃ-pūrvoktānāṃ, viṇmūtrādijāḥ kīṭā doṣaiḥ pṛthagyuktāstriprakārāḥ
                            samuditaiśca yuktā iti catuḥ prakārāḥ syuḥ|

teṣu madhye vāyavyaiḥ-vātalaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśastodarujādhiko
                            bhavet|

āgneyaiḥ kīṭairdaṣṭasya daṃśo+alpasrāvādimān syāt| pakvapīluphalanibhaḥ
                            kharjūrasadṛśo vā syāt|

sānnipātikaiḥ-tridoṣādhikaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśaḥ srutyadhikaḥ
                            sarvaliṅgaḥ| sa ca varjyo-nopakramaṇīyaḥ|

vegāśca sarpavatkīṭeṣu syuḥ| tathā śvayathurvardhanasvabhāvo
                            visraśoṇitatvaṃ ca mūrdhanetragurutvaṃ mūrcchādyāśca syuḥ|

vṛścikasya tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| tacca prathamamagniriva dahati|
                            upariṣṭādāśvevārohati| paścācca daṃśe tiṣṭhati| daṃśo vṛścikasambandhī
                            sadyo+atirugādiḥ syāt| tudyate sphuṭatīva ca| tudyata iti karmakartari
                            taṅ|

te-vṛścikāḥ, gavādiśakṛtkothāt viṣadigdhadaṣṭādi kothāt sarpakothācca
                            sambhūtā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mandaviśā madhyaviṣā mahāviṣāśca syuḥ|
mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvāḥ rūkṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ||8||
mandaviṣāḥ kīṭāḥ pītādiguṇāḥ| romaśā iti "lomādi" ityādinā śaḥ|

mahāviṣā darbhadūrvāsadṛśā dviparvāṇa ekaparvāṇo vā| raktodarāḥ
                            kecitkṛṣṇodarāḥ kecitsitodarāśca|

taiḥ-mahāviṣaiḥ, daṣṭaḥ san śūnajihvādiḥ syāt| tathedamidaṃ kurvannīdṛśaḥ
                            san prāyaśo jīvitaṃ tyajati|

ucciṭiṅgākhyo vṛściko vaktreṇa daśati| sādhyāddṛścikādatiriktavyathaḥ|
                            tathā stambhaṃ karoti meḍhrasya| tathā hṛṣṭaromatāṃ-romaharṣaṃ, karoti|
                            tathā daṃśaśca śiśirajaleneva sekamaṅgānāṃ vidhatte| sa evoṣṭradhūmakaḥ
                            kathitaḥ| rātricaraṇācca rātrikaḥ sa evoktaḥ|

kīṭā vātapittādhikāḥ| kaṇabhondurāḥ śleṣmolbaṇāḥ| prāyeṇa vṛścikā
                            vātolbaṇaviṣā uṣṭradhūmakāśca|

yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ jñāyate, tasya tasya doṣasya
                            bheṣajairviparītaguṇaiḥ kriyāṃ vidadhīta|

vātike viṣe piṇyākena vraṇalepo yojyaḥ, tailābhyaṅgaśca nāḍyādibhiśca
                            svedo bṛṃhaṇaśca vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ|

kīṭānāṃ trividhānāṃ yathāsvaṃ trividhaiva cikitsā hitā| svedādīṃśca
                            prāyeṇa koṣṇān kuryāt| mūrcchitaṃ naraṃ daṃśapākaṃ ca varjayitvā tathā
                            daṃśakothaṃ ca hitvā|
nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaśca dhūpanam||23||

narakacādayo dhūpanaṃ sarvasya viṣadaṃśasya paraṃ hitamiti bhagavān
                            kāśyapo+avādīt|
viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryātsaṃśodhanāni ca||24||
tathā viṣaghnaṃ vidhiṃ sakalaṃ vidadhyāt| saṃśodhanāni ca kuryāt|
yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ||26||

trivṛtāṃ tandulīyakasamāṃ ghṛtena naraḥ pibet| evaṃ kīṭaviṣaiśca
                            kampaṃ-kṣobhaṃ, na yāti| kailāsa iva vāyubhiḥ|

vacādikadaśadravyanirmitatvāt daśāṅgamagadaṃ kāśyapena nirmitaṃ pītvā
                            sarvaṃ kīṭaviṣaṃ hanti|

vṛścikotthaṃ daṃśaṃ sadya eva cakratailena secayet| śāliparṇīsiddhena vā
                            itareṇa-cakratailena, koṣṇena vā secayet| saindhavānvitena vā+a+ajyena
                            muhurmuhuḥ siñcet| kavoṣṇena kāñjikena dugdhasaindhavānvitena vā
                            siñcet|
jīrakakalkaḥ saindhavayukto ghṛtena bhṛṣṭa upanāhaḥ syāt|

ā- samantato, daṃśaṃ sveditaṃ pracchāya cūrṇai
                            rajanyādijairgharṣayet|
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaśca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayo+api vā||33||

bījapūrāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ surasāpuṣpaṃ lepaḥ syāt| tathā sukhoṣṇaḥ piṇyāko
                            gomayo vā lepo hitaḥ|
pāne haiyaṃgavīnaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ, dugdhaṃ vā prabhūtasitaṃ, hitam|

karabhadaṃṣṭrā śaivālayutā vṛścikaviṣaghnī| ["sasaindhavoṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca
                            hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam| manohvā saindhavaṃ hiṅgu mālatī pallavāni ca||
                            gośakṛdrasapiṣṭeyaṃ gulikā vṛścikārdite| laśuno maricaṃ hiṅgu surasaṃ
                            viśvabheṣajam|| arkakṣīreṇa guṭikā vṛścikārditaśaṅkarī|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt
                            (saṃ. u. a. 43)| ]

hiṅguharitāle sabījapūrarase lepāñjanābhyāṃ gulikā paraṃ
                            vṛścikaviṣahṛt|

yo naro muhyatyādīn vidhatte, tathā dāruṇapīḍaḥ, tasya pathyādikaṃ
                            vārtākarasapiṣṭaṃ pralepanaṃ kāryam|

sarvasmin sudāruṇe vṛścikaviṣe dadhisarpiṣī pāyayet| sirāṃ ca vidhyet|
                            vamanādikaṃ ca kuryāt| uṣṇaguṇādikaṃ ca bhojanaṃ vātaghnaṃ hitam|

nāgarādikamayamagado lepena vṛścikaviṣaṃ śīghraṃ parākaroti|
                            svāgatāvṛttam|

vṛścikadaṣṭānāmante bhṛśaṃ samudīrṇe viṣe viṣeṇa daṃśamālepayet|
                            ucciṭiṅgasaṃjñe+apyeṣaiva cikitsā|

gajapurīṣacchatraṃ kattṛṇamūlaṃ ca śleṣmātakajalena guṭikāṃ vidadhīta|
                            eṣā ca lepena paraṃ vṛścikaviṣaghnī| [āryā))

arkakṣīreṇa śirīṣabījaṃ trīn vārān bhāvitaṃ pippalīrajoyutamagadaḥ
                            kīṭādīnāṃ viṣāṇi hanti|

śirīṣakusumādikameṣo+agado rātrikavṛścikānāṃ viṣakrāntikṛd bhagavatā
                            jinenoktaḥ| upajātivṛtte|
kīṭebhyo dāruṇtarā lūtāḥ ṣoḍaśa tā jaguḥ||45||

kīṭebhyo+api ghorā lūtāḥ| tāśca munayaḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyā adhyagīṣan| anye
                            aṣṭāviṃśatirulūtā ityavocan| tato+apyapare bahutarā ācakhyuḥ| anye tu
                            raveranucarāḥ sahasraśo vadanti| iti nānāmatamuktvā svamataṃ yuktyā
                            sarvamatānugrāhi vakti| anekopadravasvabhāvatvenaikaiva lūtā
                            viṣātmikā|

nāmnā yāni rūpāṇi, tāni tasyā atisaṅkarāddhetordurjñānāni|
                            sthānavyavasthā+api nāsti| tasmāddoṣavaśena bhaṇiṣyate|

tasyā daṃśaḥ paittiko dāhādimān bhṛśoṣmā pītaraktābhaḥ kledavān
                            drākṣāphalākāraḥ syāt|
nidrāṃ śītajvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam||50||

ślaiṣmiko lūtādaṃśaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇaḥ parūṣakaphalanibho
                            nidrādīnatiśayena karoti|

āsādhyāyāṃ lūtāyāṃ hṛnmohādyāḥ syuḥ| śvetādiguṇāḥ piṭikāstathā
                            śvayathvādyāśca| daṃśād raktaṃ pakvajambūnibhaṃ sravati| saṃ-sarvā ca
                            lūtā tridoṣajaiva| bāhulyena tu vyapadeśaḥ|
saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt||55||

sā ca lūtā tīkṣṇādibhedena triprakārā| upekṣitā ca satī yathāsaṅkhyaṃ
                            daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca hanti|

sarvaśca lūtādaṃśo dadrumaṇḍalākāraḥ sitādivarṇo mṛdurunnato madhye
                            kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śyāvavarṇo vā parito jālakavṛto visarpādimān syāt| tathā
                            tapyate+anekarujaḥ| tathā jvarādiyutaḥ| tathā ca daṃśaḥ kledena
                            yadyadaṅgaṃ spṛśet tatra tatra ca vraṇaṃ vidadhāti|
taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt||60||

nābherūrdhvaṃ lūtā daśati| ūrdhvamadhastācca kīṭā daśanti| daśatīti
                            "daṃśasañjasvañjāṃ śapi" iti nalopaḥ| tayā-lūtayā dūṣitaṃ, vastrāsanādi
                            śarīre lagnaṃ vikārakṛt|

lūtāviṣajo daṃśo dinārdhaṃ na lakṣyata eva| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, asau-daṃśaḥ,
                            prathame dine sūcīvyadhatulya ābhāti| avyaktavarṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa calo
                            manākkaṇḍūrugyutaśca|

dvītīye+ahanyabhyunnato+anteṣu piṭikairiva vā+a+acito vyaktavarṇo
                                madhye nataḥ sakaṇḍūrgranthinibhaḥ|

tṛtīye+ahani jvarānvito romāñcakṛdraktamaṇḍalaḥ śarāvākāro+adhikavyatho
                            romakūpeṣu srāvavān|
pañcame dine tāṃstān-pūrvoktān, viṣakopajān vikārān vidhatte|
iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ, madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajedataḥ||65||
iti-evaṃrūpaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ viṣam| madhyaṃ hīnaṃ vā+ato nirūpya lakṣayet|

atheti maṅgale| kṛtamaṅgalasya lūtādaṣṭasya, ā-samantāt, daṃśaṃ kṣipraṃ
                            śastreṇoddharet| jāmbvauṣṭhādibhiśca dahet, pittādhikaṃ varjayitvā|
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahenna ca||68||
karkaśādiguṇaṃ daṃśaṃ daṃśaṃ na chindyāt na ca dahet|

sarvato raktaṃ visrāvayecchṛṅgādibhiḥ| anantaraṃ sekālepāśca śiśirā hitāḥ
                            pippalādibhiḥ|

phalinyādiko+ayaṃ padmakasaṃjño+agadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ| aśeṣakriyāsu(?)
                            lūtākīṭānāṃ hitaḥ|

apāmārgādibhiragado mandaro nāma| anyaśca-vakṣyamāṇo natādiḥ(dibhiḥ),
                            gandhamādano nāma|

kaphe yaṣṭyāhvādīni tandulodakena pītvā viṣaṃ kṣipramudvamet| athavā
                            śirīṣapatrādikamaṅkollamūlayutaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītvodvamet|

kusumbhakusumādikaṃ dantīparyantaṃ karṇikāyāḥ pātanaṃ varam|
                            uttamāraṇīmūlaṃ vaṃśanirlekhanayuktaṃ vā| saindhavādikaṃ pūrvaguṇam|
                            takrajo vā kiṇvaḥ-upariṣṭāt phenābhaḥ, pūrvaguṇaḥ|

lūtāyāmaśeṣaṃ snehane yatkāryaṃ-kartuṃ yogyaṃ, tad ghṛtenaiva kuryāt|
                            yatastailaṃ viṣasya vṛddhaye, tṛṇolupamiva vahneḥ|

hrīberādikamindravajrāvṛttam| rajanyādikaṃ vailālīyaṃ vṛttam| bilvādikaṃ
                            svāgatāvṛttam| ete trayogadavarā vṛttasthāḥ pittaśleṣmānilalūtāḥ kramāt
                            pānādibhiḥ kugatīriva vārayanti| āryā|

rodhnaṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padmareṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yacca
                                raktam||86||

kāntāpuṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti
                                sarvakriyābhiḥ||86||

iti
                            śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ
                            ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma sapta
                            triṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||37||

rodhrādīni sarvābhiḥ-pānādibhiḥ kriyābhiḥ, sarvā lūtā ghnanti| śālinī|
                            iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma
                            saptatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 37||
śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukradigdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā||3||

eṣāṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ yatra śukraṃ patati, śukradigdhairaṅgairvā yadaṅgaṃ
                            spṛśanti, tasminnaṅge rakte dūṣite pāṇḍutvaṃ yāti sati granthyādayaḥ
                            syuḥ| tathā tatprabhāvāt kaphānugatabahumūṣikapotakavamanaṃ satṛṭ
                            syāt|

ākhuviṣaṃ vyavāyi-sakalaśarīravyāpanaśīlaṃ, tathā kṛcchraṃ-kṛchrasādhyaṃ,
                            punaḥ punaśca kupyati|

śūnabastiṃ vivarṇādharaṃ mūṣikanibhairgranthibhirvyāptaṃ
                            chucchundaragandhatulyagandhaṃ ca mūṣikaviṣadūṣitaṃ nopakramet|

śunaḥ-sārameyasya, śleṣmādhikā doṣāḥ saṃjñāvahāni srotāṃsyāśritāḥ
                            saṃjñāmapaharanto dhātūnāmatighoraṃ kṣobhaṃ kurvanti| saḥ-śvā,
                            lālāyuto+andhabadhiro dhvastapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiro duḥkhī natamukhaḥ
                            sarvato dhāvati|

tena-śunā, vidaṣṭasya daṃśaḥ suptaḥ-acetanaḥ, kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ sravati|
                            paścād hṛtpīḍādyudbhūtiḥ syāt|

anena-daṃśādisvarūpeṇa, apare vyālāḥ-duṣṭāḥ, daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ śṛgālādaya
                            evaṃ vedyāḥ|
sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ, viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe||14||

sarvatraiva saviṣe daṃśe kaṇḍvādayo liṅgam| nirviṣe ca daṃśe+ato
                            viparītaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt|
daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati||14||

yena prāṇinā daṣṭastacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan mriyate| tameva daṣṭāraṃ,
                            ādarśakādiṣu sahasā paśyan vinaśyati|

yo jalebhyo+adaṣṭo+api santrasyet śabdasaṃsparśadarśanairhetubhiḥ, taṃ
                            jalasantrāsasaṃjñaṃ daṣṭaṃ varjayet|

ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya narasya sato daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet| darpaṇena vā
                            dāhayet| anyathā-evamadagdhe sati, karṇikā dāruṇapīḍā syāt|
daṃśaṃ dagdhaṃ pracchitaṃ visrāvayet| śirīṣabījādibhiḥ pralepayecca|
agāradhūmādiko lepo hyayaṃ mūṣikaviṣaṃ hanti| karṇikāṃ ca pātayati|

anantaramamlaiḥ kṣālayitvā+anu jalaiḥ kṣālayet| paścāt
                            pālindyādibhiraparaiśca viṣaghnaiḥ śvayathughnaiśca lepayet| athavā
                            śīghraṃ sirāṃ vyadhayet| pālindī-mālavikā trivṛt|

nīlinīkvāthena chardanaṃ kāryam| śukākhyāṅkollayośca kvāthena vamanam|
                            śukākhyaḥ-śirīṣaḥ|
madanasya ca sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet||22||
kośātakyādīnāṃ phalāni sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet|

vacādiṃ vā gomūtreṇa sañcūrṇya pūrvakalpena-dadhnā, pītvā sarvonduraviṣaṃ
                            hanti| sa0- virecanaṃ trivṛtādikalka iṣyate|
śirovirecane śirīṣasya sāraḥ phalaṃ ca yojyam|

tandulīyakamūlena pakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāne hitam| dviniśādibhirvā sādhitaṃ
                            ghṛtaṃ pāne hitam| athavā+arkamūlena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāne hitam| athavā
                            pañcakāpitthasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pāne hitam| kapitthasyemāni
                            kāpitthāni,-mūlatvakpatrapuṣpaphalāni pañca, pañca ca tāni kāpitthāni
                            ca, taiḥ siddhaṃ pañcakāpittham|

sinduvārādīnāṃ kvāthaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet| mūṣikaviṣapīḍito dadhnā
                            śālyodanaṃ bhuñjānaḥ|
takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya vā pibet||28||
athavā śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya mathitena pibet|

aṅkolamūlakalko vā chāgamūtreṇa piṣṭaḥ pānalepanayoryuktaḥ
                            sarvākhuviṣahā|
gavāṃ mūtreṇa, payasā mañjarīṃ tilakasya vā||30||
kapitthabījādikaṃ gomūtreṇa pibet| kṣīreṇa vā tilakamañjarīṃ pibet|

athavā kaṭukālābuni jalaṃ nikṣiptaṃ rātristhitaṃ pītaṃ mūṣikaviṣanāśanaṃ
                            syāt|

mūṣikaviṣaṃ kiñciccheṣaṃ jaladonnatau kupyati| athavā vātādīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ
                            kāleṣu vṛddhikāraṇeṣu prakupyati|

tatrāvasthāvaśādupakramāḥ sarve yathāyogaṃ prayojyāḥ syuḥ| ye ca
                            dūṣīviṣaghnāḥ nirdiṣṭāste ca prayojyāḥ

alarkadaṣṭasya daṃśamuṣṇena ghṛtena dagdhamagadaistaistaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ,
                            lepayet| purāṇaṃ ca sarpiḥ pibet|

aṅkollottaramūlajalaṃ palatrayamātraṃ saghṛtapalaṃ pibet|
                            dhattūraphalayutāṃ śvetāṃ vā punarnavāṃ jalena pibet|
aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ||37||

bhṛṣṭatilacūrṇaṃ, tailaṃ, rūṣikāyāḥ-arkasya kṣīraṃ, guḍaḥ, ekatra
                            miśritaṃ prakṛtatvājjalena pītaṃ viṣamalarkaṃ bhinatti| payodaughamiva
                            vāyuḥ|

mantrānvitamauṣadhīratnayutaṃ snapanaṃ ca kārayet| ["aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān
                            siddhamantrābhimantritaiḥ| aṣṭottaraśatonmānaiḥ puṣpamālāvaguṇṭhitaiḥ||
                            gocarmamātrake lipte jvalite+agnau kuśāstṛte| sthaṇḍile saritastīre
                            snānaṃ vā+asya catuṣpathe|| alarkādhipate yakṣa sārameyagaṇādhipa|
                            alarkajuṣṭametanme nirviṣaṃ kuru mā cirāt|| svāheti mantro+alarkārte
                            sarvakarmasu śasyate|" iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt (saṃ.u. a. 46)|]

catuṣpādbhiḥ-dantyaśvaprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṇibhiḥ,
                            dvipādbhiḥ-manuṣyamayūrakukkuṭādibhiḥ, vā nakhaparikṣataṃ
                            dantaparikṣataṃ ca śūyate pacyate ca rāgādyanvitam|

iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ
                            sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedho
                            nāmāṣṭatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 38||

dīrghāyuḥprabhṛtīn rasāyanādadhigacchati| kasmādetāni rasāyanāllabhyante?
                            ityāha-lābhopāya iti| yasmāt śreṣṭhānāṃ rasarudhirādīnāṃ yo lābhopāyaḥ,
                            sa rasāyanamucyate|
pūrve vayasi madhye vā tatprayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ||3||

tat-rasāyanaṃ, jitātmanaḥ puruṣasyādye vayasi-atibālyātikrāntamātre,
                            athavā madhyame vayasi prayojyam| kīdṛśasya puṃsaḥ ? snigdhetyādi|
                            snigdhādiguṇayuktasya, tathā sarvathā adha upariṣṭācca śuddhasya|
aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ||4||
vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ||4||

yasmādaviśuddhe śarīre rāsāyano vidhirupayukto vājīkaro vopayukto
                            niṣphalaḥ syāt| yathā maline vastre raṅgaḥ| malinaṃ hi vastraṃ na
                            rajyate|

munayo rasāyanānāṃ prayogaṃ dviprakāraṃ jānanti| tatra mukhyaṃ
                            kuṭīpraveśanirvṛttam| vātātapikamanyathā-amukhyamityarthaḥ|

kva tatkurvīta ? pure, prāpyopakaraṇīye, harmyaṃ-dhavalagṛhaṃ, nivātaṃ
                            nirbhayaṃ ca yasmin tasmin, tathodīcyāṃ diśi,
                            śubhe-durbhikṣamarakādirahite, kuṭīṃ trigarbhāṃ kārayet| prathamamekaṃ
                            gṛham, tasyābhyantare dvitīyam, tasyābhyantare tṛtīyam, evaṃ trigarbhā|
                            trayo garbhāḥ-antarāṇi, yasyā iti kṛtvā| tathā sūkṣmagavākṣām| tathā
                            dhūmādibhiraviliṅghitāṃ-anākrāntām| tathā praguṇāni
                            vaidyopakaraṇāni-bheṣajādīni, yasyāṃ tāṃ tathāvidhām|
                            sumṛṣṭāṃ-upalepanādikaraṇena śuddhām|
tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ||8||

atha-kṛtamaṅgalaḥ, śubhe divase śuciḥ pūjyān-gurumitrādīn, sampūjya
                            tāṃ-pūrvopavarṇitāṃ kuṭīṃ, praviśet| tasyāṃ kuṭyāṃ kṛtasanniveśaḥ
                            saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ| sukhī-arogaḥ| etacca bāhulyenoktam|
                            śilājatucyavanaprāśādīnāṃ vyādhiṣvapyanujñātatvāt| tathā ca vakṣayati
                            (ślo.142)-"na so+asti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na
                            jayetprasahya|" iti| tathā (ślo.39)-"ityeṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya
                            cyavano muniḥ| jarjarito+apyāsīnnārīnayananandanaḥ|| kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ kṣayaṃ
                            śophaṃ vaisvaryaṃ ca vyapohati||" iti| punarjātabalaṃ iti prakṛtibalena
                            yo balavānnāsīttasya saṃśodhanena balahīnatvena punarjātabalo
                            bṛṃhaṇāhārādinā yadā, sa tadā rasāyanamārabhetetyarthaḥ| asañjātabalo
                            hyutkṛṣṭavīryāṇāṃ rasāyanānāṃ vīryaṃ soḍhuṃ na kṣamata iti punarjātabala
                            ityuktam| brahmacārītyuktaṃ nivṛttastrīsaṅgaparam| tathā jātasantoṣaḥ|
                            śraddhāluralolupaśca| tathā dānarataḥ dayāditatparaḥ| tathā
                            devatābhaktaḥ| yuktau svapnaprajāgarau yasya sa evam| tathā
                            bheṣajānurāgavān madhuravacanaḥ|
haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet||11||
snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ, tena sādhu viricyate||12||

harītakyādikaṃ yogamuṣṇajalena prāk snigdhasvinno naraḥ pibet| tena
                            yogena samyag viricyate|
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam||13||

anantaraṃ, śuddhadehāya kṛtapeyādikakramāya ca trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā
                            saptāhaṃ vā sarpiryutaṃ yāvakaṃ dadyāt| athavā purāṇaśakṛtaḥ śuddhiṃ
                            yāvat tāvadyāvakaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ dadyāt| trividhamalāpekṣayā trividhaṃ
                            parijñānam,-hīnapurīṣasya trirātram, madhyapurīṣasya pañcarātram,
                            utkṛṣṭapurīṣasya saptarātramiti| tathā hi [madhya]bahuvarcaskasya
                            pañcarātreṇa saptarātreṇa vā malaḥ śuddhyati, alpamalasya trirātreṇaiva,
                            iti trividhaṃ parijñānaṃ yuktam| bahutaramalasya bahutarairevāhobhiḥ
                            śuddhiḥ syādityuktavān'āśuddheḥ purāṇaśakṛto+athavā' iti|

evaṃ saṃskṛtakoṣṭhasya narasya yasya yadrasāyanaṃ yaugikamupalabhyate,
                            sātmyajño bhiṣak sarvamālocya tasya tadrasāyanamupāharet| ["haraṇāt
                            sarvatogāṇaṃ yā+asāvuktā harītakī| pathyatvātsarvadhātūnāṃ pathyā,
                            śivatayā śivā|| yasmādvijayate vyādhīn samagrān vijayā tataḥ| abhayaṃ
                            sarvarogebhyo bhavatyāyuśca śāśvatam|| yataḥ śīlayatāmenāṃ teneyamabhayā
                            smṛtā| navā vṛttā ghanā snigdhā gurvī majjati cāpsu yā|| bālasya sā
                            prayoktavyā navanītasamanvitā| vāte sasarpirlavaṇā pitte saguḍaśarkarā||
                            kaphe sapippalīkṣaudrā sarvadā sā praśasyate|" iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt
                            (saṃ.u. a. 49)|]
dve ca tailāt pacetsarvaṃ tadagnau lehatāṃ gatam||19||

abhayānāṃ sahasramāmalakasahasratritayayutam| tathā pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ
                            palaśatadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ salile daśaguṇe paktvā daśāṃśasthite rasa
                            āpothya-mṛditvā, harītakyāmalakāni vyasthīni kṛtvā tasmin kvāthe
                            prakṣipya kuḍavapramāṇaṃ tvagelādikaṃ cūrṇitaṃ yojayet|
                            kanakaṃ-nāgakesaram| vyasthīnīti "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena" ityekaśeṣaḥ|
                            palaśatenādhikaṃ śarkarāyā ardhabhāram, ghṛtasya trīṇyāḍhakāni, dve
                            cāḍhake tailāt, tatsarvaṃ vahnau pacet| tacca lehatāṃ gatamavatīrṇaṃ
                            śītaṃ kṣaudraśataistribhirviṃśatyadhikairyuñjīta| viṃśairiti 'viṃśateḥ
                            pūraṇe' iti pūraṇe+arthe ḍibhiḥ| 'viṃśaterḍit' iti ṭilope viṃśaśabdaḥ|
                            anantaraṃ khajenāloḍitaṃ ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidadhyāt| yā-mātrā,
                            ekamāhāraṃ-sāyaṃtanaṃ, noparundhyāt sā+asya rasāyanasya mātrā smṛtā|
                            āhāramekamiti vacanācca prathamāhārakālasya
                            rasāyanamātrayā+avaśyamuparodhaḥ kārya iti vedayati| asmiṃśca lehe jīrṇe
                            ṣaṣṭikaḥ kṣīreṇa saha bhojanamiṣṭam| vaikhānasādayo brahmaṇā
                            nirmitametadupayujya rasāyanaṃ tandrādivarjitā medhādiyutā
                            amitajīvitāścābhūvan| dhanyamiti dhanāya hitam| nanu, rasāyanasya
                            dhanārjanopāyatvābhāvāt kathaṃ dhanyatvam ? atra brūmaḥ| kārye
                            kāraṇopacārādevamuktam| tathā hi rasāyanamidamāmayaghnatvādārogye ca
                            sati medhāsmṛtyāyuktasya dhanāyodyamaṃ kurvato+avaśyaṃ
                            dhanasampa[mprā]ttiriti yuktameva| nanu, āmayavarjaitā
                            ityanenaivoktārthatvāt tandrādigrahaṇamavācyameva| atrācakṣamahe|
                            āmayavarjite svāsthyānuvṛttikaraṇasāmarthyamasya
                            rasāyanasyāvādīttantrakṛt| tandrādigrahaṇaṃ ca roganāśe+apyasya
                            jyāyastvamiti pratipādanārtham|
                            ["abhayāmalakabibhītakapañcātmakapañcamūlaniryūhe| vallīpalāśakarase
                            dviguṇe kṣīre+aṣṭaguṇe ca vipaceta|| ghṛtasya kumbhaṃ madhukaṃ madhūkaṃ
                            kākoliyugmaṃ ca balāṃ svaguptām| sakṣīraśuklāmṛṣabhaṃ sajīvaṃ
                            sukhāmbupastacca pibedguṇāḍhyam|| (sam. u. a. 49)"]

abhayāmalakānāṃ sahasraṃ dṛḍhaṃ
                            kaṇāsahasrānvitamajīrṇapalāśakṣāradravīkṛtaṃ bhājane sthāpayet| kṣāre
                            copayukte sati chāyāyāṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ ca śarkarāyāścaturthāṃśena
                            caturguṇābhyāṃ ghṛtamākṣīkābhyāṃ yojyam| etadghṛtakumbhe nidhāya bhūmau
                            ṣaṇmāsasthitaṃ samuddhṛtya pūrvāhṇe yathāgni bhuktvā sātmyāhāraḥ sadā
                            syāt| tisra āryāḥ| evametatsarvamupayujya saṃvatsaraśataṃ nīrogo
                            jarārahito jīvati| viśeṣeṇa balādiyutaḥ| gītirāryā|

kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cānu pibetprakāmaṃ tenaiva varteta ca
                                māsamekam||30||

varjyāni varjyāni ca tatra yatnāt spṛśyaṃ ca śītāmbu na
                                pāṇinā+api||31||
ekādaśāhe+asya tato vyatīte patanti keśā daśanā nakhāśca||31||

nīrujo-jantvādibhiranupadruto, yaḥ palāśastasya śirasi
                            chinne+antardvihastamātraṃ tatkṣataṃ-suṣirīkṛtaṃ, gambhīraṃ
                            navairāmalakaiḥ pūraṇīyam| pūrṇaṃ yāvaddarbhairveṣṭitaṃ padminīkardamena
                            lepitaṃ tata āraṇyairgomayairādīpya nivāte svedayet| tāni cāmalakāni
                            svinnāni kṣaudraghṛtayutāni tṛptyā puruṣaḥ khādet| paścāddugdhaṃ
                            kvathitaṃ bahu pibet| tenaiva ca dugdhena māsamekaṃ varteta| indravajrā|
                            rasāyanavidhau yānyuktāni kṣārādīni varjyāni tāni parihartavyāni
                            yatnena| hastenāpi śiśiraṃ jalaṃ na sparśayitavyam| tato+asya
                            rasāyanavidhāturekādaśe+ahni vyatikrānte keśādayaḥ patanti|
                            tato+alpakaireva dinai rūpavāṃstaruṇīviṣaya
                            akṣayaśaktirgajasamānasāmarthya utkṛṣṭamedhādirasau bhavati|
                            varṣasahasrajīvī ca| upajātī vṛtte|
parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭiḥ||33||
jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī||34||
ityeṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ||39||
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam||40||

daśamūlādikaṃ palonmitamaikadhyaṃ toyadroṇa āmalakaśatāni pañca pacet|
                            tasmāccaturthāśaṃ rasaṃ vigatāsthīni cāmalakānyādāya tailaghṛtayoḥ
                            pratyekaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ palairbharjayet| śarkarātulārdhenānvitaṃ
                            tadetatsarvaṃ lehamiva pacet| snehasyārdhaṃ pakve śīte madhu tathā
                            tavakṣīrīcatuṣpalaṃ kaṇādvipalaṃ kaṇārdhena caturjātaṃ ca dadyāt|
                            ato-lehāt, mātrāṃ kuṭīsthitaḥ pathyānyaśnannava lehayet| iti-evaṃ
                            prakāraḥ, ayaṃ cyavanaprāśākhyo lehaḥ| yaṃ lehaṃ, prāśya cyavanasaṃjño
                            munirjarākrānto+api taruṇīlocanarañjana asīt| ayaṃ lehaḥ kāsādīn
                            vyapohati| "upasargādasyatyūhyorvā vacanam (rveti vācyam)" iti taṅ|
                            bālādīnāmaṅgavṛddhikṛt| medhādīṃśca vidadhyāt vidhinā
                            rasāyanoktenopayukto+ayam| indravajrāvṛttam|
sitayā vā samā yuktā samāyuktā rasāyanam||43||

madhukena samā-tulyā, yuktā triphalā tathā samaiḥ sarvaiḥ,
                            yuktā-upayuktā, rasāyanaṃ sarvarogaghnī medhādidā ca syāt|
                            tavakṣīryādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ triphalāṅgatvena rasāyanāni nirupyāṇi|
                            sindhujanmanā-saindhavena, lohāḥ-rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ sīsaṃ trapu aya iti
                            pañca, taiḥ suvarṇena ca, pṛthagyuktā varā rasāyanamiti yojyam|
                            madhusarpiṣetyekavacananirdeśād dvābhyāmapi yugapadyoga ekaṃ rasāyanaṃ
                            vedyam|

maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya
                                cūrṇam||44||

rasaṃ guḍūcyāḥ sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca
                                śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ||44||
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī||45||

maṇḍūkaparṇīsvarasaṃ prayuñjīta, agnibalāpekṣayā| dugdhena
                            madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇaṃ yuñjīta| tathā guḍūcyā rasaṃ prayuñjīta| tathā saha
                            mūlapuṣpābhyāṃ vartate sahamūlapuṣpī, tasyāḥ śaṅkhapuṣpyāśca kalkaṃ
                            prayuñjīta| ityetāni rasāyanānyāyuṣpradāni rogaghnāni balādi vardhanāni
                            medhāyai hitāni ca| atiśayena śaṅkhapuṣpī medhyā| upajātī vṛtte|

triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ
                                supiṣṭaiḥ||46||

triguṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ
                                vipakvam||47||

naladādibhiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇāttriguṇena
                            śaṅkhapuṣpīrasena ghṛtasyāḍhakaṃ(sya droṇaṃ) kṣīrasahitaṃ vipakvaṃ
                            praśya jaḍo+api naro vāgmī śrutadharaḥ sapratibho nirāmayaśca syāt|
                            aupacchandasike vṛtte|

paiṣyairmṛṇālabisakesarapatrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca
                                sarpiḥ||48||

mṛṇālādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ suvarṇaśakalānvitaṃ haiyaṃgavīnaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ
                            pañcāravindamiti pañcāravindāni yasminniti samāsaḥ, evamagre+api kāryaḥ|
                            etadghṛtaṃ naṣṭaśukrādibhirniṣevitavyam, etanniṣevaṇe naitāne
                            syurityarthaḥ|

sarpiścatuṣkuvalayaṃ sahariṇyapatraṃ medhyaṃ gavāmapi bhavet kimu
                                mānuṣāṇām||49||

yadghṛtaṃ nīlotpalasya nālādimat kāñcanaśakalānvitaṃ sakṣīraṃ vipakvaṃ
                            tadapi catuṣkuvalayaṃ prasiddham| gavāmapijaḍānāmapi, etanmedhyam| kiṃ
                            punarmānuṣāṇām ? teṣāṃ samedhānāmatiśayenetyarthaḥ| vasantatilake
                            vṛtte|

brāmhyādayastriyavapramāṇāḥ pṛthak syuḥ| matsyākṣakaḥpattūraḥ| suvarṇasya
                            yavau dbau| tila eko viṣasya| ghṛtasya ca palam| etadekato yojayet|
                            jīrṇe cāsmin bheṣaje bahughṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ samākṣikaṃ yojayet| evaṃ varṣaṃ
                            śīlayan vipulabuddhyādikaḥ syāt| upajātisvāgate vṛtte| jarādirahitaḥ
                            pūrṇalakṣyādiko varṣaśataṃ jīvati| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhādayo+anena śāmyanti,
                            atibalā vātāśca| upajātiḥ|

śaradādau puṣyanakṣatre nāgabalāmūlaṃ samuddharet|
                            tasmānmūlāccūrṇitādakṣamātraṃ-karṣamātraṃ, dugdhena pibet,
                            mākṣikājyābhyāṃ vā lihyāt, kṣīravartano+anannāśī| evaṃ varṣaprayogeṇa
                            balavān san varṣaśataṃ jīvet|
kṣīreṇa tenaiva ca śālimaśnan jīrṇe bhavetsa dvitulopayogāt||57||

śaktaḥ surūpaḥ subhagaḥ śatāyuḥ kāmī kukudmāniva
                                gokulasthaḥ||57||

gokṣurakaḥ phalābhimukho mūlayutaśchāyāviśuṣkaḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇitaḥ svarasena
                            subhābitaḥ| tasmāt-gokṣurakāt, mātrāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ parāṃ yaḥ kṣīreṇa
                            pibet, pariṇate tasmin dugdhenaiva ca śālīn bhakṣayet, sa puruṣaḥ
                            palaśatadvayopayogāt śaktyādiguṇaḥ syāt| upajātīndravajrāvṛtte|
māsaṃ niranno māsaṃ ca kṣīrānnādo jarāṃ jayet||58||

vārāhyāḥ-vṛddhadārakasya, mūlamatyārdraṃ dugdhena māsaṃ pibet| jīrṇe+api
                            kṣīrapo nirannaḥ syāt| aparaṃ ca māsaṃ kṣīrānnāśī san jarāṃ jayati|
                            saṃ-tasyāḥ-vārāhyāḥ, mūlaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇaṃ vā svarasena suṣṭhu bhāvitaṃ
                            ghṛtamākṣikāplutaṃ lihyāt| tena vā mūlakalkena pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet
                            pūrvaguṇam|

vidāryādīṃśca pṛthak pṛthak tadvat-vṛddhadārakavat
                            sarpirdugdha(rmadhu)yutān, medhādyāvahānupayuñjīta| tataścopayuktā
                            vayaḥsthairyādipradāḥ syuḥ|
yathottaraṃ sa guṇavān vidhinā ca rasāyanam||62||
chāyāśuṣkaṃ tato mūlaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ lihan||63||
sarpiṣā madhusarpirbhyāṃ piban vā payasā yatiḥ||63||
ambhasā vā hitānnāśī śataṃ jīvati nīrujaḥ||64||
tailena līḍho māsena vātān hanti sudustarān||65||

citrako yathāyogaṃ puṣpaiḥ pītaiḥ śuklaiḥ kṛṣṇaiśca yathottaraṃ guṇavān
                            veditavyaḥ| vidhinā ca prayukto rasāyanaṃ syāt| saṃ-tasmāccitrakāt mūlaṃ
                            chāyāśuṣkaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ ghṛtena madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt| payasā
                            vā brahmacārī pibet| pānīyena vā hitānnabhojanaḥ san pibet| sukhī
                            medhāvān balavān ramaṇīyo vapuṣmān dīptāgniḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati|
                            saṃ-tailena līḍhaścitrako māsena dāruṇān vātān jayati| gomūtreṇa pītaḥ
                            śvitrakuṣṭhāni hanti| takreṇa pīto+arśāṃsi jayet|
saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat trīṇi trīṇi tataḥ param||68||

bhallātakāni suniṣpannāni grīṣme saṃgṛhya dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet| hemante
                            madhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ saṃskṛtaśarīrastānyaṣṭāvaṣṭaguṇe jale kvāthayet|
                            tatkvāthamaṣṭāṃśaśeṣaṃ kṣīrasahitaṃ śītaṃ pibet| paścāttasmin pratidinaṃ
                            caikaikaṃ bhallātakaṃ vardhayet-adhikīkṛtya kvāthayedityarthaḥ|
                            saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat| saptarātratrayāt paratastrīṇi trīṇyaruṣkarāṇi
                            catvāriṃśataṃ yāvadvardhayet| anantaraṃ tāni-aruṣkarāṇi,
                            vṛddhivaddhrāsayet| iti-evaṃ, saptabhiḥ saptāhaiḥ sahasramupayuñjīta|
                            yantritātmā puruṣo ghṛtakṣīraśāliṣaṣṭikabhojanaḥ| tathaiva ca
                            bhallātakaprayogānta ekaviṃśatisaptāhān ghṛtakṣīraśāliṣaṣṭikabhojanaṃ
                            kuryāt| evaṃ kṛtabhallātakaprayogo+apūrvāḥ-abhilaṣitā dayitāḥ, āśiṣo
                            labhate, tathā viśeṣeṇa vahnipāṭavam| pramehādivarjitaśca syāt|

piṣṭaṃ śālicūrṇaṃ svedyate+asminniti piṣṭasvedanaṃ,- bhāṇḍam|
                            tadarujaiḥ-dṛḍhaiḥ, bhallātakaistathā vijarjaritaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sat
                            kṛtacchidraṃ bhūminikhāte kumbhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikayā
                            liptamanantaraṃ gomayāgninā mṛdunā parivāritaṃ pacet| tatsvaraso
                            yastatra dharānikhāte kumbhe patet, tamanyasminnahani gṛhṇīyāt|
                            amuṃ-pūrvoktaṃ, svarasaṃ mākṣikāṣṭamabhāgaṃ dviguṇaghṛtaṃ pūrvavidhinā
                            yantritātmā sannupayujya, tāneva-pūrvoktān, guṇān prāpnoti| āryāstisraḥ,
                            madhyamā+atra mukhacapalā|

sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tatra tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyātsvecchaṃ śarkarāyā
                                rajobhiḥ||77||

ekībhūtaṃ tatkhajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ
                                suguptam||77||

tamamṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśamaśnan anu pibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri
                                dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā||78||

suniṣpannāni bhallātakāni pākena paricyutānyāḍhakasammitāni
                            iṣṭikācūrṇakaṇairghṛṣṭāni jalena prakṣālya, mārutena saṃśoṣya-na
                            tvātape, tato jarjarāṇi jaladroṇe vipacet| pādaśeṣadhṛtagālitaṃ śītaṃ ca
                            tadrasaṃ punarapi kṣīradroṇasahitaṃ pacet| [tatra-] tasmin pādaśeṣasthe,
                            tulyapramāṇaṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ śarkarācūrṇena yutaṃ yathecchaṃ
                            prakṛtyādivaśādyuñjīta| tacca khajaloḍanenaikībhūtaṃ dhānyamadhye
                            saptarātraṃ suguptaṃ sthāpyam| indravajrāsvāgatāśālinyo vṛttāni|
                            tamamṛtarasatulyapākaṃ yaḥ pūrvāhṇe prāśaṃ-lehaṃ, bhakṣayan
                            paścādyatheṣṭaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ māṃsarasaṃ vā pibati, sa smṛtyādiyutaḥ
                            suvarṇaughagauro dīrghamāyuḥ prāpnoti| mālinī|

jaladroṇe vraṇakṛtāṃ bhallātakānāṃ śatatrayādvipakvāt
                            kvāthasyāḍhake+avaśiṣṭe tilatailāḍhakaṃ tiktādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ kalkitaiḥ
                            pakvaṃ niḥśeṣakuṣṭhaniṣūdanāya paraṃ-śreṣṭham| vasantatilakam|

sahāmalakaśuktibhirdadhisareṇa tailena vā guḍena payasā ghṛtena
                                yavasaktubhirvā saha||80||

tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā vapuṣkaramaruṣkaraṃ
                                paramamedhyamāyuṣkaram||80||

āmalakatvagādibhirekādaśabhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ bhallātakamupayuktaṃ
                            praśastaśarīrakaraṇakāraṇam| tathā paraṃ-atiśayena, medhyamāyuṣpradaṃ ca
                            syāt| pṛthvīvṛttam|

bhallātakāni tīkṣṇāni suniṣpannāni dahanatulyāni tāni yathāvidhi
                            prayuktānyamṛtatulyāni bhavanti|
kaphajo na sa rogo+asti na vibandho+asti kaścana||82||

śleṣmottho rogaḥ sa nāsti, vibandhaśca sa kaścidapi na vidyate, yaṃ-rogaṃ
                            vibandhaṃ vā, bhallātakaṃ drutataraṃ paṭutaradahanakaraṃ na hanyāt|

tuvarasaṃjñā vṛkṣāstuvarakāḥ paścimasamudrataṭodbhūtāḥ| vīcītyādinā
                            viśeṣaṇena toyanidhinikaṭataratvaṃ pratipādayati| tebhyo vṛkṣebhyo
                            jaladāgame supakvāni phalāni gṛhṇīyāt| phalebhyo+api majjño gṛhītvā
                            śoṣayitvā suṣṭhu cūrṇayitvā ca tilavad droṇyāṃ pīḍayet| kusumbhavadvā
                            kvāthayetj| tacca tailaṃ siddhaṃ punaḥ pacettoyakṣayaṃ yāvat| pakvaṃ
                            cāvartāya karīṣe māsārdhaṃ nidhāpayet| yantrapīḍitaṃ tu prakṛtyaiva
                            nistoyaṃ tailaṃ tadakvathitameva nidhāpayet| tataḥ-pakṣādanantaraṃ,
                            tailamudddhṛtya snigdhasvinno hṛtadoṣo mantreṇānena majjasāretyādinā
                            pavitritasya tailasya śubhadivase caturthena bhaktenāntarito+aharmukhe
                            karṣaṃ pibet| tena tailenāsya puṃsa ūrdhvamadhaśca punaḥ punardoṣā
                            yānti| anantaramaparāhṇe+asnehalavaṇāṃ yavāgūṃ śiśirāṃ pibet|
                            itthaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, parihāryān pariharan pañca divasāni tailaṃ
                            pibet| pakṣaṃ mudgarasānnabhojanaḥ sarvakuṣṭhairvimucyate|

tadeva-tuvarāsthitailaṃ, khadirakvāthena triguṇena samyakpakvaṃ
                            pūrvavat-karīṣe pakṣaṃ nihitaṃ, māsaṃ suyantritaḥ pibet| tena ca
                            tailenābhyaktaśarīro bhojanaṃ pūrvoktaṃ mudgarasānnaṃ vidadhyāt| etena
                            prayogeṇa śīghraṃ kuṣṭhavantaṃ puruṣamupakramet|

tadeva-tuvarāsthitailaṃ, khadiramantareṇa ghṛtamadhuyutaṃ pakṣaṃ pītaṃ
                            sanmāṃsarasāhāraṃ naraṃ dviśatāyuṣaṃ vidhatte|0

tadeva tailaṃ nasye pañcāśadvāsarān sevitaṃ varaśarīraṃ śrutadharaṃ
                            trivarṣaśatāyuṣaṃ puruṣaṃ karoti|

pañca pippalīrathavā saptāṣṭau vā daśa vā mākṣikasarpirbhyāṃ
                            rasāyanaguṇamabhilaṣya varṣamekaṃ prayojayet|

palāśakṣārabhāvitāḥ pippalyaḥ sarpiṣā bharjitā mākṣikānvitāstisraḥ
                            pūrvāhṇe, tisro bhuktvā, tisro bhojanasyāgre, prayojyāḥ rasāyanaguṇaṃ
                            kāmayamānena|

daśa dināni daśapaippalikaṃ dinaṃ kramavṛddyā kṣīreṇa saha yojayet,
                            vardhamānā daśa pippalīḥ prayojayedityarthaḥ| tathaiva daśapaippalikaṃ
                            dinaṃ payasā sahāpanayet| pariṇatabheṣajaśca ṣaṣṭikaṃ dugdhaghṛtenādyāt|
                            ayaṃ-evaṃprakāraḥ, sahasrapippalīnāṃ prayogo rasāyanaṃ syāt|
                            tāḥ-pippalyaḥ, piṣṭāḥ satyo balavadbhirnaraiḥ pātavyāḥ,
                            madhyabalairnaraiḥ kvathitāḥ peyāḥ|
tadvacceti anenaiva krameṇa chāgakṣīreṇa saha dve sahasre prayojayet|
ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam||102||

ebhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ prayogaiḥ, pippalya upayuktāḥ kāsādīṃśchophādīṃśca
                            jayanti|

bilvārdhamātreṇa ca pippalīnāṃ pātraṃ pralimpedayaso
                                niśāyām||103||

pippalīkarṣadvayamātreṇa niśāyāṃ lohapātraṃ limpet| tacca jalāñjaliyugena
                            prātaḥ pibet saṃvatsaraṃ svecchābhojanapānakriyaḥ| etacca rasāyanaṃ
                            pūrvaguṇam| indravajrā vrattam|

śuṇṭhyādīn pṛthageva pippalīriva lohopaliptānupayujya varṣaśataṃ
                            rogajarārahito jīvati|

amūni-pūrvoktāni rasāyanāni, lohalepanāni
                            kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ-dugdhapalāṣṭakena, upayuktāni pūrvoktaguṇātiśayamāyuḥ
                            prakarṣaṃ ca tato dviguṇaṃ vidadhati| ādyante indravajrākhye, madhyamaṃ
                            tūpajātiḥ|

asanādikvāthena bhāvitāṃ bākucīṃ mākṣikādibhiryuktāṃ varṣamavilahan
                            pāriṇāmān-vayaḥpariṇatijān, vikārān jahāti| tathā hitamitabhojana
                            āhārajān vikārāṃstyajati| mālinī|

dāruṇena kuṣṭhena vyāptadeho yaḥ śaśāṅkalekhāṃ kṛṣṇatilayutāṃ niyamena
                            vatsaraṃ bhakṣayet, sa candrakāntiṃ śarīreṇa jayet| upajātiḥ|

uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tadevānu pibanti
                                cānte||109||

ye puruṣā vituṣīkṛtāyā indurājyāścūrṇairyuktāt kṣīrāt sujātāt
                            sāraṃ-navanītākhyaṃ, uddhṛtya mākṣikeṇa saha lihanti, paścāt tadeva
                            takraṃ ca ye pibanti, te kuṣṭhavantaḥ śīryamāṇaśarīrāḥ
                            samudbhūtāṅgulighrāṇāḥ śobhante| tarava iva bhūyaḥ
                            sañjātapratyagrapallavāḥ| indravajrā|

atha laśunakalpamācaṣṭe- svarbhānoramṛtāpaharaṇāparādhena
                            kaṇṭhācchinnādye+amṛtasya bindavo dharitryāṃ patitāste laśunatvaṃ
                            prāptāḥ| ya(a)-asmāddhetoḥ, daityadehotthaṃ laśunamato dvijā na
                            bhakṣayanti| sākṣāccāmṛtasambhūtatvāddhetorasau rasono rasāyanaṃ
                            grāmaṇīḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|

śīte-hemantaśiśirayoḥ, laśunaṃ śīlayet| kaphādhiko vasante+api śīlayet|
                            vātottaro varṣāsvapi śīlayet| sarvadaiva vā vātārtau
                            grīṣmartucaryācaraṇena śīlayet| kīdṛśaḥ san ? snigdhā śuddhā ca
                            tanuryasya sa evam| tathā śītalairmadhuraiścopaskṛtaḥ-saṃskṛtaḥ, āśayo
                            yasya sa evam| tathā tasya-laśunasya, śekharakarṇapūrābhyāṃ maṇḍitā
                            anucarāḥ-sevakāḥ, aṅgaṇe yasya sa tathā|
tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktamālocya mātrayā||117||
kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalameva vā||118||

tasya-laśunasya, kandān vasantaṛtajāṃstathā himaveddeśajāṃśchakadeśajān
                            vā uddhṛtatvaco rātrau madirābījapūrarasādibhistimayet-kledayet|
                            tatkalkasya svarasaṃ dhautavastrapīḍitaṃ madirāyāḥ suruḍhāyāstribhāgena
                            yutaṃ, madyādervā tribhāgena yutaṃ, athavā tasminneva kāle
                            surādibhiryutaṃ, mātrayā-deśakālāturādyapekṣiṇyā, ālocya-nirūpya,
                            tailādibhirvā pṛthak yuktaṃ yadi vā kvāthena yathāvyādhivaśādyuktaṃ,
                            kevalameva vā rasaṃ, prāk-pūrvaṃ, gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ pibet
                            galanāḍīviśodhanāya|

vedanāyāṃ satyāṃ satataṃ svedanaṃ śreṣṭham| tathā vamau mūrcchāye ca
                            sahasā-jhaṭityeva, śītalajalaseko mukhe śasyate|
śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi||120||
śeṣaṃ rasaṃ klānterapagama ojasi sthairyaṃ prāpte sati pibet|

vidāhopaśāntaye+atiśītānulepanaḥ syāt| tathā muktāmālikāḥ
                            karpūtamālikāśca sajalakaṇā dhārayet|
kuḍavo+asya para mātrā tadardhaṃ kevalasya tu||122||
palaṃ piṣṭasya tanmajjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet||122||

asyottamā mātrā surāsahitasya kuḍavaḥ| kevalasya tu rasasya kuḍavārdhaṃ
                            paraṃ mātrā| tanmajjñaḥ piṣṭasya palaṃ parāmātrā| sabhaktaṃ prāk cāhārāt
                            tacchīlayet|

purāṇaśālibhaktaṃ pariṇate śaṅkhādivat sitaṃ yūṣādibhiḥ sātmyādivaśāt
                            bhuñjīta|

tatra ca tṛṣi jātāyāṃ kevalaṃ madyaṃ jalayutaṃ pibet| amadyapastu naro
                            dhānyāmlādīni pibet| parisikthikā-saṭṭakaviśeṣaḥ, kiṭṭiriti
                            kvacitprasiddhā|

athavā tasya-laśunasya, kalkaṃ tulyaghṛtaṃ khajenāloḍitaṃ ghṛtabhāṇḍe
                            sthitaṃ daśāhādūrdhvaṃ bhuñjīta| tathaiva vasayā saha sthitaṃ
                            daśāhādūrdhvaṃ bhuñjīta|

vikañcuko-vigatatvag, yaḥ prājyaḥ-prabhūto laśunaḥ, sa garbho yeṣāṃ
                            tāṃstathāvidhān, tathā sahaśūlyamāṃsena saśūlyamāṃsān, tathā
                            nānāvidharucakān, īdṛśān vā nimardakān ghṛtaśuktakānvitān, yathecchaṃ
                            laghu tathā tucchaṃ-alpaṃ, bhuñjānaḥ| upendravajrāvṛttam|
śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunātparam||127||

vāte laśunātparamanyad dravyaṃ na vidyate| kimbhūte ?
                            pittaraktavihīnasakalāvaraṇāvṛte| śuddhe-kevale vā, pavane+aparaṃ
                            dravyaṃ na vidyate|

laśunaṃ priyajalādernarasya, māṃsādidveṣiṇaḥ, tathā+ajīrṇamatitikṣoḥ,
                            niścayena vyāpattaye syāt|

laśunaprayogānte ca pittakopabhayāt mṛdu-atīkṣṇaṃ virecanaṃ ca kārayet|
                            evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa yukte rasone, rasāyanaguṇān paripūrṇān prāpnoti| [
                            "āmāmbupānekṣuvikāramatsyayānādhvavātātapabhāṣyacintāḥ| svapnaṃ divā
                            jāgaraṇaṃ niśāsu piṣṭaṃ vyavāyaṃ dadhi cātra necchet||
                            pāṇḍūdaroraḥkṣataśophatṛṣṇāpānātyayacchardiviṣavraṇeṣu| paitte
                            vikāṛre+akṣigade+atisāre kṣāme śarīre ca sa varjanīyaḥ||" iti
                            vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| rasonasyopari etāni viruddhāni| ]

grīṣme ṛtau girayo ravitaptā jatutulyaṃ yat vamantikṣaranti,
                            suvarṇādayaśca te ṣaḍdhātavaśca teṣāṃ rasaṃ, tat śilājatu gadyate|
sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ||131||
chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate||131||

sarvaṃ-ṣaḍdhātujamapi, girijaṃ tiktakaṭukaṃ na cātiśayenoṣṇaṃ pāke
                            kaṭukaṃ chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa| tatra madhye lauhaṃ śilājaṃ
                            praśasyate|
snigdhamanamlakaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham||132||

vyādhiśca vyādhitaśca tayoḥ sātmyaṃ-upaśayaṃ, samanusmaran lohapātre
                            girijaṃ bhāvayet| katham ? ityāha-pūrvaṃ kevalajalena dhautaṃ tataḥ
                            śuṣkaṃ sat kvāthairbhāvanīyam| saṃ-samaṃ girijaṃ yasmin bhāvanauṣadhe
                            tadevamaṣṭaguṇe jale niḥkvāthyam| tatkvāthe+aṣṭāṃśaśeṣe pūtoṣṇe sati
                            śilājatu prakṣipet| tatsamarasatāṃ prāptaṃ śuṣkaṃ punā rase prakṣipet|
                            evaṃ svaiḥ svaiḥ kvāthaiḥ sapta vārān bhāvanīyam| āryāścatasraḥ|
guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaṃ na ca||138||

atha girijamevaṃ bhāvayitvā snigdhasya śuddhasya ca narasya
                            tiktakasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ divasatrayamupayuñjīta| nanu, yadi snigdhaśuddha
                            evāsau, tatkimiti punaḥ sarpiryujyate ? brūmaḥ| kṛtaghṛtasya
                            śilājatuvidhānaṃ sutarāṃ śastam| tathā coktam-"yathā hi kavacī śastraṃ
                            parebhyaḥ sahate+adhikam| tathā snehādhike gātre sevyamānaṃ śilājatu||"
                            ityādi| tathā ekaikena vakṣyamāṇena saha, śailajaṃ tryahamupayuñjyāt|
                            triphalāyāḥ kvāthena tryahaṃ, paṭolyāśca kvāthena tryahaṃ,
                            madhuyaṣṭyāśca kvāthena tridivasam| anantaraṃ yogyaṃ yogaṃ
                            kālādīnapekṣya prayojayet| evaṃ anena vidhinā, girijaṃ yuktaṃ
                            śarīrasyopakārakataraṃ syāt| sakalān guṇān vidhatte| aksmādeva ca
                            vyāpadaṃ na karoti|

ekaṃ saptāhaṃ trisaptāhaṃ saptasaptāhamiti kālayogaḥ, karṣamardhapalaṃ
                            palamiti mātrāyogaḥ, iti dvaye+apyatra yathākramaṃ hīnamadhyottamatvam|
                            ekaśca trayaśca sapta ca teṣāṃ saptāhamiti samāsaḥ| muninā+apyuktam (ca.
                            ci. a. 1 pā. 3/54)- "prayogaḥ saptasaptāhāstraya ekaśca kālataḥ|
                            nirdiṣṭastrividhastasya varo madhyo+avarastathā|| palamardhapalaṃ karṣaṃ
                            mātrā tasya tridhāmatā|" iti|

saṃskṛtaṃ-pavanādiharairdravyairbhāvitaṃ, saṃskṛte dehe-snehanaśodhanaiḥ
                            kṛtasaṃskāre śarīre, śilājatu prayuktaṃ prayuktaṃ tāmrādibhiḥ
                            samuditairvyastairvā yuktaṃ dugdhenāloḍitaṃ kṣiprameva rasāyanaphalaṃ
                            vidadhyāt| kulatthādīni kṛtatatprayogaḥ sadaiva jahyāt| kharaṇāde
                            kākamācīkapotau na varjitau| tadvacanaṃ hi-"śuṣkāmiṣaṃ viruḍhaṃ piṣṭaṃ
                            śuktam vidāhi guru cānyat| pānāśanaṃ kulatthān viśeṣato varjayeccātra||"
                            ityādi| muninā+api naitau varjitau| tathā ca tadgranthaḥ (ca. ci. a. 1
                            pā.3/62)

\_"śilājatuprayogeṣu vidāhīni gurūṇi ca|
                            varjayetsarvakāleṣu kulatthāṃśca sadā tyajet||" iti| vidāhyādivarjanaṃ
                            rasāyanakālād dviguṇaṃ kālaṃ vidheyam| kulatthāṃśca yāvajjīvamityeke|
                            anye tu vadanti sadāśabdena saṃvatsara ucyate| yato ya ete ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ|
                            etāvāneva kālo, na ṣāḍ ṛtuvyatirikto+anyaḥ kālo+astīti
                            teṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ| nanu, vidāhigurvādibhyaḥ kimiti kulatthānāmadhikaḥ
                            parihāra iṣyate ? brūmaḥ| pāṣāṇabhede kulatthānāmadhikatarasvabhāvatvāt|
                            tathā hi-santaptakulatthajalenāplutānāṃ pāṣāṇānāṃ pāṣāṇahantṛbhiḥ
                            sukhenaiva vidāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam| śilājatu ca girijamityuktam| ataḥ
                            śilājatuprayogāt tanmayameva śarīraṃ sampadyate| tena tasya kulatthā
                            bādhāvidhāyinaḥ, iti parihārasteṣāmadhikaḥ kṛtaḥ|

na so+asti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet
                                prasahya||142||

tat kālayogairvidhivat prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ
                                dadhāti||142||

atra bhūlokagrahaṇaṃ sakalabhūlokaparigrahārtham| anyathā kaścideva deśo
                            gṛhyeta, na tvaśeṣo bhūlokaḥ| rūpagrahaṇena sādhyaḥ savikalpo+api
                            gṛhyate, tena kṛcchrasādhyo+api gṛhyate| rūpa padamantareṇa tu
                            sukhasādhya eva kevalo gṛhyeta| prasahyetyanena śīghrataraṃ niścitaṃ ca
                            rogajayaṃ karotīti gamayati| tadayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-kuṣṭhaghnāni
                            mūtrakṛcchraharāṇi vā yathauṣadhāni teṣāṃ śamayati, tataḥ kṣiprataraṃ
                            niścitaṃ ca rogajayaṃ karoti girijamiti| na sa rogo sādhyarūpo vidyate,
                            yaṃ śilājatu prasahya na jayet| girijaṃ kālayogena ca vidhinā prayuktaṃ
                            nīrujasya puruṣasya mahatīmūrjāṃ ca karoti| upajātiḥ| ata eva saṅgrahe
                            jagāda (u. a. 49)-"jvarī jvaraghnāmbudaparpaṭādeḥ kvāthena raktī
                            madhuyaṣṭikāyāḥ| śoṣī rasaiḥ kravyabhugāmiṣotthairmāyūramāṃsaiḥ payasā
                            ca kārśye|| madhvambunā medasi saṃpravṛddhe kṣīreṇa
                            paryākulabuddhisattvaḥ| pāṇḍau saśophe jaṭhare sakṛcchre pibecchilājaṃ
                            mahiṣījalena|| aśma vīratarādyena kuṣṭhaṃ khadiravāriṇā| viṣaṃ
                            viṣaghnairagadairhantyevaṃ tadyathāmayam||
                            śailajatrikaṭukaṭukṣaudrakṣaudradhātūn viṣevate| kṣīrodanāśī yo jīrṇe
                            yakṣmaṇā na sa bādhyate|| subhāvitāṃ sārajalaistulāṃ pītvā śilodbhavāt|
                            sārāmbunaiva bhuñjānaḥ śālīn jāṅgalajai rasaiḥ|| apohya
                            madhumehākhyamantakaṃ rogasaṅkaram| vapurvarṇabalopetaḥ śataṃ
                            jīvatyanāmayaḥ|| amaramandiramandarasambhavāt palaśataṃ
                            girijādupayojaya| yadi jarāmayaduḥkhavivarjitāṃ suciramicchasi
                            jīvitasantitam|| daśaguṇamupayuṅkte yaḥ śataṃ
                            śailajātāllaghuhitamitabhojī varjayan varjanīyān| satatasamanuṣaktān
                            varjitān vaidyavṛndairvidhamati sa gadaughānnekṣate cāyuṣo+antam||" iti|
                            śivaguṭikā cātraivoktā (saṃ. u. a. 49)| yathā-"śilāhvāt ṣoḍaśapalaṃ
                            tristrirekatra bhāvayet| varāyā daśamūlasya guḍūcyāḥ karkaṭasya ca||
                            balāyā madhuyaṣṭyāśca rase gavye ca vāriṇi| kṣīre sakṛt krameṇaivaṃ
                            saptakṛtvastathā punaḥ||
                            kākoliyugmaghanapuṣkaravahnirāsnāmedāyugarddhicavikāgajapippalīnām|
                            pāṭhādvijīvakanikumbhavidāriyugmavīrāvarīmadhuphalāṃśumatīdvayānām||
                            palikānāmabdroṇe siddhānāṃ pādaśeṣite kvāthe| bhāvitamitthaṃ girijaṃ
                            dvipalaiścūrṇīkṛtairyuñjyāt|)
                            karkaṭaśṛṅgīdhātrīvyoṣaistālīsapatrakuḍavena| cūrṇapalena
                            vidāryāstvakkṣīryāḥ karṣayugmena|| kuḍavena
                            caturjātāttailaghṛtakṣaudraśarkarābhiśca| dvipalādidviguṇābhiḥ
                            kuryādgulikāstato+akṣasamāḥ|| tāḥ śuṣkā navakumbhe jātīpuṣpādhivāsite
                            sthāpyāḥ| tāsāmekāṃ khādet pratidinamanupānamatreṣṭam||
                            kṣīrarasadāḍimāmbhomārdvīkasurāsavānyatamam| jīrṇe+annaṃ laghu bhojyaṃ
                            yūṣapayaḥpiśitaniryūhaiḥ|| saptāhamātramevaṃ sarvānnīnaḥ
                            kramādbhavetparataḥ| bhaktasyānte prāgvā gulikā na virudhyate caiṣā||
                            nirapāyā bhūriphalā parihārasukhopayojitā jayati| prabalamapi
                            vātaśoṇitamūrustambhaṃ jvaraṃ dīrgham||
                            bhagamūtraśukradoṣaplīhayakṛdraktapāṇḍuhṛdrogān|
                            vardhmavamigulmapīnasahidhmākāsāruciśvāsān|| vidradhimudaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ
                            śvitraṃ ṣāṇḍhyaṃ kṣayaṃ madaṃ mūrcchām| unmādamapasmāraṃ
                            mukhanetraśirogadāṃstāṃstān|| ānāhamatīsāraṃ halīmakaṃ
                            kāmalāgrahaṇirogān| granthyarbudān sapiḍakān bhagandaraṃ gaṇḍamālāṃ ca||
                            atikārśyamatisthaulyaṃ svedamapi ślīpadaṃ gude kīlān| daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ
                            samūlaṃ garaprayogān sughorāṃśca|| abhicāramarātikṛtaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ
                            bhautikīṃ tathā bādhām| pāpmālakṣmīṃ ceyaṃ gulikā śamayecchivā nāma||
                            vṛṣyā+a+ayuṣyā dhanyā kāntiyaśaḥ śrīvibodhanī medhyā| kurute
                            nṛpavallabhatāṃ jayaṃ vivāde ca vaktrasthā|| jitakhalativalīpalitaṃ
                            jīvayati sukhaṃ śatadvayaṃ śaradām|
                            varṣadvayaprayogādvarṣaśatacatuṣṭayaṃ jīvet||" [iti|] kharanāde
                            tūktam-"kanakādrajatāttāmrādayasaḥ sīsāttathā trapuṇaḥ|
                            girivivaraniḥsṛtaṃ tatkvāthasnigdhātimṛdumṛtsnam|| jatvābhaṃ ca śilājatu
                            vidyādetajjaḍātmakaṃ girijam| saṃraktapītavarṇaṃ satiktamadhuraṃ rase
                            kaṭuvipāki|| śītaṃ kanakaśilājatu viśeṣataḥ śleṣmapittaghnam|| śvetaṃ ca
                            tiktamadhuraṃ pācanavallekhanaṃ śītam| kiñcillavaṇaṃ
                            vidyā(rūpyā)dviśeṣato vātapittaghnam|| śitikaṇṭhatulyavarṇaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ
                            lekhanaṃ vipākakaṭu| kiñcillavaṇaṃ tāmrātmakaṃ smṛtaṃ
                            kaphakṛ(hṛ)dviśeṣeṇa|| guggulukābhaṃ snigdhaṃ tiktaṃ lavaṇaṃ saraṃ
                            viśadatīkṣṇam|| kaṭupākinātiśītaṃ trimalaghnaṃ tvāyasaṃ śreṣṭham||
                            svākarasamānavarṇe sīsatrapusambhave śilājatunī|| alpāntarakarmaguṇe
                            kṛṣṇāyasajācchilājatunaḥ|| gomūtragandhamasitaṃ guggulukābhaṃ viśarkaraṃ
                            mṛtsnam| snigdhamanamlakaṣāyaṃ śilodbhavaṃ sarvakarmaṇyam||" ityatra
                            gurumṛduguṇau noktau| tathoktam-"sasnehalavaṇabhāvādvātaghnaṃ pittanut
                            saratvāttat| rasapākayoḥ kaṭutvāttaikṣṇyācca śleṣmamedoghnam||
                            kaṭutīkṣṇatvāddīpanamagneruddīpanānmalān pacati| tiktatvādraktaghnaṃ
                            kaṭutaikṣṇauṣṇyāt kṛmighnaṃ ca|| śobhanabhāvāddṛṣyaṃ snigdhatvāt
                            pauṣṭikaṃ ca balyaṃ ca| āyuṣyaṃ ca viṣaghnaṃ maṅgalyamamṛtānvayatvācca||
                            śodhanabhāvāt srotodhātvindriyabuddhiśodhanaṃ varṇyam| putryaṃ ca
                            vṛṣyabhāvānmedhyaṃ yonisvabhāvācca||" ityādi| tathā
                            "bhāvitamanyairdravyairvīryotkarṣādviśeṣakarmaṇyam| tat
                            syāttasmādbhāvyaṃ vātādiharauṣadhakaṣāyaiḥ||
                            'rāsnādaśamūlabalāpunarnavairaṇḍaśuṇṭhimadhukānām| kvāthena bhāvitaṃ
                            tadviśeṣato vātarogaghnam|| drākṣā bhīrupaṭolītrāyantiguḍūcijīvanīyānām|
                            kvāthena bhāvitaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ pittarogaghnam||
                            triphalāvacāviḍaṅgakarañja ghanamukhyapañcamūlānām| sahapañcakolākānāṃ
                            kvāthena kaphāmaye bhāvyam||
                            laghupañcamūlaśuṇṭhīdrākṣākāśmaryavājigandhānām| suguḍūciśarabalānāṃ
                            rasena pittānilagadeṣu||
                            ghanakuṣṭhavacātriphalāsuradāruviḍaṅgapañcakolānām|
                            rajanīmaricātiviṣāyuktānāṃ vātakaphajeṣu||
                            pāṭhāpaṭolanimbatriphalāghanakuṭajasaptaparṇānām|
                            trāyantyamṛtātiviṣāsahitānāṃ pittakaphajeṣu (saṃ. u. a. 49)||" trimaleṣu
                            yathādoṣaṃ yogānetān vikalpya bhāvyaṃ syāt| prākkevalajaladhautaṃ śuṣkaṃ
                            kvāthaistato bhāvyam|| girijaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ kvāthyaṃ
                            syādbhāvanauṣadhaṃ tatra| caturthaśeṣe kvāthe pūtoṣṇe
                            prakṣipedgirijam||" iti| atra caturguṇajalasyauṣadhasya kvāthena
                            muktarasatā na tathā syāditi vāgbhaṭoktamevāṣṭaguṇajalakvāthena
                            kāryamiti manyāmahe| tathoktam-"salilaviśuddhādgirijāt pibedarogaḥ
                            phalatrikarasena| mātrāṃ kramābhivṛddhāṃ tryahaṃ paṭolasya ca rasena||
                            mūtreṇa gavāṃ tadvat tryahaṃ kaṣāyeṇa madhukasya|" iti| "rogānviteṣu
                            girijaṃ jalaśuddhaṃ bhāvitaṃ kaṣāyaiśca| doṣavyādhibalāturakālāpekṣī
                            prayuñjīta|| jīrṇauṣadhaḥ sukhodakapariṣikto māṃsarasapayoyūṣaiḥ|
                            raktādiṣaṣṭikaudanamanavamarogo gadī vā+adyāt|| vyādhyāturadoṣabalaṃ
                            dṛṣṭvā tasya tridhā prayogaḥ syāt| śreṣṭhastriṣaṣṭirātraṃ māso
                            madhyastrisaptarātramavaraḥ|| pānāvagāhayoḥ syāddivyaṃ śailodbhavaṃ
                            kaupam|" munistvasya caturdhātujatvameva saṃgirate| tathā ca tadgranthaḥ
                            (ca. ci. a. 1 pā. 2/47)- "anamlaṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca kātupāke śilājatu|
                            nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ cātubhyaścaturbhyastasya sambhavaḥ||| hemnaḥ
                            sarajatāttāmrādvaraṃ kṛṣṇāyasādapi|" iti| saṅgrahe ca
                            guggulukalpo+abhihitaḥ| yathā (u. a. 49)- "dānavendravijitān purā surān
                            bhraṣṭakāntidhṛtiśauryatejasaḥ| vīkṣya viṣṇuramṛtaṃ kilāsṛjadgugguluṃ
                            balavapurjayapradam|| adyāpyataḥ suragaṇāḥ kila dhūpamukhyān hitvā
                            varāguruturuṣkahimendudarpān| nirdahyamānavapuṣo+api śikhāṃ pibanto
                            gandhena yasya muditā dadhati prasādam|| sa yogavāhī sa śivaḥ sa sārvaḥ
                            sarvartusevyaḥ sukhaśīlanīyaḥ| hartā jarāpāpmamalāmayānāṃ
                            kartā+agnimedhāsmṛtipāṭavānām|| gandhotkaṭaḥ sa dāhe
                            snigdhadravapicchilo vigataśalyaḥ| mahiṣākhyaḥ
                            puṣparāgasphaṭikāsitanīradacchāyaḥ|| yaḥ padmarāgarāgo yaḥ
                            kanakacchedapātalo yo vā| jayatīndranīlamamalaṃ
                            bhagno+apyatikāntimattvena|| śreṣṭhaḥ prayogo+asya tulā palānnaivādhikaṃ
                            pibet| ātreyamunigītaśca mantro+ayaṃ karmasiddhikṛt|| 'bhagavān
                            puṇḍarīkākṣo devāśca sapurandarāḥ| ājñāpayanti samyaktvāṃ prabhāvaṃ
                            cādiśanti te|| jarāmaraṇaduḥkhebhyo yathā te+abhyutthitāḥ surāḥ|
                            upayoktustathaivāsya bhava tvaṃ hi mahābalaḥ||' iti| pañcamūlasya
                            mahataḥ kvāthena hitabhojinā| gugguluḥ śīlito hanti sarvān
                            vātakaphāmayān|| laghīyaso+api tadvacca sukhoṣṇena jalena vā|
                            mastudhānyāmlamadyairvā vacādeḥ salilena vā|| varaṇādestu bādhiryaṃ
                            dantakarṇaśirorujaḥ| svarabhedodaraścāsavardhmāntargulmavidradhīn||
                            vātapittāsrarogeṣu bṛṃhaṇārthini ceṣyate| kvāthena vājigandhāyā
                            jīvanīyagaṇasya vā|| kvāthenotpalamṛdvīkāraktacandanajanmanā| vātapittaṃ
                            nihantyeṣa padmakādigaṇasya vā|| cavyakuṣṭhaviḍaṅgānāṃ yavānyā nāgarasya
                            vā| prasāraṇyāśca toyena gugguluḥ kaphavātajit||
                            tryūṣaṇāgnighanavellavarābhirbhakṣayan samadhṛtaṃ mahiṣākṣam| āśu hanti
                            kaphamārutamedodoṣajān balavato+api vikārān||
                            paṭolanimbatriphalāguḍūcīgāyatrirātridvayabījakānām| kvāthaiḥ pṛthak
                            pathyaparasya hanti māsena ghorān kaphapittarogān||
                            viśeṣācchophavīrsarpaduṣṭavraṇabhagandarān|
                            śukrārtavamanodoṣapramehaśvitrapāṇḍutāḥ||
                            paṭolāriṣṭaniryūhapiṣṭastulyarasāñjanaḥ|
                            galarogāpacīvyaṅgagranthisthaulyakṛmipraṇut|| śilājatusamaḥ pītaḥ payasā
                            vātaśoṇitam| nivartayatyatibalaṃ kṣīramāṃsaghṛtāśinaḥ|| rasena payasā
                            mūtrairvātapittakaphāpahaḥ| brāhmīmaṇḍūkaśaṅkhānāṃ pṛthaṅh
                            medhādikṛdrasaiḥ|| māgadhikāgniviḍaṅgakaliṅgairbilvadhṛtaiḥ
                            savacāpalaṣaṭkaiḥ| guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ
                            sakalāmayanāśaḥ|| pibetpalaśataṃ yo+asya vidhinā niyato yatiḥ|
                            nākālamṛtyorna vyādherna tasya jaraso bhayam|| kalpayedoṣadhaiḥ svaiḥ
                            svairvyādhiṣu vyādhināśanaiḥ| śilājatuvidhānaṃ ca gugguloḥ
                            sarvamiṣyate|| guṇanidhirapi kuryāt
                            so+atimātropayuktastimiravadanaśoṣaklībatākārśyamehān|
                            śamalaśithilabhāvaṃ deharaukṣyaṃ ca tasmādrajanicaraniṣevī syānna
                            rogeṣvamīṣu||" [iti|]
ato+anyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ||143||

kṣaṇināṃ-vyāpārakaraṇaṃ prati svatantrāṇām, tathā
                            paricchadavatāṃ-saparivārāṇām, kuṭīpraveśalakṣaṇo vidhirhitaḥ|
                            ataḥ-asmāt, ye+anyathā-paratantrāḥ parivārarahitāḥ, teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko
                            vidhirhitaḥ|
sukhopacārā bhraṃśe+api ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ||144||

ataḥ-asmācca hetoḥ, ye vātātapasahā yogāste viśeṣeṇa vakṣyante| tathā ye
                            na duḥkhāvahāḥ, bhraṃśe+api-vyāpattāvapi, śarīrasya na pīḍākṛtaḥ|

śiśirajalādikamekaikaśo dviśastriśo vā prāgbhojanāt pītaṃ vayaḥ
                            sthāpayet| tena śītāmbho vā, kṣīraṃ vā, madhu-mākṣikaṃ vā, sarpirvā,
                            pītamathavā śītāmbhaḥpayasī, śītajalakṣaudre, śītadalaghṛte, ityevaṃ
                            yathāsambhavaṃ dve saṃyukte prākpīte+athavā trīṇi saṃyuktāni pītāni
                            samastaṃ vā catuṣṭayamityevamavatiṣṭhate|
guḍena madhunā śuṇṭhyā kṛṣṇayā lavaṇena vā||146||
dve dve khādan sadā pathye jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī||146||

guḍādinā pratyekaṃ dve dve harītakyau sarvadā bhakṣayan samāśataṃ sukhaṃ
                            jīvet|

harītakīṃ sarpiṣi sampratāpya samaśnatastat pibeto ghṛtaṃ
                                ca||147||

bhaveccirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakṛt kṛtaṃ sādhu yathā
                                kṛtajñe||147||

ghṛte harītakīṃ samyak tāpayitvā bhakṣayatastacca ghṛtaṃ pibato
                            dehe+atidṛḍhaṃ balaṃ sthirataraṃ bhavet| yathā kṛtajñe nare
                            sakṛt-ekavāraṃ, śobhanaṃ kṛtaṃ cirasthāyi bhavet| upendravajrā|
praṇāśamāyānti jarāvikārā granthā viśālā iva durgṛhītāḥ||148||

āmalakasvarasamākṣikaśarkarāghṛtāni narāṇāṃ hitāśanānāṃ lihatāṃ
                            jarāvikārāḥ praṇāśamāyanti| yathā viśālā granthā duḥpaṭhitāḥ praṇāśaṃ
                            yānti|
samudgake bījakasāraklṛpte lihan balī jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ||150||

lohacūrṇādikaṃ samudgake-sampuṭe, bījasāramaye varṣamātraṃ sthāpitaṃ
                            lihan balī-balasahitaḥ, kālakaco jīvati|

viḍaṅgādīni ye puruṣā madhvājyayutāni khādanti, te jarānadīṃ
                            gadakallolavatīṃ lāvaṇyavantastaranti-nirāmayā jīvantītyarthaḥ|
                            upajātayaḥ|
niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvantyarujaḥ kimatra citram||152||

khadirabījasārayūṣabhāvitāṃ triphalāṃ ghṛtamadhuyutāṃ niyamena ye
                            khādanti, te nirāmayā niścayena bhavanti, ityatra nāsti sandehaḥ|
                            aupacchandasikam|
niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvantyarujaḥ kimatra citram||152||

khadirabījasārayūṣabhāvitāṃ triphalāṃ ghṛtamadhuyutāṃ niyamena ye
                            khādanti, te nirāmayā niścayena bhavanti, ityatra nāsti sandehaḥ|
                            aupacchandasikam|

bījakasya rasamaṅgulihāryaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ triphalāṃ
                                ca||153||
śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarattā svāgatā+api vinivartata eva||153||

bījasārasya rasamaṅgulihāryamatikharaṃ śarkarādikaṃ ca śīlayannaro
                            jarābhāvaṃ suṣṭhvāgatamapyapākurute| svāgatākhyaṃ cedaṃ vṛttamiti
                            śleṣaleśaḥ| tallakṣaṇaṃ ca-"svāgatā ranubhagairgurukāntā|" iti|

māsadvayaṃ tattriguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇo+api bhūyaḥ sa punarnavaḥ
                                syāt||154||

punarnavasya pratyagrasya karṣadvayaṃ piṣṭaṃ māsārdhaṃ, māsadvayaṃ,
                            tattriguṇaṃ-ṣaṇmāsān, varṣaṃ vā, deśapuruṣādyapekṣayā yaḥ payasā pibet,
                            sa puruṣo jīrṇaśarīro+api punarnavo bhavet|

śatāvarīkalkakvāthābhyāṃ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ śarkarāsahitaṃ ye khādanti, tān
                            jīvitamārgamabhiprapannān vikāracaurā na chindanti| jīvitādhvānamiti
                            vikāracaurā iti samāsarūpakam| tasya hi lakṣaṇam-"upasarjanopameyaṃ
                            kṛtvā samāsametayorubhayoḥ| yatra prayujyate
                            tadrūpakamanyatsamāsoktam||" iti|

pītā+aśvagandhā payasā+ardhamāsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā
                                vā||157||

kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā
                                suvṛṣṭiḥ||157||

aśvagandhā+ardhamāsaṃ payasā ghṛtādyanyatamena vā pītā kṛśasya vapuṣaḥ
                            puṣṭiṃ karoti| yathā bālasya sasyasya śobhanā vṛṣṭiḥ|

anudinaṃ kṛṣṇatilapalaṃ śiśirajalānupānaṃ bhakṣayatāṃ śarīrasya
                            puṣṭirmahatī syāt| maraṇāvadhayaśca dvijā dṛḍhāḥ syuḥ|

vṛṣaḥ sthiraḥ śāntavikāraduḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati
                                kṛṣṇakeśaḥ||159||

gokṣurakādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ ghṛtamākṣikamiśraṃ lihan vṛṣādiguṇānvito varṣaśataṃ
                            kṛṣṇakaco jīvati| ṣaḍupajātayaḥ|
ye+adyurmayurā iva te manuṣyā ramyaṃ parīṇāmamavāpnuvanti||160||

kṛṣṇatilaiḥ saha dhātrīphalāni saṃkṣudya bibhītakāni harītakīrvā ye narā
                            bhakṣayeyuḥ, te śikhina iva ramaṇīyaṃ vayaḥpariṇāmaṃ
                            prāpnuvanti,-darśanīyā bhavantītyarthaḥ| indravajrāvṛttam|

ye māsamekaṃ svarasaṃ pibanti dine dine
                                bhṛṅgarajaḥsamuttham||162||

ye mārkavasvarasamanudinaṃ māsaṃ yāvat pibanti dugdha bhojanāḥ santaḥ, te
                            balavīryayutā varṣaśataṃ jīvitamaśnuvate|
māsaṃ vacāmapyupasevamānāḥ kṣīreṇa tailena ghṛtena vā+api||163||

vacāṃ ca māsaṃ kṣīrādyanyatamenopayuñjānā rākṣasairanupadrutarūpā
                            medhāvanto jvaladujvalavacanāśca syuḥ| medhāvina iti "asmāyāmedhāsrajaḥ"
                            iti viniḥ| upajātayaḥ|

maṇḍūkaparṇīṃ ghṛtena pakvāṃ khādanto māsamanannāśino mahāntaṃ kālaṃ
                            jīvanti prāgalbhyādiguṇayuktāḥ| indravajrāvṛttam|

chāyāviśuṣkaṃ gulikārdhamadyāt pūrvaṃ samastāmapi tāṃ
                                krameṇa||166||

bhajedviriktaḥ kramaśaśca maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ vilepīṃ rasakaudanaṃ
                                ca||166||

sarpiḥsnigdhaṃ māsamekaṃ yatātmā māsādūrdhvaṃ sarvathā
                                svairavṛttiḥ||167||

bhavati vigatarogo yo+apyasādhyāmayārtaḥ prabalapuruṣakāraḥ śobhate
                                yo+api vṛddhaḥ||168||

lāṅgalyādīnāṃ palapaścāśatā bhṛṅgasvarasena kṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭyā+adhikaṃ
                            gulikānāṃ śatatrayaṃ chāyāviśuṣkam| tato gulikāyā ardhaṃ pūrvamadyāt|
                            krameṇa tāṃ samastāmapi bhuñjīta| tato viriktaḥkrameṇa maṇḍādīnadyāt|
                            upajātirvṛttam| māsamekaṃ sarpiḥsnigdhamannaṃ jitātmā bhuñjīta|
                            māsādanantaraṃ yatheṣṭabhojanaḥ syāt| sarvadā tu yatnenājīrṇaṃ varjyam|
                            evaṃ anena prakāreṇa, varṣeṇa sarvā gulikā upayuñjyāt| [ śālinīvṛttam| ]
                            kṛtopayogo nīrogo yo+apyasādhyarogārto, vṛddho+api prakṛṣṭapuruṣakāravān
                            jāyate| puṣṭavistīrṇaśarīraḥ praśastanayanakarṇādimāṃstaruṇa iva pañca
                            varṣaśatāni jīvati| [ mālinīvṛttam| ]

vimalakhaṇḍasitāmadhubhiḥ pṛthak yutamayuktamidaṃ yati vā
                                ghṛtam||171||

gāyatryādīn piṣṭvā+aṣṭādaśaguṇe jale lauhaiḥ śakalaiḥ saha dhṛtānāyase
                            bhājane trīṇi dināni dinakarakarairāśoṣayan pācayet| paścādatīkṣṇe
                            vahnau lohaśakalaiḥ saha pādasthitaṃ tat pacet| śārdūlavikrīḍitam|
                            pūtasyāsya bhāgaḥ, kṣīrādaṃśaḥ, bhṛṅgarajaḥkvāthādaṃśau dvau, tathā
                            varāyāścāṃśāstrayaḥ, ghṛtādaṃśāścatvāraḥ, etatsarvaṃ melayitvā kṛṣṇalohe
                            pacet| vaiśvadevīvṛttam| ujjvalakhaṇḍaśarkarāmākṣikaiḥ pṛthagyutamayutaṃ
                            vā ghṛtametadātmecchayā kṛtāhārapānavihāro naraḥ palaṃ palamaśnan
                            śrīmadādiyuto bhavet| drutavilambitavṛttam| śrīmānnirdhūtapāpmā bhavet|
                            tathā vanamahiṣatulyabalaḥ, vājinaḥ-aśvasya, vegena samaḥ,
                            sthirāṅgaḥ-dṛḍhaśarīraḥ, tathā keśairbhramarakṛṣṇairupalakṣito bhavet,
                            tathā madhuvatsurabhimukhaḥ syāt, tathā bahustrīgamanasāmarthyayuktaḥ
                            syāt, tathā vāṅmedhādibhiḥ samṛddhaḥ, tathā suṣṭhu paṭuḥ-tīkṣṇo,
                            hutavahaḥ-agniḥ, yasya sa tathāvidho, māsamātropayogāt-syāt| asau-asya
                            ghṛtasyopayoktā, narasiṃhasadṛśaṃ śarīramatidārḍhyayogāt tathā
                            vahniśikhāsantaptasuvarṇakāntiṃ dhārayediti| sragdharāvṛttam|
                            narasiṃhākhyasya haviṣo bhoktāraṃ rogā na spṛśantyeva,-āsatāṃ
                            tāvadvyādhayaḥ| yathā nārasiṃhaṃ rūpaṃ cakrojjvalabhujaṃ praveṣṭuṃ
