                            daityā bhītyā(tāḥ) spraṣṭumaśaktāḥ, ityupamā|

mārkavapallavānetenaiva sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭān yo+aśnāti [ni]-yataḥ
                            śuddhakoṣṭhaḥ san| bījakasārasiddhakṣīrānupaḥ, tenaiva-asanasārasiddhena
                            dugdhena, kṛtabhojanārthaḥ-taddvṛttirityarthaḥ| saḥ-puruṣo, māsopayogāt
                            sukhī-nīrogo, varṣaśate dve jīvati| tathaikavāramapi kathitaṃ gṛhṇāti|
                            kīdṛk san ? aviluptāni smṛtīndriyāṇi yasya sa evam|

anenaiva vidhānena yaḥ puruṣastailamupayojayet, sa tāneva-pūrvoktān
                            guṇān, prāpnoti| kṛṣṇakacaśca sampadyate| saṃ-rasāyanāni yāni śakyāni
                            phalayuktāni yugānurūpāṇi ca tānyuktāni| aparāṇi cāśakyāni yāni
                            mahāphalānyapi tāni na kathitāni| upajātiḥ|

rasāyanasya vidhibhraṃśāt-vyapāyāt, yadi rogā bhaveyuḥ, tato rasāyanaṃ
                            vihāya teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ sarvamauṣadhaṃ kāryam|

satyabhāṣiṇaṃ, tathā krodharahitaṃ, tathā+adhyātmapravaṇāni
                            yogapravaṇāni, indriyāṇi yasya taṃ, tathā śamayuktaṃ, tathā
                            saddṛttanirataṃ, sthitamevaṃbhūtaṃ naraṃ nityarasāyanaṃ jānīyāt|
sa nivṛttātmā dīrghāyuḥ paratreha ca modate||180||

ebhiḥ-satyavacanādibhirguṇaiḥ, saṃyuktaḥ puruṣo rasāyanaṃ sevate yaḥ, sa
                            puruṣo nivṛttacito dīrghāyuśca sanniha modate+anyajanmani ca|

ceṣṭā śāstrānusāriṇī, pārśvasīnāśca cittavidaḥ, artheṣu-viṣayeṣu,
                            buddhiraskhalitā, ityetat paripūrṇaṃ rasāyanamiti| iti
                            śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ
                            sarvaṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne rasāyanavidhi- rnāma
                            ekonacatvāriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 39||

vājīvayena samarthaḥ kriyate, tadvājīkaraṇam, tasyādhyāyaḥ|
                            śeṣamāyuṣkāmīyavadyojyam|

viṣayī yaḥ puruṣaḥ, sa satataṃ vājīkaraṇamauṣadhamanvicchet| puṃgrahaṇaṃ
                            strīṣaṇḍhādinivṛttyartham, anyathā yathā pañcakarmāṇi ṛtuvidhānādi ca
                            sāmānyoktatvāt stryādīnāmapi prasajjati, tathedamapi vijñāyate,
                            tasmāttadvyavacchedārthaṃ puṃgrahaṇam|
                            satatagrahaṇenaitaddyotayati,-yathā rasāyanamupayuktaṃ
                            cirakālamanuvartate na tathā vājīkaraṇamiti| api tu yasminnevāhni
                            prayujyate tasminneva kāryakaraṇasamarthaṃ prāyeṇa syāditi
                            satataṃ-anavarataṃ, vājīkaraṇamanvicchedityuktam| vājīkaraṇena ko+arthaḥ
                            syāt ? ityāha-

tatra vājīkaraṇe tuṣṭyādi saṃśritam| apatyaṃ kimbhūtam ? guṇavat, na tu
                            durapatyaṃ kulāṅgārarūpam| yato+apatya[nāṃ]
                            santānakaraṃ-avicchedasthitikaraṃ ca, yacca sadyaḥ-śīghrameva,
                            saṃpraharṣaṇaṃ vājīkaraṇam|

yena vājīkaraṇena turaṅga ivāpratihatasāmarthyastarūṇīḥ saṃgacchati,
                            tathā yena yoṣitāmativallabhaḥ syāt, tathā yenopacayaṃ prāpnopti,
                            tadvājīkaraṇamucyate| taddhi śarīrasyorjaskaramatiśayena| nanu,
                            vājīkaraṇamupāyaheturviṣayāṇāmihaiva bandhanadarśanāt| uktaṃ ca
                            tantrāntare-"kośakāro yathaivāṃśūnupādatte vandhavahān" ityādi|
                            tasmānnārtho vājīkaraṇenetyāha-

yato dharmādanapetaṃ-dharmyaṃ, brahmacaryaṃ tadanumodāmahe| tathā
                            yaśasyādihetuḥ| tathā lokadvaye-ihaloke paraloke ca, rasāyanamiva
                            rasāyanaṃ, sadopakāratvāt| tathā ekāntenasarvathā, nirmalam| yato
                            brahmacaryam| na tu brahmacaryavat svadārādi(re)ṣu putrādyarthameva
                            nirmalam| ato hetostadanumodāmahe| kintvābhyudayikaṃ mārgamāśritya
                            vājīkaraṇopadeśaḥ| dvividho hi mārgaḥ,-naiḥśreyasika ābhyudayikaśca|
                            tatra naiḥśreyasikaṃ mārgaṃ samanusṛtya brahmacaryopadeśaśca
                            kośakāradṛṣṭantaśca kleśanāśakṛcca| ābhyudayikaṃ ca
                            mārgamāśrityāyamupadeśa ityatrāha|

stokasattvasya puṃsaḥ kleśairviṣayotthaiḥ pīḍyamānasya rāgiṇaḥ-kāminaḥ,
                            śarīrakṣayarakṣārthaṃ vājīkaraṇmucyate| anena śāstrakṛtā, aparaiśca
                            tantrakāraiḥ|

kalpa(lya)sya-samarthasya, tathā yauvanasthasya, vājīkaraṇaṃ satataṃ
                            kurvataḥ, tasya sarveṣveva ṛtuṣu dine dine vyavāyo maithunaṃ, na
                            niṣidhyate|

atha-kṛtamaṅgalasya, snigdhasya tathā viśuddhasya tathā kṣīrādyāśino
                            yogavit-vaidyaḥ, prāṅh nirūhān sānuvāsanān ghṛtādisaṃyuktān kārayet|
                            tataḥ-anantaraṃ, vājīkarān yogān yojayet| kimbhūtān ? śukrādipradān|

acchāyatvādibhirguṇairyukto+arthināṃ yathā taruranāśrayaṇīyaḥ, tathā
                            tādṛśo mānavo nirapatya iti| ekavacanenaiva ekārthasya
                            labdhatvādekagrahaṇaṃ kevalārthapratipattyartham| ekaḥ
                            kevalomādhavīlatādirahitaḥ|

skhaladgamanādikamapatyaṃ kena padārthena darśanādiṣu samānam| kiṃ
                            punaryadyaśādivardhanāt tasya kena tulyatā bhavet ? apatyaśabdasya
                            puṃstvamatra cintyam(?)| tatkila nitarāṃ sukhapradamityarthaḥ|
mede dve dve ca kākolyau śūrpaparṇyau śatāvarīm||13||
vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭiṃ phalgūni pippalīm||17||

śarādīnāṃ mūlāni kaṇṭakāryāśca, tathā jīvakādīn, tripalikān bhāgān
                            pṛthak, māṣāṇāmāḍhakaṃ ca, etatsarvaṃ jaladroṇadvaye pācayet| tena
                            rasenāḍhakaśeṣeṇa ghṛtāḍhakaṃ dattvā vidāryādirasādīnāṃ ca
                            pṛthakpṛthagāḍhakaṃ dattvā kṣīrāḍhakacatuṣṭayaṃ ca dattvā pacet| vīrādīn
                            kalkān sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇānnikṣipet| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pakvaṃ pūtaṃ
                            pṛthak śarkarātugayoścūrṇaprasthena kaṇāyāḥ palacatuṣṭayena maricapalena
                            ca yojayet| tvagādibhiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ pṛthagardhapalonmitaiḥ kṣaudrasya
                            kuḍavayugalena yojayet| tato miśritāt palamātraṃ pratidinaṃ bhakṣayet,
                            māṃsarasakṣīrabhojī san| tenopayuktena turaṅga ivārohati| caṭaka iva
                            hṛṣyati|

vidāryādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kapikacchumūlācca cūrṇaṃ pṛthak kuḍavamātraṃ,
                            mākṣikasya ca kuḍavaḥ, śarkarāpalāni pañcāśat, pratyagraghṛtasya palāni
                            ṣoḍaśa, ataḥ-saṃyojitāt, karṣamātraṃ sa khādet yasya bhavane
                            kāntāśatamasti|

godhūmān sakapikacchuphalān dugdhe sādhitān himān māṣān vā
                            ghṛtamākṣikānvitān khādan gṛṣṭikṣīramanu pibedyaḥ, sa sarvāṃ
                            rātrimakhinno rāmā ramayan jayati(jāgarti)|

chāgalāṇḍapakve kṣīre tilānasakṛdbhāvitān saśarkarān yaḥ khādet, sa
                            kāntāśatamapūrva iva yāti|

śṛgālikāyāścūrṇaṃ vidārīsvarasenaiva bahuśo bhāvitaṃ madhughṛtayuktaṃ
                            līḍhvā rāmāśataṃ yāti|

kṛṣṇāmalakacūrṇaṃ dhātrīsvarasena subhāvitaṃ śarkarākṣaudraghṛtairlīḍhvā
                            yo+anu kṣīraṃ pibet, sa puruṣo+aśītivarṣo+api taruṇa iva hṛṣyati|
payo+anupānaṃ yo lihyānnityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet||29||

madhuyaṣṭikācūrṇasya karṣaṃ ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ kṣīrānupānaṃ yo leḍhi,
                            so+apraṇaṣṭavegaḥ puruṣaḥ syāt|

karkaṭaśṛṅgyāḥ kalkaṃ kṣīreṇāloḍya yaḥ pibedcharkarāsarpiḥkṣīrānnabhuk,
                            sa rāmāsu vṛṣāyate|
pibedbāṣkayaṇaṃ cānu kṣīraṃ na kṣayameti saḥ||31||

kṣīrakākolīṃ kṣīrasiddhām mākṣikaghṛtayutāṃ yaḥ khādet,
                            baṣkayaṇīkṣīramanuḥ yaḥ pibet, sa śukrakṣayaṃ na yāti|

kapikacchvikṣurakabījacūrṇaṃ śarkarāsahitaṃ dhāroṣṇena kṣīreṇa pītvā naro
                            bāleya ivācarati|

dadhnaḥ saraṃ śaśidhavalaṃ śarkarāṣaṣṭikaudanayuktaṃ vastreṇa
                            subhāvi(mārji)taṃ bhuktvā vṛddho+api taruṇa ivācarati|
śvadaṃṣṭrādīn kṣīreṇa piban vṛddho+api rāmāśataṃ yāti|

yatkiñcidvastu madhurādiguṇaṃ cittaharṣajananaṃ ca, tatsarvamapi vṛṣyaṃ
                            kathyate|

tasmādevaṃprakāralirdravyaiḥ kṛtadarpaḥ śataṃ lalanānāṃ yāyāt| na kevalaṃ
                            vṛṣyadravyairdarpito yāvadātmavegena codīrṇaḥ-preritaḥ| na tu
                            vājīkaraṇaṃ me yuktamiti yoṣitaṃ gacchet|
                            strīguṇaiḥ-lāvaṇyakaumalyādibhiḥ , kṛtapraharṣaḥ san|

\ kimbhutāḥ ? sarvendriyāṇāṃ sukhahetavaḥ, tathā dharma eva
                            kalpavṛkṣe+aṅkurā ivāṅkurāḥ| tathā puṣpacāpasya pañcaśilīmukhā iti
                            vākyarūpakam|
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṅghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ||38||

yasmādekaiskaśo+api-vyastā api, arthāḥ-śabdādayaḥ sevyamānāḥ, paraṃ
                            harṣaprītyutpādakāḥ| kimuta striyāḥ śarīre ye samudāyena
                            vyavasthitāḥ|
nāmāpi yasyā hṛdayotsavāya yāṃ paśyatāṃ tṛptiranāptapūrvā||39||

priyaṃvadā tulyamanaḥśayā yā sā strī vṛṣatvāya paraṃ
                                narasya||40||

yasyāḥ striyā nāmāpi hṛdayotsavāya| yaṃ striyamālokayatāmanāptapūrvā
                            tṛptiḥ syāt| tathā yā+aśeṣāṇāṃ karaṇānāmākarṣaṇapāśaḥ| tathā
                            kāntasya-bhartuḥ, anuvartanaṃ tadeva vrataṃ tatra yā dīkṣitā|
                            indravajrāvṛttam| tathā kalādaya eva vibhūṣā yasyāḥ saivam| tathā
                            śuciḥ-antarbahiśca, lajjānvitā, rahasisurate, prauḍhā| tathā
                            saumyavacanā| tathā tulyaḥ-samo, manaḥśayo-manasijo, yasyāḥ saivaṃ yā,
                            sā strī-vāmalocanā, paraṃ atiśayena, puṃso vṛṣatvāya kalpate|
                            upajātiḥ|

tathā kāmasūtre vihitā yā sakalā raticaryā tāmagarhyāṃ deśādivaśādācaret|
                            tathā vaidyakaśāstrācāre+aviruddhām| svāgatāvṛttam|

tathā+abhyañjanādi vājīkaraṇamiti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|
                            gītādikuśalāstulyasvabhāvā vaśagāḥ sahāyāḥ| tathā
                            dīrghikākrīḍāpuṣkariṇī, svagṛhasamīpe kṛtā| padmareṇumadhudbhyāṃ mattā
                            vihaṅgā yasyāṃ saivam| haritasamabhūbhāgaṃ yatparvataśṛṅgaṃ, tasya
                            nitambaḥ, tatra ca yāni kānanāni, tāni purasamīpabhūtāni| upajātisvāgate
                            vṛtte| dṛṣṭisukhakāriṇī tathā nānāprakārā mahīruhajātiḥ|
                            kalakaṇṭhakūhitaṃ śravaṇasukhakāri| aṅge sukhānurodhena ṛtvanurodhena ca
                            bhūṣaṇam| tathā sakalaḥ parivāro manaḥsukhahetuḥ| tathā tāmbūlādikaṃ
                            vājīkaraṇam| na ca kevalaṃ tāmbūlādikam, api tu yadyacca kiñciccetasaḥ
                            priyaṃ tattat vājīkaraṇam| dodhakamudgītirāryā|

madhu mukhamiva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kalaraṇanā parivādinī
                                priyeva||46||
vājīkarāḥ sannihitāśca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti||47||

tathā mārdvīkaṃ sajalajaṃ dayitāvadanamiva| parivādinī-vīṇā,
                            madhurakvaṇanā vallabheva| puṣpanikararamaṇīyā śayyāpallavavatī
                            kusumapradhānā lateva| puṣpitāgreti vṛttanāmaśleṣaḥ| deśa ityādi| ete
                            padārthāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ-icchāṃ pūrayanti, kāmamutpādayantītyarthaḥ|
                            puṣpitāgrendravajre vṛtte|

mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare, tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭodbhavaṃ,
                                lājāśchardiṣu, bastijeṣu girijaṃ, meheṣu dhātrīniśe||48||

pāṇḍau śreṣṭhamayo+abhayā+anilakaphe, plīhāmaye pippalī, sandhāne
                                kṛmijā, viṣe śukatarurmedonile gugguluḥ||48||

sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ, krimiṣu kṛmighnaṃ, śoṣe surā cchāgapayo+atha
                                māṃsam||49||

akṣyāmayeṣu triphalā, guḍūcī vātāsraroge, mathitaṃ
                                grahaṇyām||50||

kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ, sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ
                                ca||50||
unmādaṃ ghṛtamanavaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ, vyapasmṛtiṃ brahmī||51||

māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ, laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ, stabdhagātratāṃ
                                svedaḥ||52||
samaśuktārdrakamātrā mande vahnau, śrame surā snānam||55||
kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ, sarpiḥ pittaṃ, samīraṇaṃ tailam||57||

mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare śreṣṭhaṃ-rogopaśamanahetuḥ| evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi yojyam|
                            sandhāne-uraḥsandhāne, kṛmijā-lākṣā, śreṣṭhā| śukataruḥ-śirīṣaḥ|
                            śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam| vṛṣādayo raktapittādiṣu śreṣṭhāḥ| upajātiḥ|
                            akṣyāmayādiṣu triphalādīni sevyāni| indravajrā| anavaṃ-purāṇaṃ, sarpiḥ
                            kartṛbhūtamunmādaṃ jayati| vyapasmṛtiṃ-apasmāraṃ, brāhmī jayati| evaṃ
                            kṣīrādayo nidrānāśādīn jayantītiyojyam| guḍamañjarī-kālā śālmalī, tasyāḥ
                            khapuro-niryāso, nasyena skandhādijāṃ rujaṃ hanti| navanītayuktaṃ
                            khaṇḍamarditam| auṣṭraṃ payo mūtraṃ ca jaṭharaṃ parākaroti| auṣṭramiti
                            cintyam| uṣṭrādruñi prāpte kecittu tasyedamiti vivakṣayā aṇpratyayaḥ
                            kārya ityāhuḥ| nasyādayo mūrdhavikārādīn jahatīti sambandhaḥ| nanu,
                            vṛddhatvaṃ kṣīraghṛte hata ityanupapannam| tathāhi-"ekarasābhyāso
                            daurbalyakarāṇām|" (ca. sū. a. 25) ityuktam| daurbalyakaraṇaṃ ca kathaṃ
                            vṛddhatvahṛt syāt ? brūmaḥ| utsargatvāttasya vacasaḥ, apavādarūpaṃ
                            tvidaṃ vacanam| tasmāt kṣīraghṛtādanyatraikarasābhyāsasya
                            daurbalyakaraṇtvaṃ vedyam| gītayastisraḥ(pañca)| kāsetyādi| [
                            bastirityādi|] āryā| iti-uktena prakāreṇa, yacchreṣṭhamauṣadhamuktam,
                            tad rogāṇāṃ śamāya-śāntyai, alaṃ-samartham| tacca-agnyaṃ, deśādīnāṃ
                            balena yathāsvaṃ kalpanīyam| jaghanacapalā+a+aryā| etacca yathāsvaṃ
                            cikitsiteṣu kathitaṃ saṅkṣepatayā punaḥ kathitam| śāstraṃ hi vyāsena
                            samāsena ca vimatayo virundhate| tasmāt pūrvaṃ vyāsenopadeśaḥ,
                            idaṃ(ayaṃ) tu samāsenetyavabudhyasva|

ātreyāt-bhagavataḥ punarvasoḥ, iti-uktena prakāreṇa,
                            arthasūtraṃ-abhidheyatattvaṃ ca, āgamayya-avabudhya, agniveśaḥ
                            saṃśayāno-na tu śāstrāvabodhāhaṃkṛtaḥ, idaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, papraccha|
                            kimbhūtaḥ ? tasya-ātreyasya muneḥ, sūktāni-subhāṣitāni,
                            yuktiyuktārthapratipādanātteṣāṃ sūktānāṃ madhurāṇāmatṛptaḥsākāṅkṣaḥ|
                            tathā ca kimbhūtaḥ ? bheḍajātūkarṇyādīnāṃ punarvasuśiṣyāṇāṃ sammataḥ|
                            tathā bhaktinamro-na tu jñānoddhataḥ san, sa papraccha|
                            śālinīvṛttam|

bhagavan-punarvaso, kecinnarā ātmavanto hitāhāravihārā api rogiṇaḥ
                            pratyakṣānumānādyairupalabhyante|
                            ātmavanto+apītyapiśabdādanātmavanto+api| kadācit
                            śeṣapādatrayavikalatvena rogitvaṃ syāt, netyāha-dravyopasthātṛsampannā
                            vṛddhavaidyamatānugā iti| tathā+a+amayāśca prāṇāścāmayaprāṇāḥ, kṣīyamāṇā
                            āmayaprāṇā yeṣāṃ ta evam, kecidrogādvimucyamānāḥ kecicca mriyamāṇā
                            ityarthaḥ| viparītāstathā+apara iti anātmavanto dravyopasthātṛvikalā
                            vṛddhavaidyamatānanusāriṇaścaivaṃbhāvā dṛśyante|
                            tasmāt-anantaroktātkāraṇāt, hitāhitavibhāgasya tantroktaṃ
                            phalamaniścitaṃ-anaikāntikam| aniścitaphalatvācca kāraṇāt
                            śāstraṃ-āyurvedākhyaṃ, kiṃ śāsti ? na-kiñcicchikṣayatīti|
                            ataścaitadārambho niṣphalaḥ kākadantaparīkṣāśāstravat| iti vikalpayataḥ
                            śiṣyagaṇasya-jātūkarṇyabheḍādeḥ, bhagavān punarvasustattvaṃ-paramārthaṃ,
                            kārtsnyena-sāmastyena, jagāda| kimbhūtasya śiṣyagaṇasya ? agniveśo
                            mukhyaḥ-pradhāno, yasya tasyeti|

cikitsā-catuṣpātṣoḍaśaguṇayuktā, acikitsā-hitāhitavibhāgāparāmarśe
                            yatkiñcanakāritā, sā tulyā bhavituṃ nārhati| keṣām ? kriyāṃ vinā
                            svāsthyamapi gacchatām| apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ,
                            svāsthyamapī+atyato+anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| kimbhūtayā kriyayā ?
                            ṣoḍaśāṃśayā| tadayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-ṣoḍaśa bhāgayā cikitsayā vinā yatra
                            rogopaśāntiḥ syāt, tatrāpi cikitsayā kṣiprataraṃ tatsādhanaṃ cikitsā
                            viśiṣṭā| tathā cikitsāsādhyānāṃ rohiṇikādīnāṃ cikitsāmantareṇa
                            śāntirnāsti| tadevamapi cikitsayā tulyā+acikitsā na
                            bhavitumarhatīti|

tasmādātaṅka eva paṅko duruttaratvāttasmin magnānāṃ taptānāṃ,
                            bhiṣagjitaṃ-tadupadeśakaśāstraṃ, upacārādevamuktam| tadbhiṣagjitaṃ
                            hastālambo-hastālambatulyam| mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmevāsādhyānāmapi
                            bheṣajājjīvitaṃ na ca bhavati|
na hyupāyamapekṣante sarve rogā, na cānyathā||65||

yasmāt sarve rogāḥ-asādhyā api, upāyaṃ-catuṣpādalakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ,
                            nāpekṣante, asādhyarogāṇāṃ cikitsānirapekṣatvāt| ye copāyasādhyā
                            rogāḥ-rohiṇyādayaḥ, te+anyathā cikitsāmantareṇa, naiva sidhyanti| yato
                            yo+ahetuḥ sa hetumānna bhavati| api tu niryuktika evāyaṃ hetuvādaḥ,
                            yaccikitsākhyena hetunā vinaiva rogopaśāntirddaśya iti|

yattūktaṃ sarvasampattiyuktayā+api cikitsayā mṛtyurbhavati| dṛśyante
                            bhagavan kecidātmavanto+api rogiṇaḥ| yāvatkṣīyamāṇāmayaprāṇāḥ ityādi|
                            tadevaṃ na bhavati, yathā tvaṃ vadasi| yasmānna upāye+anupāyatā+asti| yo
                            hi yasya yayā yuktyopāyaḥ prathitaḥ, sa na kadācittasyānupāyaḥ|
                            yathā,-ghaṭasya mṛddaṇḍacakrādisāmagrīviśeṣo na kadācidanupāyo
                            bhaviturmahati| tasmāccatuṣpāccikitsāsādhyasya rogasyopāya eva cikitsā,
                            na tvanupāyaḥ|

dhīmataḥ-prājñasya narasya, upāyayuktasyāpi daivāparādhāt iyaṃ
                            ṣoḍaśātmikā kriyā kadācinna sidhyati| ta(ya)smādāyuḥ parīkṣya
                            sādhyāsādhyavibhāgjño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsāyāṃ vaidyaḥ pravartate
                            tasmāddaivavaiguṇyam| vimalavipulamatyā samyak paricchedāccikitsāyā
                            rogaviṣaye pravṛttāyāḥ siddhireva syānnāsiddhiḥ| yasmādyo yatropāyaḥ, sa
                            tatrānupāyo na bhavati| muninā+apyuktam (ca.sū. a.
                            10/7)-"sādhyāsādhyavībhāgajño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsakaḥ| kāle cārabhate
                            karma yattatsādhayati dhruvam||" iti|
na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam||68||

kasya puruṣasya vahniḥ svedakarmaṇi, stambhanakarmaṇi ca toyaṃ, na
                            siddham| ādiśabdānmūrcchāpagamādau śītānilādiḥ| api tu sarvasyaiva
                            siddho+anvayavyatirekāt| evaṃ yāvadrohiṇikādiṣviti vyākhyeyam| evaṃ
                            niścitaphalā cikitseti sthitam|

na kevalaṃ pūrvoktāddhetościkitsātantraṃ saphalam| yataścākālamaraṇaṃ
                            sarvasiddhāntaniścitam| tadanyathā-cikitsāśāstramantareṇa, parameṇāpi
                            yatnena kathaṃ-kena prakāreṇa, nirvāyatām ? na kenacidityarthaḥ|

dāhādau viṣaye candanādi cāgamapūrvakameva lokarūḍham, na tvevameva|
                            tathā śāstrādeva-cikitsākhyāt, sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ jvare
                            laṅghanabṛṃhaṇaṃ bhaktacchedakṣīrādi siddhimupagatam, nānyasmāt|

tasmāccatuṣpādā[nāṃ] ye guṇāḥ-āyuṣkamīyoktāḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 1/27), taiḥ
                            sampanne-yukte, tathā suṣṭhu nirūpya deśakālādīn yojite cikitsite,
                            vyādhinirghātaṃ prati vicikitsāṃ-saṃśayaṃ, mā kṛthāḥ|

yataścākāṇḍe-akāle, mṛtyupāśāḥ-jvarādayasteṣāṃ etat-cikitsāśāstraṃ,
                            dṛḍhaṃ-sāraṃ, chedanam| tathā samutpannebhyo jvarādibhyastrastānāṃ
                            śaṅkayā bhītānāṃ sūtrarahitaṃ rakṣāsūtrakaṃ, tatkāryakaraṇādityarthaḥ|
                            tasmādadhyetavyaṃ cikitsāśāstram|

tathaitat-cikitsāśāstraṃ, tat-sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ, sākṣāt-svarūpeṇa,
                            amṛtaṃ mṛtyujaye, ta(ya)t lokaprasiddhaṃ jagataḥ surāsurarūpasya,
                            āyāsādutpannaṃ kṣīrodamathanakāle, tena varjitamidam| amṛtamapi
                            durbhājanasthitaṃ sadyaḥ-śīghrameva, viṣatvaṃ yāti|

ajñātaḥ śāstrasadbhāvaḥ-paramārtho, yaistāṃstathāvidhān bhiṣakpāśān
                            dūratastyajet| tathā śāstramātraparāyaṇān-śāstrapāṭhamātraśaraṇān| ata
                            eva viṣasāmānyataḥ śāstrapāṭhamātratvena niṣiddham| tathā
                            śāstraparamārthānavabodhācca viṣatvam| kāniva ?
                            vaivasvātān-yamasambandhinaḥ, pāśān yathā| iti tāvadasampūrṇān|

suvaidyānāṃ saccaritānāmiha loke+anyatra ca sadaiva bhadram| kiṃvidhānām
                            ? āgamena-granthato+arthataḥ, ślāghituṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣām| īdṛśā
                            apyanabhyastakarmāṇo na ślāghārhāḥ syurityāha,
                            abhyastaṃ-asakṛttailalehādipākādyanuvāsananirūhādiyojanaṃ ca, [karma]
                            yaisteṣāṃ lokadvaye+api bhadram| sarvasattvānāṃ putramitrādirūpeṇa
                            bhadramiva hitaṃ sukhaṃ cābhilaṣanti-icchanti ye, teṣāmapi
                            bhadraṃ-śastam|

tantryate-dhāryate śarīramaneneti tantram, tasya
                            guṇāstantraguṇāḥ,-yaistantramalaṅkriyate tantrayuktyādayaḥ,
                            tairevaZṃprakārairyuktam| tathā coktaṃ saṅgrahe (u. a.50)-"alaṅkṛtaṃ
                            yuktipadaiḥ sadratnairiva kāñcanam| ṣaṭtriṃśatā+arthadurgeṣu bhiṣajāṃ
                            saṅkramairiva|| tatrādhikaraṇaṃ yogo hetvartho+arthaḥ padasya ca|
                            pradeśoddeśanirdeśavākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam||
                            upadeśāpadeśātideśārthāpattinirṇayāḥ| prasaṅgaikāntanaikāntāḥ sāpavargo
                            viparyayaḥ|| pūrvapakṣavidhānānumatavyākhyānasaṃśayāḥ|
                            atītānāgatāpekṣāsvasaṃjñohyasamuccayāḥ|| nidarśanaṃ nirvacanaṃ
                            niyogo+atha vikalpanam| pratyutsārastathoddhāraḥ
                            sambhavastantrayuktayaḥ||" iti|

idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ tantraṃ, mantravadācaritaṃ saṃprayoktavyam| na
                            kathañcidapi mīmāṃsyam,-kimidaṃ syādvā naveti saṃśayo na kārya
                            ityarthaḥ| kasmāt ? suviśuddhajñānebhyo mahāmunibhya āgamena śuddhatvāt,
                            tathā pratyakṣaphalasya-jvaracikitsādikasya, darśanāt|

ataḥ-aṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyāttantrāt,
                            pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānaiḥ-rogacikitsālakṣaṇena, dhruvaṃ-avaśyaṃ,
                            dīrṅajīvitādīn prāpnoti| na ca tāneva prāpnoti| kiṃ tarhi ?
                            paramapītyāha-

etat-anantaroktamaṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, adhīyānaḥ(paṭhan)-kaṇṭhe
                            dadhat,
                            saṅgrahabodhaśaktaḥ-etadgranthārthaviśeṣa-śeṣavastvavabodhārtham| tasmāt
                            svabhyastakarmā ata eva pāṭhāvabodhaḥ| svabhyastakarmā-tasya
                            guṇaśatayogādaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasya vyākhyānāmanyeṣāṃ bheṣajakarmajena
                            satsvabhyastakarmaṇā cikitsakaḥ, akṣobhyaḥ san, anyeṣu-carakādiṣu,
                            viśālatantreṣu vihitābhiyogān vaidyān yadi kampayati-kṣobhayati,
                            tannāścaryam| upajātirvṛtam| yathā cākampayante+apare bhiṣajastathā
                            darśayannāha-

atha carakavihīnaḥ prakriyāyāmakhinnaḥ kimiva khalu karotu
                                vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ||84||

saṃ-yadi kevalaṃ carakaṃ paṭhati tatastasmāt
                                suśrutādipraṇigaditānāṃ-vartmasandhisitādijānāṃ rogāṇāṃ, dhruvaṃ
                                saṃjñāmātrāvabodhe+api bāhyaḥ| kintu hetulakṣaṇopakrameṇānabhijña
                                ityapiśabdārthaḥ| atha carakavihīnaḥ kevalaṃ
                                suśrutapāṭhasādhyaprakriyāyāṃ
                                doṣadūṣyakālabalaśarīrasattvasātmyādilakṣaṇāyāṃ, akhinnaḥ san
                                vyādhitānāṃ-kāsaśvāsādyabhibhūtānāṃ, kimiva varākaḥ-alpadhīḥ,
                                vidadhātu ? na kiñcidvidadhātuṃ śakta ityarthaḥ| iha tu
                                carakoktaprakriyāyāḥ pratipādanāt suśrutoktāmayābhidhānācca
                                tadadhyetā rogacikitsāyāṃ pravartamāno rogaśānti dhruvaṃ
                                vidadhātyeva| mālinīvṛttam|

paṭhatu yatnaparaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu
                                vaidyakamādyamanirvidaḥ||85||

abhiniveśo-vastupakṣapātaḥ, tasya vaśaḥ-sāmarthyaṃ, tasmāt| anyatra
                            guṇadoṣāvabhiyoktā śobhanokte+api tantre yonābhiyujyate-ṛṣipraṇīte
                            prītiṃ karoti, sa nara ādau bhavamādyaṃ,-prathamapraṇītaṃ brahmoktaṃ
                            śatasāhasraṃ, vaidyakaṃ yatnaparastathā anirvedaḥ san
                            puruṣāyuṣaṃ-varṣaśataṃ, paṭhatu| kilāsmin kāle
                            hīyamānabuddhimedhājīvitasya puruṣasya śravaṇacintanāvabodhānuṣṭhānāni
                            sudūrotsāritānyevetyarthaḥ| puruṣāyuṣamityacaturādisūtre nipātitam| [
                            drutavilambitaṃ vṛttam| ]

vāte pitte śleṣmaśāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpirmākṣikaṃ ca
                                krameṇa||86||

etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahajo vā kā nirmantre
                                vaktṛbhedoktiśaktiḥ||86||

vāte tailaṃ pathyaṃ, pitte ghṛtaṃ pathyaṃ, śleṣmākṣikaṃ pathyaṃ,
                            yathākramam| ityevaṃ bhagavān brahmā bhāṣatām, brahmajo
                            vā-sanatkumārādiḥ, bhāṇatu| nirmantre-aśabdasvabhāve tailādike svākarata
                            utpanne, vātādiśamanaśaktervaktṛviśeṣoktyā śaktirna kācidityarthaḥ|
                            śālinīvṛttam|

vaktṛvaśāt kiṃ tailāderdravyasya śaktirviśiṣyate ? api tu na kaścideva
                            viśeṣa utpadyate| yataḥ svabhāvahetubhya eva etacchaktiyuktāścotpannāḥ|
                            ato-vidhātṛśād dravyaśaktiviśeṣalakṣaṇāddhetoḥ, matsaramutsṛjya-vidveṣaṃ
                            vihāya, mādhyasthyamāśrīyatām| madhyastho hi puruṣaḥ
                            kālabudhdyādyanurūpamidameva śāstramupakārakaṃ mama, na tvato+aparaṃ
                            śāstramupakārakaṃ buddhyā parāmarśyādhyeṣyate, na
                            tvajñānābhiniveśāgrahametītyarthaḥ|
bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmādgrāhyaṃ subhāṣitam||88||

yadi ṛṣipraṇīte prītistataścarakasuśrutākhyau hitvā
                            bheḍajātūkarṇyādimunipraṇītāni śāstrāṇi kimiti na paṭhyante sarveṇaiva
                            vaidyavṛndena| api tu subhāṣitapriyatayā carakasuśrutau bāhulyena yathā
                            paṭhyete, na tathā bheḍādayaḥ| tasmātsthitametat subhāṣitaṃ grāhyam, na
                            tu munipraṇītameva tantram| ataścarakasuśrutavadanārṣamapīdaṃ
                            guṇavattvānmatimadbhirgrāhyameva|
kṛtvā yacśubhamāptaṃ śubhamastu paraṃ tato jagataḥ||89||

etat-hṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, hṛdayamiva| kasya ?
                            sarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ| yathā hṛdayaṃ śarīrasyaikadeśamapi
                            daśabhirmūlasirābhiḥ sakalaṃ kāyaṃ vyāpnoti, tathedamapi ṣaḍbhiḥ
                            sthānaiḥ sakalamaṣṭāṅgāyurvedavāṅmayaṃ vyāpya sthitamiti sādharmyāt|
                            tadevamīdṛśaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā-vidhāya, yatkalyāṇaṃ paraṃ-śreṣṭhaṃ, prāptaṃ
                            [ tataḥ- ] tasmācśubhāt, jagataḥ-bhuvanasya, maṅgalaṃ bhavatviti| āryā|
                            iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya-
                            ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vājīkaraṇa-
                            vidhirnāma catvāriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 40||
